title: Sales Manager Cyber Security (m/w/d) – Aufbau Neukundengeschäft
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Cyber Security entscheidet heute über die Zukunftsfähigkeit von Unternehmen. Als Sales Manager (m/w/d) für unsere Cyber-Security-Beratung erschließt du neue Kundenbeziehungen, vertiefst bestehende Partnerschaften und identifizierst konkrete Geschäftschancen für unsere Beratungsleistungen.

Deine Stärke ist es, Menschen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Vertrauen aufzubauen und gemeinsam mit unseren Solution Managern passgenaue Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln. Dein Ziel: echten Bedarf frühzeitig erkennen, qualifizierte Opportunities aufbauen und realistische Budgets verhandeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst aktiv neue Kundenbeziehungen im Offline-Vertrieb und baust unser Netzwerk systematisch aus.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Zielkunden und Ansprechpartner in den von uns definierten Märkten.
  • Du knüpfst neue Kontakte, organisierst Erstgespräche und führst überzeugende Ice-Breaker-Pitches durch.
  • Du qualifizierst potenzielle Leads hinsichtlich Bedarf, konkreten Herausforderungen, Entscheidungsstrukturen, Zeitplanung und Budget.
  • Du lieferst vorqualifizierte Business Opportunities an unser Management und unsere Solution Manager.
  • Du begleitest Kontakte kontinuierlich vom ersten Austausch bis zur konkreten Opportunity und stellst ein konsequentes Follow-up sicher.
  • Du nimmst an relevanten Fachveranstaltungen, Branchen-Events und Networking-Formaten teil.
  • Du analysierst Events im Vorfeld, identifizierst für uns relevante Kontakte und sprichst diese gezielt an.
  • Du entwickelst unseren bestehenden Sales-Prozess weiter und machst Vertriebsaktivitäten messbarer und effizienter.
  • Du arbeitest als Sparringspartner eng mit Marketing, Management und Solution Managern zusammen.
  • Du gibst Markt- und Kundenfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebs- und Beratungsangebots zurück.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung neuer Kunden und im Aufbau belastbarer Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Ein eigenes, für unser Geschäft relevantes Netzwerk sowie die Fähigkeit, dieses kontinuierlich auszubauen.
  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Ansprache und Vorqualifizierung potenzieller Kunden.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für den Markt des Security Consulting und die Abgrenzung zum Vertrieb von Security-Produkten.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Bedarf, Needs und Budgets potenzieller Kunden strukturiert zu erfassen und realistisch einzuschätzen.
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Freude an persönlichen Kundenterminen, Networking und Events.
  • Ausgeprägte soziale Kompetenz und ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner.
  • Die Fähigkeit, dich auf Menschen, Rollen, Branchen und Gesprächssituationen flexibel einzustellen.
  • Ein modernes, digitales und unternehmerisches Mindset.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du musst nicht zu jedem Kunden bereits die fertige Lösung präsentieren. Deine Aufgabe ist es, Interesse zu wecken, relevante Gespräche zu eröffnen und echte Herausforderungen zu erkennen.

Wir suchen deshalb eine Persönlichkeit, die:

  • Einen überzeugenden Ice-Breaker-Pitch beherrscht
  • Nicht versucht, vorschnell eine dedizierte Solution zu verkaufen
  • Aufmerksam zuhört und die richtigen Fragen stellt
  • Vertrauen aufbaut, ohne aufdringlich zu wirken
  • Auch komplexe Cyber-Security-Themen verständlich vermitteln kann
  • Kontakte nicht nur sammelt, sondern nachhaltig entwickelt

Unser Vergütungsmodell

Wir bieten dir ein transparentes und leistungsorientiertes Vergütungsmodell:

  • 60.000 bis 70.000 € fixes Jahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation.
  • Ein variabler Vergütungsanteil von rund 40 % auf Basis klar definierter Vertriebsziele.
  • Bei Überperformance ist eine Gesamtzielerreichung von bis zu 150 % möglich.
  • Ein Firmenwagen wird gestellt.
  • Die Provision wird quartalsweise ausgezahlt.
  • Im ersten Quartal gleichen wir den noch nicht vorhandenen Provisionsanteil durch eine Aufstockung des Fixgehalts aus.

Warum du zu uns kommen solltest

  • Du baust einen wichtigen Vertriebsbereich in einem zukunftskritischen Markt aktiv mit auf.
  • Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum bei Kundenansprache, Netzwerkaufbau und Prozessentwicklung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Solution Managern, Marketing und Management zusammen.
  • Du verkaufst keine beliebigen Produkte, sondern hilfst Unternehmen, ihre Cyber Security strategisch und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Deine Kontakte, Ideen und Erfolge werden sichtbar und wertgeschätzt.
  • Du profitierst von einem attraktiven Fixgehalt, einer leistungsorientierten Provision und einem Firmenwagen.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Du erkennst dich in dieser Rolle wieder und möchtest Cyber-Security-Consulting gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und einigen Sätzen zu deinen bisherigen Erfolgen im B2B-Vertrieb, deinem relevanten Netzwerk und deiner Motivation für den Bereich Cyber Security.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Business Intelligence Data Architect
descriptionHtml:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.

In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.

If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:

  • Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.
  • Build governed data models and semantic layers: Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish analytics engineering best practices: Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Enable secure, reliable data access: Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.
  • Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.
  • Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You

  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.
  • Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.
  • Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.
  • Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.
  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.
  • Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
  • Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.
  • You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!

What Do We Offer?

Interesting Work | We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. 

Tribe Vibe | We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.

Bragging Rights | We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

One Team One Dream | This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…

title: Business Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Engineer C2

Team: Product & Tech Business Operations

Salary: £45,600 - £57,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Business Operations

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work inthe UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

You'll own and evolve the technical systems that power P&T Business Operations — Jira architectures, data pipelines, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise platforms. You identify where operational capability could be stronger, scope those opportunities, and design and build solutions in collaboration with the Business Operations Manager. You approach problems with an AI-first mindset and make technical decisions with clarity about trade-offs.

  • Own and evolve the standardisation of Jira and other Kaluza data systems. Configure, extend, and redesign them to support increasingly complex business operations.

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and dashboards that turn raw operations data into clear signals for decision-making. Explore where AI agents and autonomous systems can streamline operations.

  • Identify opportunities for new capabilities (better delivery planning data & tooling capabilities, improved management insights solutions, plugging into adjacent Kaluza products) and design and build solutions, aligned with the direction from the business operations manager who will lead the product & delivery enablement side of things

  • Connect and integrate internal products and platforms — Workday integrations, locally-built internal tools, and other solutions. Make recommendations on what to build, integrate, or take over — clearly articulating trade-offs, impact, and delivery path.

  • Anticipate security, compliance, and regulatory constraints upfront. Navigate Kaluza's systems to unblock delivery quickly.

  • Spot when something's off — in the data, in a process, or in a tool — and fix it before it becomes someone else's problem.

  • Iterate on our operational tooling continuously, testing new approaches early and sharing what you learn openly with the team.


What you'll bring

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • 3–5 years building and maintaining operational tooling — not just writing code, but owning what you ship.

  • Strong Jira expertise (including JQL) and Confluence; comfortable configuring them for complex portfolio structures.

  • Experience with APIs/integrations and data exchange, SQL + basic scripting, BI tools, AI tools and automation.

  • Experience building data pipelines or automated workflows with practical understanding of keeping them reliable at scale.

  • Confident in identifying improvements and implementing them independently. You break down ambiguous problems, scope solutions, and drive delivery without constant prompting. You don't wait to be told what's next.

  • Comfortable with data analysis, ambiguity, and working in scaling organisations where processes and systems need to grow as fast as the people using them.

  • You navigate Kaluza's systems to move fast. You share progress openly and communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

What will set you apart:

  • You're the kind of person who spots a constraint, maps it back to its root cause, and builds a fix (or identifies where a temporary workaround is needed, whilst you work on a fix). You set a high bar for your own work and raise it over time, and you're not satisfied leaving a system in a worse state than you found it.

  • You work openly by default: you share progress, flag blockers early, and communicate what's working and what isn't without waiting to be asked. People across the organisation find it easy to understand what you're doing and why.

  • You're genuinely curious about new tools and approaches — especially AI — and you actively bring others along by sharing what you've tried, what landed, and what didn't. Learning in the open comes naturally to you.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Category Management Werkstudent (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale perfekt mit den besten lokalen und internationalen Produkten ausgestattet sind – und das immer frisch und zu den besten Preisen.

Als WerkstudentIn (m/w/d) bist du das operative Rückgrat dieses Teams und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in den E-Commerce und den FMCG-Bereich (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods). Du tauchst tief in Daten ein, unterstützt bei der Sortimentsgestaltung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte in der App optimal präsentiert werden. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Category Managern sowie cross-funktionalen Teams (wie Supply Chain und Marketing) zusammen, pflegst wichtige Stammdaten und hilfst dabei, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist. Mit deinem analytischen Denken und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse zudem jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser.

Das erwartet dich

  • Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft: Du hilfst unseren Category Managern bei operativen und administrativen Aufgaben im E-Commerce-Alltag – von der Ein- und Auslistung von Produkten bis hin zur Überprüfung von Datenblättern.
  • App & Content Pflege: Du bist mitverantwortlich für den In-App Content deiner Produktkategorien. Du sorgst dafür, dass Artikelbeschreibungen, Bilder und Promotions immer up-to-date sind und unseren KundInnen ein Lächeln ins Gesicht zaubern.
  • Daten & Analysen: Du wertest Verkaufszahlen, Kundenfeedback und Markttrends aus, erkennst Muster und hilfst dem Team dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zur Sortimentsoptimierung zu treffen.
  • Lieferanten- & Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du unterstützt bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung von Lieferantengesprächen und arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Teams wie Supply Chain und Customer Success zusammen.
  • Projektarbeit: Du bekommst die Chance, eigene, übergreifende Projekte zur Verbesserung unserer Tools und Prozesse zu übernehmen und so aktiv zur Unternehmensstrategie beizutragen."

Das bringst du mit

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Ein scharfes Auge fürs Detail, starkes logisches Denkvermögen und eine natürliche Neugier, um hinter die Kulissen zu blicken und operative Rätsel zu lösen.
  • Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.
  • Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software und automatisierten Systemen.
  • Zeit, unser Team für 16 - 20 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Ein moderner Workspace: Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).
  • Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Als WerkstudentIn verdienst du 14,75 €/Std. (Bachelor) bzw. 15,50 €/Std. (Master) und sammelst spannende Praxiserfahrung.
    Schick uns deine Bewerbung gern auf Englisch, wenn du schon eine englische Version parat hast.

title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT HOMME/SLG/CEINTURE (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

title: CDI - Manager AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Au contact des dirigeants et des responsables métiers, vous définissez des dispositifs de montée en compétences, de construction d’agents et d’accompagnement au changement. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions : vous en garantissez la qualité, l’impact et la rentabilité, faites grandir vos équipes et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables.

Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre ambition : faire de l’IA un levier de transformation du travail, avec un impact concret, mesurable et durable sur les équipes et leur performance.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Conduire le cadrage avec L&D, RH, sponsors et métiers: définir populations cibles, priorités, objectifs observables et parcours différenciés.Concevoir une stratégie de démultiplication combinant sessions, contenus digitaux, coaching, champions et transfert aux équipes internes.Piloter un portefeuille de cas d'usage opérationnels: valeur, faisabilité, risque, capacité de build et séquencement des sprints.Organiser les ateliers de discovery et faire arbitrer les points de dépendance, d'accès ou de gouvernance par les interlocuteurs habilités.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Piloter budget, planning, staffing, qualité pédagogique et satisfaction ; réaliser les arbitrages nécessaires et faire grandir les équipes.Superviser les assets pédagogiques, animer les sessions à forte visibilité et garantir l'alignement entre exercices, capacités des plateformes et besoins métier.Superviser les solutions low-code/no-code, les standards, les jeux de tests, la documentation et les quality gates adaptés au périmètre technique et aux standards de la practice.Concevoir avec les Analytics Engineers l’architecture de reporting d’un programme, définir les standards de visualisation et de KPIs, coacher les équipes en data storytelling, superviser leurs dashboards et en piloter l’adoption.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Coordonner la mise en usage, la formation des utilisateurs et le handover client: relais managériaux, communautés, rituels et office hours.Piloter les boucles de feedback, les indicateurs de valeur et, si désigné, le plan de change sur une mission ciblée.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Définir des indicateurs de compétences, d'autonomie et d'usage; restituer les résultats aux sponsors et ajuster la démarche.Contribuer aux avant-ventes, estimations, chiffrages et propositions, en identifiant les extensions pertinentes chez les clients.Qualifier la nécessité d’un co-delivery avec Solutions Engineering ou la DSI, sans empiéter sur leurs autorités techniques.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision

5 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.Une expérience confirmée de pilotage de missions complexes et de management d’équipes, avec une responsabilité sur la qualité des livrables, les délais, les budgets et la satisfaction client.Une solide maîtrise des usages de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir, challenger et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et à guider les équipes dans leur construction.Une expérience dans la conception et le pilotage de dispositifs de montée en compétences et de programmes d’adoption de l’IA, ainsi que dans la transformation des processus, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.Une aisance dans la relation avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau, la capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes, faire grandir les consultants et contribuer au développement commercial.Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement s'étend sur l'intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : Strategize AI (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opérationnels), Deploy AI (ingénierie, industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et Adopt AI (conduite du changement, acculturation, usage quotidien de l'IA).

Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises
Occuper un rôle à la croisée de l'humain (AI Adoption), de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (AI Engineering).Piloter ce qui compte

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

Une trajectoire qui accélère 

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (30 / 45’) avec les RH / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un entretien de fit expert (60’) avec un AI Builder Senior ou Manager
  3. Une présentation d’un cas réel (60’) sur lequel le candidat a travaillé par le passé avec un AI Builder Director
  4. Un role play AI Adoption Manager (45 / 60’) AI Builder Director ou un AI Builder Partner
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30’) avec un AI Builder Partner

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - Manager Product Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 75 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 8 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Présentation département

L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon.

Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement.

Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement.

Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs.

Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR

Présentation de la ou les thématiques :

Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. Il implique plusieurs laboratoires du CNRS (INL, TIMA, IRISA, IETR, LIP6, LIRMM, LAMIH, IMS, Lab Hubert Curien, Lab-STICC…), le CEA-LIST, ainsi que de nombreux partenaires académiques et industriels.

Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) ingénieur(e) informatique / EDA chargé(e) de la qualification des outils, modèles et blocs IP utilisés et développés au sein de PHOENIX, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche, les doctorants et les partenaires industriels.

Description de la ou les missions / les activités

- Mettre en place, maintenir et faire évoluer l’environnement logiciel de conception (flow EDA) pour les partenaires du consortium PHOENIX (CAO, simulation, caractérisation, PDK, IP).
- Qualifier les outils EDA (commercials et open source), modèles de dispositifs et blocs IP : définition de bancs de tests, métriques de performance, protocoles d’évaluation et rapports de validation.
- Participer à l’intégration et à l’évaluation de méthodes d’EDA augmentées par l’IA (optimisation de flows, génération de modèles, analyse automatique de résultats, etc.).
- Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, interface avec les fournisseurs d’outils et les équipes IT locales).
- Contribuer à la rédaction de livrables techniques du projet : documents de spécification, rapports de qualification, guides d’utilisation des outils et IP.
- Mettre en place de bonnes pratiques pour la gestion de versions, la traçabilité des résultats, l’automatisation des flows (scripts, CI/CD, conteneurisation).
- Participer à la veille technologique sur les outils EDA, les librairies IP, les technologies de calcul avancées et proposer des évolutions du parc logiciel.



Profil recherché / Compétences attendues________________________________

Diplômes : Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master 2 ou doctorat en informatique, microélectronique ou domaine proche.
Expérience : Débutant accepté

Compétences opérationnelles :

- Solides compétences en EDA (front-end et/ou back-end) : RTL, synthèse, P&R, extraction, simulation (SPICE, mixed-signal, etc.), PDK, caractérisation.
- Maîtrise de scripts et automatisation (Python, Shell, Make, ou équivalent) et aisance avec les environnements Linux.
- Connaissance souhaitée des architectures matérielles pour l’IA, des technologies émergentes ou de la conception de chiplets.
- Intérêt marqué pour la qualité logicielle et la validation : tests, métriques, reproductibilité, documentation.
- Excellent sens de la communication et du travail en équipe dans un environnement multi-sites et pluridisciplinaire.
- Maîtrise du français et bonne pratique de l’anglais technique (échanges avec partenaires et fournisseurs, rédaction de rapports).

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive BJAK's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.

What You'll Own

  • Drive strategic execution across AI Neobank priorities. 

  • Build and manage operating rhythm, OKRs, leadership updates, decision tracking and accountability. 

  • Coordinate major workstreams across product, engineering, licensing, market expansion, partnerships, finance and operations. 

  • Prepare concise decision memos, board / leadership materials, execution plans and performance reviews. 

  • Identify gaps, risks and dependencies before they become serious blockers. 

  • Help leadership make sharper trade-offs on people, capital, product and market priorities. 

  • Own special projects that require senior judgement and cross-functional authority.


What We're Looking For 

  • Strong operator with experience driving strategic execution across teams. 

  • Excellent judgement, communication, prioritization and follow-through. 

  • Able to work with founders, CEOs, leadership teams and senior external stakeholders.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity with limited guidance. 

  • Can go from high-level strategy to detailed execution without losing quality. 

  • Strong writing, business analysis and problem-solving skills. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, strategy, operations, fintech, financial services or regional expansion is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Makes the company move faster and with more clarity. 

  • Can challenge, align and unblock teams without adding bureaucracy. 

  • Stays close to facts, numbers, owners and deadlines. 

  • Balances strategic judgement with hands-on execution. 

  • Low ego, high ownership and strong bias for action.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who want a purely advisory role. 

  • Candidates who cannot handle pressure, ambiguity or senior accountability. 

  • People who create process without improving execution. 

Location

This role is based in United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

Project Management:

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

title: Clinical AI Research Lead
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

descriptionHtml:
At Excelya, we combine passion, scientific excellence, and collaboration to drive healthcare innovation. As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Data Manager to join a global clinical development environment supporting international studies.

In this role, you will work closely with Biometrics, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations teams, and external partners to oversee data management activities across company-sponsored clinical studies. You will play a key role in ensuring data quality, compliance, vendor oversight, and timely database deliveries while collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and international setting.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Review and supervise Data Management deliverables produced by CROs and external service providers, including:
    • Data Management Plans (DMP)
    • Data Transfer Specifications
    • Data Review Plans
    • Data Management Reports
    • Protocol Deviation Specifications
  • Participate in the design, review, and validation of eCRFs:
    • CRF design and review
    • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Monitor and track data management milestones throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Oversee vendor performance and study progress through dashboards and KPIs.
  • Ensure high-quality data review activities and timely database lock in compliance with company quality standards.
  • Ensure delivery of clean and finalized databases according to agreed timelines and formats.
  • Participate in vendor selection processes and Request for Proposal (RFP) reviews.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biostatistics, Data Management, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Strong years of experience in Clinical Data Management.
  • Experience supervising CROs, external vendors, or Data Management teams.
  • Experience in Real-World Evidence (RWE), non-interventional, retrospective, and prospective studies is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle.
  • Knowledge of Data Management processes and industry standards.
  • Experience with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and eCRF development.
  • Strong project management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment.
  • Fluent English (written and verbal).

Benefits

Why Join Us?

At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with a true team spirit to redefine excellence in the healthcare sector.

Here’s what sets us apart:

We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, with the goal of becoming the leading mid-size CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience. Our “one-stop provider” model—offering full-service, FSP, and consulting—allows you to grow through a variety of projects. Working alongside recognized experts, you’ll contribute to the advancement of scientific, operational, and interpersonal knowledge, all in the service of improving the patient experience.

“Excelling with care” means thriving in an environment that values your natural talents, encourages boldness, and supports the development of your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our collective mission.

title: Clinical Training and Education Lead
descriptionHtml:
What is the job?

This is an opportunity to shape how our clinical teams learn, develop and perform as Montu continues to grow.

Sitting within the Learning and Development function, you will take ownership of the learning experience across our clinical teams. You will build structured, engaging and practical development programmes that give our people the knowledge, skills and confidence to deliver safe, consistent and patient-centred care.

You do not need to be a clinician or hold a professional healthcare registration. However, you will need to understand the realities of working in a clinical environment, including the importance of patient safety, clinical governance, regulatory compliance and quality.

Working closely with clinical subject-matter experts, operational leaders and the wider People team, you will turn complex standards, processes and clinical requirements into learning that people can understand, apply and embed in their everyday work.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is passionate about developing people, confident working with specialist stakeholders and comfortable building learning solutions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

What You Will Own

Clinical Learning and Development

  • Own the learning and development plan for our clinical teams, ensuring it supports business priorities, service growth and workforce capability

  • Design and deliver structured onboarding, induction and ongoing development programmes for new and existing team members

  • Build clear learning pathways that support employees from joining the business through to continued development and career progression

  • Create engaging workshops, digital learning, practical resources and supporting materials for a range of clinical audiences

  • Conduct training needs analyses, skills audits and capability assessments to identify current and future development priorities

  • Deliver group workshops, virtual learning sessions and one-to-one coaching where required

  • Support the delivery and monitoring of mandatory training and continuing professional development requirements

Competency and Capability

  • Develop clear and practical competency frameworks in partnership with clinical subject-matter experts

  • Create consistent approaches to assessing knowledge, skills and competence across clinical teams

  • Work with managers to identify capability gaps and put appropriate development plans in place

  • Support leaders in embedding coaching, feedback and reflective practice within their teams

  • Ensure learning is transferred into day-to-day performance rather than ending when the training session finishes

Clinical Standards and Governance

  • Work closely with Clinical Governance, Quality, Safeguarding and operational leaders to ensure learning reflects current standards and requirements

  • Translate clinical policies, pathways, Standard Operating Procedures and regulatory requirements into clear and practical learning

  • Support the rollout of new clinical services, systems, technologies and ways of working through effective training and change support

  • Ensure relevant learning supports Care Quality Commission standards, patient safety requirements and internal governance expectations

  • Recognise where specialist clinical input or approval is required and work with the appropriate subject-matter expert

  • Maintain accurate learning, competency and compliance records across clinical teams

Learning Impact and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish clear measures of success for learning programmes and evaluate their impact on capability, performance and service quality

  • Use assessment outcomes, employee feedback, audit findings, quality data, incidents, complaints and patient feedback to identify learning priorities

  • Produce meaningful learning insights and reports to demonstrate progress, risks and areas for improvement

  • Regularly review and improve learning content to ensure it remains accurate, relevant and effective

  • Identify opportunities to improve how learning is delivered, recorded and embedded across the business

  • Champion a culture where learning, coaching, feedback and continuous improvement are part of everyday work

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build credible and trusted relationships with clinical, operational and People leaders

  • Partner with subject-matter experts to create learning that is clinically accurate, engaging and appropriate for its audience

  • Coach and support managers to identify development needs and build capability within their teams

  • Balance learning priorities with operational requirements in a busy and fast-moving environment

  • Act as the Learning and Development lead for relevant clinical change and transformation projects

What do you need?

  • Strong experience within Learning and Development, workforce development, operational training or a similar role

  • A good understanding of clinical or healthcare environments, including patient safety, clinical governance, quality and regulatory requirements

  • Experience designing and delivering engaging learning programmes for specialist, operational or regulated teams

  • Strong learning design skills, with the ability to turn complex or technical information into clear and practical learning

  • Experience developing structured onboarding programmes, learning pathways or competency frameworks

  • Excellent facilitation, coaching and communication skills

  • The confidence to work with clinical specialists and senior stakeholders without needing to be the clinical expert in the room

  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different teams

  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business

  • Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work through to completion

  • Experience using data, feedback and performance measures to evaluate learning and drive improvement

  • Experience supporting organisational change, service transformation or the implementation of new systems and processes

  • Confidence using learning management systems, digital learning tools and reporting platforms

  • A relevant Learning and Development, education or training qualification would be beneficial but is not essential

  • Professional registration with a healthcare body is a plus, but not required

 

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £45K – £50K

title: Cloud Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will operate and support the cloud platforms that power The Exploration Company’s engineering, operations, and data workloads in France. You will design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud services so teams can work securely and reliably across both environments. This hands-on, high-ownership role sits at the intersection of aerospace and modern cloud engineering, with a strong focus on security, sovereignty, and compliance requirements.

You will work on-site in France and collaborate closely with engineering teams to translate their needs into resilient, secure, and well-documented infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud environments, including managed Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

  • Define and maintain a consistent architecture across AWS and SecNumCloud, including identity, networking, and secrets management, to keep environments comparable and portable where needed.

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) so all environments are reproducible and version-controlled.

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure and application builds, testing, and deployment.

  • Manage container platforms and orchestration, including Kubernetes cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, and workload scheduling.

  • Set up and maintain observability (metrics, logging, alerting) to detect and resolve issues before they affect engineering or operations.

  • Enforce security and compliance best practices, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and vulnerability patching.

  • Support audits and compliance evidence collection for SecNumCloud and other applicable frameworks.

  • Define backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies for critical data and services.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable infrastructure solutions.

What we would love to see from you

  • 3+ years of experience in a cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering role.

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS or GCP, including compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

  • Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and version control workflows.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts: VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, DNS, and VPNs.

  • Working knowledge of containers and orchestration, ideally Kubernetes.

  • Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Willingness to learn sovereign and high-assurance cloud security requirements, and to apply them to cloud environments. Prior exposure is a plus but not required.

  • A security-first mindset with practical knowledge of IAM, secrets management, encryption, and compliance frameworks.

  • Fluent English. Working knowledge of French is not required but is considered an advantage.

  • Ability to work effectively in a multilingual team.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the aerospace, defense, or mission-critical systems domain.

  • Experience with multi-region or disaster recovery architectures.

  • Experience with hybrid or multi-cloud architectures across AWS and sovereign cloud providers.

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer - Professional) or equivalent.

  • Exposure to ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or other security certification environments.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: CNC Machinist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

The parts you cut go into aircraft, defence systems, energy infrastructure and robots. This is a hands-on machining role at our Hamburg factory, where you own your work from the program to the finished part rather than handing it down a line.

The factory is still being built, so you will help shape the setup rather than wait for it.

What you'll do

  • Program, simulate and optimise toolpaths in 3-axis, 5-axis and mill-turn where it applies.

  • Set up, prove out and run jobs to aerospace and defence standards.

  • Own cycle time and machine utilisation.

  • Choose fixturing, tooling and cutting parameters for aluminium, steels, titanium and Inconel.

  • Take new parts from drawing to repeatable production, with DFM feedback for the customer.

What we're looking for

  • Strong CAM programming in Fusion, Hypermill, Mastercam or equivalent.

  • A record of holding tolerances of ±0.01 mm or tighter.

  • Production experience setting and running high-end machines such as Hermle, DMG Mori or Mazak.

  • A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling strategy and workholding.

  • Confident reading of complex drawings and GD&T.

Nice to have

  • Aerospace, defence or other high-specification experience.

  • 5-axis simultaneous machining.

  • Probing, automation or pallet systems.

  • EN 9100, AS9100 or ISO 9001 familiarity.

  • Some English, for working with our UK and US teams.

Why Isembard

  • Work on mission-critical aerospace and defence components on advanced machine tools.

  • Influence the programming standards used across our sites.

  • Join early and help build our German factory.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Hamburg factory.

Applications in German or English are welcome. Lieber auf Deutsch? Hier bewerben.

Isembard is an equal opportunity employer.
