descriptionHtml:
termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.

termios ist ein 2023 gegründetes Joint-Venture von mantro als Company Builder, dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen

Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.

Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.

Du startest dabei nicht bei null: Wir haben bereits zwei vom BMWE geförderte Forschungsprojekte und sind in weiteren Forschungsfeldern aktiv. Für dieses wachsende Portfolio suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt jemanden, der Forschung nicht nur organisiert, sondern selbst betreibt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Studiendesign und Feldversuche: Du übersetzt offene Fragen in prüfbare Hypothesen und ein belastbares Studiendesign mit Vergleichsgruppen, Baseline, Witterungsbereinigung und Messkonzept. Messkampagnen in realen Liegenschaften setzt du gemeinsam mit Field Service und Anlagentechnik um.

  • Datenanalyse: Du wertest Zeitreihen aus dem Gerätebestand und aus Messkampagnen selbst aus, quantifizierst Effekte und Unsicherheiten und trennst sauber zwischen Korrelation und Wirkung.

  • Ergebnisse: Du bereitest Erkenntnisse für Abschlussberichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzen und Kunden auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie in unsere Algorithmen und Produktentwicklung zurückfließen.

  • Projektleitung: Du steuerst mehrere parallel laufende Forschungs- und Pilotprojekte, von Arbeitspaketen und Meilensteinen über Budgets und Berichtspflichten bis zu Kooperationsverträgen, Datenschutz und Förderrichtlinien.

  • Förderung und Akquise: Du findest passende Förderprogramme auf Landes-, Bundes- und EU-Ebene, entwickelst Projektideen mit Partnern und schreibst Skizzen und Anträge.

Das bringst du mit

  • Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem ingenieur-, natur- oder datenwissenschaftlichen Fach, z. B. Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Bauphysik, Physik, Mathematik oder Informatik.

  • Forschungserfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der angewandten Forschung gearbeitet, etwa an einem Fraunhofer-Institut, einer anderen Forschungseinrichtung, einer Hochschule oder in einer F&E-Abteilung, idealerweise im Umfeld Gebäude, Energie oder TGA.

  • Methodik und Daten: Du hast Studien oder Messkampagnen selbst konzipiert und ausgewertet, wendest statistische Verfahren wie Regression, Zeitreihenanalyse und Hypothesentests sicher an und arbeitest dabei mit Python oder R sowie SQL.

  • Projektleitung: Du hast Projekte mit mehreren Partnern geleitet oder koordiniert und bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen.

  • Kommunikation: Du schreibst klar und belastbar, vom Förderantrag bis zur Veröffentlichung. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau.

Das ist ein Plus

Niemand bringt alles mit. Vieles davon lernst du bei uns.

  • Förderprojekte: Du hast schon Anträge geschrieben oder öffentlich geförderte Projekte abgewickelt.

  • Heizungstechnik: Du kennst dich mit Heizungshydraulik, hydraulischem Abgleich und Wärmeerzeugern wie Fernwärme oder Wärmepumpe aus.

  • Einsparnachweise: Du kennst Verfahren zur Messung und Verifikation von Einsparungen, z. B. IPMVP.

  • Modelle: Du hast Erfahrung mit Gebäudesimulation (z. B. Modelica, TRNSYS) oder Machine Learning.

  • Promotion oder eigene Publikationen

Gute Gründe, um bei uns durchzustarten

  • Forschung, die ankommt: Wenn du eine Hypothese an einem realen Gebäude prüfen willst, organisieren wir das. Was du herausfindest, landet im Produkt, und Veröffentlichungen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Hardware, Firmware, Funk, Cloud und Daten. Wer das gebaut hat, wonach du fragst, sitzt im selben Team.

  • Gestaltungsfreiraum ab dem ersten Tag, in einem agilen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid in Düsseldorf oder München, mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

  • Konditionen: Unbefristete Festanstellung, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub, Urban Sports und Corporate Benefits sowie regelmäßige Teamevents.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, gern mit Publikationsliste oder Links zu deinen Projekten. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schreib uns lieber ein paar Sätze dazu, welche Forschungsfrage dich bei uns besonders reizt.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer - stage (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Contexte
Alfeor est un groupe de PME industrielles françaises (nucléaire, défense). Le groupe déploie l’IA dans toutes ses filiales, avec des contraintes fortes de sécurité et de souveraineté des données. Vous rejoignez la holding et travaillez directement avec la direction et les équipes terrain. Déplacements fréquents sur les sites des filiales, 2 à 3 jours par semaine.

Missions

  • Identifier et prioriser les cas d’usage IA avec les équipes des filiales (méthodes, achats, qualité, commerce, direction).
  • Construire des outils et les mettre en service : connexion aux ERP et CRM, automatisation de tâches répétitives, agents sur de la documentation technique volumineuse.
  • Administrer l’infrastructure IA du groupe (serveurs Linux, conteneurs, API d’inférence).
  • Appliquer les règles de sécurité et de gouvernance des données dans un environnement sensible.
  • Former et accompagner les utilisateurs (ateliers, permanences, supports).


Exemples de projets

  • Extraction et analyse de données ERP pour aider les équipes commerciales.
  • Assistant de recherche dans des normes techniques de plusieurs milliers de pages.
  • Transcription et comptes rendus automatiques de réunions.
  • Veille automatisée sur des entreprises cibles.
  • Amélioration de process internes (suivi des commandes, contrôle qualité).


Profil

  • École d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou université, avec un fort profil technique.
  • Python, Rust, SQL, API, Docker, Linux. Une expérience avec des LLM ou des agents est un plus.
  • Bases solides en cybersécurité (réseaux, gestion des accès, protection des données).
  • Polyvalent : à l’aise sur un sujet technique comme dans un atelier avec un opérateur, une réunion avec la direction ou animer une séance de formation.
  • Autonome, avec un esprit entrepreneurial. Vous avancez sans attendre qu’on vous dise quoi faire.
  • Capacité à expliquer des sujets techniques à des personnes non techniques.


Ce que nous offrons

  • Une grande autonomie et un impact direct sur des entreprises industrielles réelles.
  • Des sujets variés, dans des secteurs peu exposés à l’IA aujourd’hui.
  • Fort impact et la possibilité de mener de bout en bout des projets.
  • Télétravail possible de manière occasionnelle.
  • Offre de CDI selon performance

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

The role

This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last.

It is not a support role. It is a build role, deployed forward, defining a new function rather than filling a seat. You will be based at our London factory, with roughly 30 to 50 per cent of your time embedded at other sites. We are open to graduate and experienced engineers. The package includes equity.

  • Run onboarding, training and day-to-day adoption with machinists, engineers and site operators.

  • Turn repeated support questions into playbooks, training material or self-service tools. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed.

  • Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status.

  • Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer.

  • Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap.

What you bring

  • The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision.

  • Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows.

  • Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site.

  • The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue.

  • Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

STRATOS builds the commercial digital twin that large industrial companies run on. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role

Take messy data from some of Europe's biggest industrial companies and ship it into production systems that their leaders and sales teams use every day. There are no slide decks and no hand-offs: you scope it, build it, ship it and see it change how a business sells.

What you'll do

  • Own client deployments end to end, from the first conversation with a client's team through to production

  • Build data pipelines in PySpark, Python and SQL that bring ERP, CRM and market data together into one model

  • Ship AI agents and workflows on Palantir Foundry and AIP that commercial teams use every day

  • Work directly with client leaders to understand what matters to them, then decide what to build and what not to

  • Feed what you learn back into the core product, so each deployment makes the next one faster

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1: Get to know the platform and the team, and ship your first pipeline to production.

  • Month 2: Own a workstream on a live client deployment.

  • Month 3: Take the lead with the client's team on what you're building.

You might be a fit if you

  • Have 0–4 years' experience in data engineering, software engineering or analytics

  • Write strong Python, PySpark and SQL

  • Can turn a vague business problem into clean, maintainable pipelines

  • Pick up new tools fast and want real responsibility early

  • Would rather build at a fast-growing company than wait your turn at a big one. Startup or top-tier consultancy backgrounds are both welcome

Nice to have

  • TypeScript, API development or dashboarding tools

  • Airflow, dbt or Databricks

  • Experience with ERP (SAP, Oracle) or CRM data

  • Palantir Foundry or AIP

Why engineers join us

  • Big clients, small team. Some of the biggest names in industry, served by a team of 40. Your work reaches their leadership in weeks, not years.

  • Own the stack. We fully control our stack and choose our tools. No committees, no tickets passed between five teams, no egos.

  • Built to last. Profitable, founder-led and majority founder-owned, backed by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel), with our Series A still ahead of us. That means growth on our terms and real upside for early joiners.

  • Learn from people who've done it. Founders who have run a $1B business, plus people from Palantir, McKinsey and BCG, all in the same room.

  • In person, on purpose. Three days a week together in Farringdon. Fast feedback, fast decisions and fast shipping.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

How we hire

  • Intro call with our recruiter

  • Technical task, reviewed by our engineers within a day or two

  • Call with Solomon, our VP Engineering

  • Two hours in person with Marco (CTO) and Solomon

  • 30-minute final conversation with Nico, our CEO

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

title: Founders Associate Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht zuschauen, wie ein Start-up wächst, sondern es mitbauen? Du hast in Beratung, Banking oder Business Development gelernt, wie man Probleme strukturiert, und willst jetzt selbst umsetzen? Dann komm zu MediPulse!

Healthcare is broken. Das wollen wir ändern, und dafür suchen wir Dich!

Über MediPulse

Ärzt:innen führen ihre Praxis wie ein mittelständisches Unternehmen: mit Personal, Investitionen und Kreditlinien. Gesteuert wird sie trotzdem im Blindflug. Das Honorar der KV steht erst Monate nach Quartalsende fest, die BWA kommt Wochen zu spät, und der Überblick entsteht mühsam in Excel. Engpässe zeigen sich erst, wenn sie längst eingetreten sind.

Das ändern wir. MediPulse verbindet Praxisverwaltungssystem und Bankkonten und zeigt Umsatz, Kosten und Liquidität tagesaktuell, aufgeschlüsselt nach KV, HZV und Privat, nach Standort, Arzt und Ziffer. Über 300 Arztpraxen und MVZ steuern damit heute ihre Praxis, 2025 hat uns die ENTSCHEIDERFABRIK mit ihrem Startup- und Digitalisierungspreis ausgezeichnet. Unser Ziel: Jede Praxis in Deutschland weiß jeden Tag, wo sie wirtschaftlich steht.

Wir sind ein kleines Team in München, mit Leuten von McKinsey und BCG, einem Arzt im Gründungsteam und Entwickler:innen mit durchweg 5+ Jahren Erfahrung. Wir arbeiten schnell und mit viel KI, übernehmen Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen, und bleiben dabei bodenständig.

Deine Mission

Als Founders Associate Intern arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern an den Themen, die MediPulse gerade am stärksten nach vorn bringen. Du übernimmst eigene Projekte, triffst Entscheidungen mit und siehst jeden Tag, wie aus einer Idee Umsatz wird. Du lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.

Woran du arbeitest

  • Wachstum: neue Vertriebswege und Partnerschaften aufbauen, etwa mit Praxisberatungen, Steuerberatungen und Verbänden
  • Strategie: Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Business Cases und Preismodelle, aus denen wir echte Entscheidungen ableiten
  • Investoren und Finanzen: Unterlagen, Kennzahlen und Auswertungen für Gespräche mit Investoren und Partnern vorbereiten
  • Sonderprojekte: von der Messe bis zum neuen Produktangebot – du koordinierst, treibst voran und bringst zu Ende
  • Automatisierung: Abläufe mit KI-Werkzeugen bauen, statt sie von Hand zu erledigen – so arbeiten wir im ganzen Team

Mit wem du arbeitest

Du arbeitest täglich mit Alex und Kolja, unseren Gründern. Beide kommen von McKinsey; Kolja kennt die Praxis von innen: Im chirurgischen MVZ seines Vaters hat er von Anfang an die betriebswirtschaftliche Seite verantwortet.

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Du hast schon erste Erfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in Business Development, Unternehmensberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital oder einem Start-up
  • Du denkst analytisch, strukturierst Probleme sauber und bringst Ergebnisse, die man direkt verwenden kann
  • Du packst an und bist dir für operative Arbeit nicht zu schade
  • Du lernst neue Werkzeuge schnell und hast Lust, mit KI zu arbeiten
  • Du studierst Wirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medizin oder etwas Vergleichbares, gern schon im Master
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern und echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins
  • Büro direkt am Marienplatz und ein Team, das eng vor Ort zusammenarbeitet
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Raum für Home-Office
  • Moderne Hardware deiner Wahl (z. B. MacBook) und Zugang zu den KI-Werkzeugen, die du brauchst
  • Fitnessabo (Wellpass) und attraktive Corporate Benefits

About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.


Your Role

title: Founding Customer Success Manager - DACH
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager at Heidi Health, you’ll be the bridge between technology and care - helping hospitals, clinics, and clinicians across Germany adopt and love Heidi.

You’ll manage the full customer journey for both public and private hospital deployments, ensuring seamless implementation, strong clinician engagement, and measurable impact on patient care.


This role is ideal for someone with a medical background (e.g. former doctor, nurse, or allied health professional) who’s excited to drive digital transformation in healthcare.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer outcomes: Be the strategic partner for a portfolio of Heidi’s customers, ensuring they achieve measurable success and realise value.

  • Lead onboarding & training: Lead onboarding of new customers from planning, training through to go-live, delivering seamless integrations into customer workflows.

  • Track and improve metrics along customer journey like time-to-first-value and early activation.

  • Drive strategic adoption: Develop and execute tailored adoption plans to maximise user engagement and satisfaction, enhancing the continued love for Heidi among clinicians.

  • Enhance Retention & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities, mitigate churn risks and work cross-functionally to deepen product engagement.

  • Customer advocacy: Build executive-level relationships and become the voice of the customer internally, advocating for their needs and priorities and showcasing wins.

  • Continuous engagement: Deliver value at every touchpoint through proactive check-ins, success planning, and education strategies. Think and act strategically to scale your impact.

  • Resolve operational blockers: Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Feedback insights: Gather and share insights to influence product development and feature prioritisation.

What you'll need

  • 2+ years in a customer success role at a SaaS company, with proven ability to own the full lifecycle

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone's day.

  • Familiarity with Germany’s healthcare ecosystem (both public and private).

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effortlessly set and manage expectations with customers and cross-functional teams.

  • Highly organised and can confidently manage multiple projects and competing priorities, while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

  • Self-starter with a bias for action, comfortable navigating fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude is more important than experience - if you are hungry, competitive, and motivated, with a knack for problem solving and relationship-building, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von 15 Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 40 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt: Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams.

  • Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft.

  • Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat.

🛟 Customer Support

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt: Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

Warum alago?

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

  • Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience und bestimmst Prozesse, Tools, Standards und Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

  • Du lernst, Vertrauen aufzubauen, schwierige Gespräche zu führen und Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert zu begleiten.

  • Ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, Pairing mit dem Engineering-Team und echte Code-Reviews. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen.

Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert

  • Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 16 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren.

  • Du knackst den Code, wie Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar werden – und nimmst dieses Playbook überallhin mit.

Du beschleunigst deine Entwicklung

Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern

title: Founding Operations & Systems Lead
descriptionHtml:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

 

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.

  • The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

     

What you'll own

  • Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.

  • Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.

  • Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.

  • Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.

  • The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.

     

What we're looking for

  • You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.

  • Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. We care much more about the traits you have and the things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV.

     

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up
    Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed
    We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership
    Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty
    If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service
    Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

     

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather write specs and hand tickets to engineers than build the thing yourself;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that's raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

     

Salary

£90k - £120k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

 

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. A call with our Head of People, an in-person session with the founders where you solve a real Odin problem end to end with AI, then a final with the founders. The last two can run on the same day.

 

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

 

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

You build the experience traders see when they work with Leonidas AI: a streaming, branching conversation where agents answer with live price tiles, charts, ARB analysis and sources, inside our app and wherever traders already work, such as Microsoft Teams and Excel. You own features end to end, from the backend-for-frontend to the component in a trader's hands.

This is a full stack role for the agentic era. The interface is no longer a set of fixed screens: it renders what an agent decides to show, as it thinks. You make that feel instant, trustworthy and easy to act on.

What you will do

  • Build agentic UI. Streaming chat, typed blocks parsed mid-stream, tool-call status, branching threads, and dashboards that turn an answer into something a trader can watch.

  • Own the BFF. Route handlers, auth, persistence of conversations and blocks, and the contract between the front end and the agent runtime.

  • Surface data people trust. Show source and as-of time on every number, with charts and tables that make curves and ARBs easy to read.

  • Work with the people who use it. Pair with designers, product and SMEs, and talk to traders to see where the experience breaks.

  • Use AI to build faster. Prototype with Claude Code, write tests that keep pace, and help raise our bar on testing beyond the UI.

What you bring

  • Proven experience building production web applications across front end and back end.

  • Strong TypeScript, React.

  • Experience with real-time UIs: streaming (SSE or WebSockets), optimistic updates and resilient reconnects.

  • Backend skills in Node.js or Python, with Postgres and API design (REST, tRPC or GraphQL).

  • A product eye: you sweat latency, empty states and the detail of a chart.

  • Good testing habits: unit, integration and end-to-end.

Nice to have

  • Built UI for LLM products or integrated with an agent backend.

  • Data visualisation for time series or financial data.

  • Design systems and monorepos (Nx, Storybook).

  • Microsoft Teams or Office add-in development.

Our stack for this team

TypeScript · React · tRPC · Kotlin · Postgres · Redis · Python · AWS

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

descriptionHtml:

Unser Mandant ist ein etablierter CNC-Präzisionsfertiger im Großraum Rendsburg: über 20 Jahre am Markt, rund 20 Mitarbeiter, ausgezeichnete Reputation. Der heutige Inhaber möchte sich aus dem operativen Geschäft zurückziehen und sucht dafür eine geordnete, vollständige Nachfolge. Moderne Maschinen und ein eingespieltes Team sind vorhanden – die Kapazitäten sind da, aber noch nicht ausgereizt. Wer hier einsteigt, übernimmt kein Sanierungsobjekt, sondern einen gesunden Betrieb mit konkretem, kurzfristig hebbarem Wachstumspotenzial.

WERDEN SIE NICHT NUR GESCHÄFTSFÜHRER – WERDEN SIE UNTERNEHMER!

Lassen Sie sich von der genannten Gehaltsspanne nicht täuschen: Sie steht nicht für ein Angestelltengehalt, sondern für den Unternehmerlohn, den Sie sich als Inhaber dieses Betriebs auszahlen können. Wie hoch er ausfällt, entscheiden künftig Sie – nicht ein Arbeitgeber. Und der Betrieb wirft Jahr für Jahr einen operativen Gewinn (EBITDA) von rund 400.000 EUR ab – und zwar zusätzlich zu Ihrem Unternehmerlohn. Geld, mit dem sich ein erheblicher Teil des Kaufpreises praktisch von selbst finanziert.

Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den Betrieb, fachlich wie kaufmännisch. In der operativen Steuerung – Produktionsplanung, Qualitätssicherung, Kundenbetreuung – werden Sie von einem erfahrenen Betriebs-/Produktionsleiter und der Arbeitsvorbereitung unterstützt.
  • Organisation von Produktion, Instandhaltung und angrenzenden Bereichen erfolgt zusammen mit Ihrem Team - so bleibt Ihnen der Kopf für die Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens und den Vertrieb frei.

  • Analyse und Optimierung der Prozesse – KVP, Kostenmanagement, Kennzahlensteuerung – mit dem klaren Ziel, die vorhandenen Kapazitäten besser auszulasten.
  • Steuerung der strategischen Weiterentwicklung: Sie sorgen nicht nur dafür, dass die richtigen, fertigungsgerechten Aufträge ins Haus kommen, sondern setzen auf Wachstum. Ein moderater Ausbau der zweiten Schicht und echte, aktive Marktbearbeitung statt reiner Bestandskundenpflege sind die Hebel.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem technisch geprägten, produzierenden Umfeld ist Voraussetzung – idealerweise in der Zerspanung bzw. CNC-Fertigung. Eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium in der Zerspanungstechnik ist ein klarer Vorteil, aber kein Muss: ausgeprägte technische Affinität und nachweisbare Erfolge im technischen Vertrieb können eine fehlende Fachausbildung ausgleichen.
  • Affinität zum technischen Vertrieb: Die Auftragslage ist heute stabil, doch langfristig entscheidet die Fähigkeit, Kunden zu gewinnen und zu binden, über den Erfolg.
  • Führungserfahrung – oder der ernsthafte, belegbare Wille, jetzt den Schritt in die Geschäftsführung zu gehen.
  • Betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis und die Bereitschaft, unternehmerische Verantwortung inklusive finanzieller Beteiligung zu tragen.
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten.

Benefits

  • Moderne Maschinenausstattung, gelebte Digitalisierung, ein eingespieltes Team erfahrener Facharbeiter.
  • Gutes Betriebsklima, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Einstieg als geschäftsführender Gesellschafter im Rahmen einer vollständigen Übernahme – begleitet von einer geordneten Übergabephase mit dem heutigen Inhaber.

Diese Position ist mit einer unternehmerischen Beteiligung (Vollübernahme) verbunden, Eigenkapital ist also erforderlich. Sie übernehmen einen modernen Maschinen- und Anlagenpark sowie die Betriebsimmobilie. Kundenstamm und Mitarbeiterschaft stellen einen erheblichen weiteren substanziellen Wert dar. title: Global PR Operations Lead - 12 month FTC
descriptionHtml:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Global PR Lead to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About the role
(Hybrid)

This is a role at the heart of our fast-paced, high-volume PR team, helping keep our communications flying in formation across 23 markets worldwide. You’ll be the central point connecting plans, people, budgets, agencies and operations — making sure our global PR machine runs smoothly, efficiently and at scale.

Working closely with our Senior Director of Communications, regional PR leads, internal teams and global agency partners, you’ll help turn our international PR strategy into coordinated action. From shaping global initiatives to sharpening the way we plan, measure and operate, you’ll bring the structure that helps brilliant PR ideas travel further.

What you’ll be doing

  • Driving global PR planning: You’ll lead the planning process with our global PR agency hub, partnering with the Senior Director of Communications to keep forecasting, budgets, resources and priorities aligned.

  • Turning measurement into momentum: You’ll work closely with our measurement lead to make sure reporting is accurate, useful and connected to the strategies and decisions that matter.

  • Optimising our PR ecosystem: You’ll partner with Procurement and Finance to make sure we have the right suppliers, commercial setup and financial tracking in place to support growth — without the spreadsheet drama.

  • Keeping priorities moving: You’ll traffic-manage inbound requests, help the team navigate competing priorities and make sure resources are focused where they can have the greatest impact.

  • Leading global PR initiatives: You’ll spearhead strategic PR initiatives and special projects beyond our core campaigns, while supporting the delivery of our Awareness strategy and Big Bet activity through PR.

  • Making operations smarter: You’ll lead and collaborate on cross-functional improvements spanning tools and technology, including Tableau, ThoughtSpot, AI and our Product Ops model — finding smarter ways for a global team to work at scale.

  • Creating consistency across markets: You’ll partner with market leads, our global agency hub and Corporate and B2B PR teams to develop playbooks, strengthen processes and drive consistent adoption and delivery across 23 markets. You’ll also manage and develop our PR Coordinator, keeping calendars, finance trackers and reporting firmly on course.

About you

  • Global PR operator: You’ve worked in complex, international communications environments and know how to turn lots of moving parts into one joined-up plan.

  • Strategic and operational: You’re equally comfortable shaping a global PR initiative and getting into the detail needed to make it happen. Big picture, meet beautifully organised spreadsheet.

  • Stakeholder savvy: You build trusted relationships across senior leaders, market teams, agencies and cross-functional partners, bringing people together around shared priorities.

  • Agency confident: You know how to get the best from global agency relationships, balancing clear direction, strong partnership and accountability for delivery.

  • Commercially switched-on: You’re comfortable working with budgets, forecasting, suppliers, Procurement and Finance, and you understand how strong operational foundations help teams achieve more.

  • Tech and data curious: You’re interested in how measurement, dashboards, AI and smarter tools can improve PR operations, reporting and decision-making at scale.

  • Calm in the whirlwind: You thrive in fast-paced environments, can prioritise when everything feels important, and enjoy helping teams work more effectively. You’re also comfortable managing and developing others along the way.


What it's like here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

title: Global Senior Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations.

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes.

Your main responsibilities are:

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery.

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites.

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle.

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables.

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact.

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth.

Why do you want this position?

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology.

What do we offer?

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

What we expect from you

Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Role is full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week.

Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year.

The start date is flexible.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost -29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. title: Graduate Customer Care Advisor (Kent)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

  • Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

  • Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

  • Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

  • Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

  • Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

  • Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

  • Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues


What we're looking for

Essential

  • Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

  • The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

  • Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

  • Sound judgement, and the willingness to speak up when a customer isn't getting a good outcome

  • Comfort with digital tools and picking up new technology, including AI-driven platforms

  • Availability to work from our Chatham office three days a week and two weekends a month (where you will work from home)

Nice to have

  • Experience in a contact centre or another customer-facing role, particularly in financial services would be a definite plus but it is not essential for this role.

  • A habit of spotting where a process could work better and suggesting how


Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.Interview process


Our Interview Process

We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Unfortunately, we can’t talk about some of our clients until you join us, but you could be developing the next breakthrough product for brands you use every day.    

What you can bring  

  • You are a high-achieving graduate (or soon-to-be graduate) in a STEM discipline, with a strong academic track record and a genuine interest in software development.

  • You have knowledge of and a willingness to learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies, alongside a genuine enthusiasm for learning and solving interesting problems.

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been continuously resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.

Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. Mach die Dinge hübsch. Mit Verstand. Und mit Power.

Von der Website über Logos bis zum Magazin – und zwischendurch noch ein paar knackige Slides und clevere Social-Media-Post. Du unterstützt und entwickelst: Konzept, Ideen, Text. Du filmst, fotografierst, machst Bildbearbeitung. Und du wendest an: als planen, posten, schalten, auswerten, berichten.

title: GRC Analyst, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.

The Role

Rogo is hiring a GRC Analyst to support our customer trust, security assurance, and compliance programs as we scale globally. This role plays a critical part in how Rogo communicates its security and privacy posture to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

You will work closely with security, engineering, legal, and go-to-market teams to ensure Rogo’s controls, risk posture, and security practices are clearly understood and accurately represented. This is a hands-on role requiring strong written communication, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement across frameworks relevant to the UK, EU, US, and beyond.

What You Will Own

  • Support Rogo’s customer trust and security assurance processes, including responding to customer security inquiries and risk assessments.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for customer security reviews, partnering with internal teams to provide accurate, consistent, and timely responses.

  • Maintain and improve Rogo’s security documentation and response materials, ensuring alignment with current systems and controls.

  • Collaborate with security and engineering teams to understand and articulate technical controls in a customer-facing context.

  • Support compliance initiatives across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, EU AI Act, UK Cyber Essentials, and GDPR, including evidence collection and audit readiness.

  • Identify common themes and gaps surfaced through customer inquiries and contribute to continuous improvement of security and compliance practices.

  • Help streamline and scale trust-related workflows as customer volume and enterprise requirements grow.

What You Will Need

  • Experience supporting customer-facing security, compliance, or trust functions at a SaaS or cloud-native company.

  • Experience translating technical security concepts into clear, concise written responses.

  • An understanding of common enterprise security expectations across areas such as cloud infrastructure, access control, data protection, and incident response.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple parallel requests without sacrificing quality.

  • Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Sound judgment when handling sensitive or ambiguous security questions.

  • Interest in operating at the intersection of security, compliance, and customer engagement.

Bonus:

  • Experience working with security questionnaires, audits, or third-party risk assessments.

  • Exposure to cloud security concepts (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, IAM).

  • Experience improving or scaling trust, GRC, or compliance processes in growing organizations.

  • Prior experience supporting enterprise customers.

  • Comfort engaging with financial services customers on security, risk, and compliance topics.

Who You Are

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup.

  • You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible.

  • You are curious. You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

We zijn continu op zoek naar manieren om onze content beter, creatiever en relevanter te maken. Dat betekent dat we graag experimenteren met formats, inspelen op trends en openstaan voor frisse perspectieven.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een creatieve hbo-opleiding, zoals Communication & Multimedia Design, Creative Business of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Canva;

  • Adobe Creative Cloud;

  • het monteren van short-formcontent;

  • de nieuwste trends op social media.

Je denkt in mogelijkheden en krijgt energie van samenwerken.

Je hebt een ondernemende instelling en komt met innovatieve ideeën.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw creatieve en socialmediaskills verder ontwikkelt in een professionele en informele werkomgeving;

  • leert om complexe statistische informatie te vertalen naar begrijpelijke en toegankelijke content voor een breed publiek;

  • effectief samenwerkt met betrokken collega's in een professioneel team.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.
