title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Rennes) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

 

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :

title: Partner - Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness, London
descriptionHtml:
Associate Partner/Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness
London, UK

About Ekimetrics

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, scalable and lasting impact. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, we are committed to responsibility and frugality in AI, and to staying loyal to our values and DNA.

The opportunity

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

title: People & Admin Ops.
descriptionHtml:
🩺 Why Prévenir

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

  • Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

  • Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

  • People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

  • Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.

👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

  • At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

  • Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

  • Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

  • Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

  • Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

  • Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge.

Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

💡 Overview

As our People Ops Intern, you'll work at the heart of the People team, supporting both People Operations and Talent Acquisition. You'll own real projects end to end, be trusted to bring your own ideas, and see how a fast-scaling international startup actually runs behind the scenes, across HR admin, office life, employer brand, tech events and AI automation.

🧠 What you'll work on:

People Operations & HR admin

  • Support the day-to-day of an international team across France, the US, remote Europe, as well as parts of Asia and Australia: employment contracts, policies, employee benefits, onboarding and offboarding logistics.

  • Become our go-to expert on Deel (our global HR platform): research country-specific rules, maintain workflows and chase down answers.

Office, community & culture

  • Take ownership of our Paris office: visitors, room bookings, day-to-day logistics.

AI & automation

  • Audit our recurring admin processes, identify what can be automated, and build the automations yourself with Claude.

Talent Acquisition & employer brand

  • Help organize tech events in Paris

  • Push the referral policy

  • Support employer brand content and research alongside our Talent acquisition lead.

  • Help with sourcing research when we open new roles or new markets: mapping companies, building talent pools, filtering candidates.

🧩 What we're looking for:

  • 6 months availability, starting January to March 2027

  • Based in Paris, fully comfortable working in English.

  • Thorough and reliable - you follow up, you don't let things slip, and the details matter to you.

  • Autonomous and adaptable. You'll juggle very different topics in the same day and figure things out without a manual.

  • Curious about AI, or already experimenting with it. No technical background needed, but genuine appetite to learn is a must.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

title: Permitting and Regulatory Compliance Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable, and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

You will own Focused Energy's permitting and regulatory pathway across our regulated technical facilities, from early feasibility through construction, commissioning, and handover to Operations. You will build and run the integrated permitting strategy under the direction of the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and act as our primary contact with competent German authorities. Your work will ensure regulatory requirements shape design, procurement, and construction decisions, with a particular focus on the Biblis site transition and the evolving German fusion regulatory framework.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain the integrated permitting strategy, including authority mapping, submission schedules, permit and conditions registers, and regulatory-risk forecasts.

  • Lead coordinated engagement with municipal, district, Hessian state, and federal authorities, aligning submissions and commitments with the approved project strategy.

  • Own permitting coordination for the Biblis nuclear-site transition, including RWE decommissioning interfaces, existing licences, radiation-protection arrangements, and handover evidence.

  • Coordinate application readiness with Engineering, architects, fire-safety and structural specialists, and the Prüfstatiker, and track reviews to closure.

  • Monitor the German fusion legal framework and translate permit conditions and regulatory changes into project requirements, schedules, and risk responses.

  • Escalate material risks and options to the Senior Project Manager / Programme Director, and hand ongoing permit obligations to Operations.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Strong experience in German construction and public permitting, including building applications, authority consultations, and partial approvals.

  • Working knowledge of Hessian procedures and the Hessische Bauordnung.

  • Working knowledge of radiation-protection licensing and nuclear-site interfaces.

  • Experience coordinating fire-safety and structural-checking processes with specialists and consultants.

  • Ability to explain regulatory risk and options clearly to non-specialists, including project managers and agency counterparts.

  • Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.

title: Pflichtpraktikant Content & Digital PR (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir wachsen an jedem Auftrag und gestalten die sich stetig wandelnde Welt des Online Marketings mit. Auf Augenhöhe mit den Möglichkeiten der Zeit zu sein, ist unser Anspruch und unser Versprechen.

digitalagenten wächst, deshalb suchen wir Dich! Wir sind spezialisiert auf digitales Marketing. In unserem Büro in Berlin Charlottenburg arbeitet ein starkes Team von 25 Kollegen und Kolleginnen in den Bereichen Content Strategie, SEO, SEA, Social Media Management, Redaktion, Frontend-Entwicklung und Projektmanagement. Seit 2013 surfen wir die Online Marketing Welle und behaupten uns mit Kompetenz und Zuverlässigkeit am Markt. Dies mündete bereits oft in spannenden wie wegweisenden Partnerschaften mit nationalen und internationalen Kunden aus Branchen wie E-Commerce, Automotive oder Finanzen. Unser Portfolio reicht von der strategischen Beratung, Konzeption und Planung von Web-Projekten über die Programmierung von Webauftritten sowie Shops bis hin zur Umsetzung von Werbekampagnen.

Das Praktikum ist ab Dezember 2026 in Vollzeit im Rahmen eines Studiums als Pflichtpraktikum möglich. Wünschenswert wäre eine Laufzeit von bis zu 6 Monaten. Gerne kannst du uns auch deine Bewerbung für ein späteres Startdatum zusenden. Anschließend besteht ggf. die Möglichkeit eines Traineeship, einer WerkstudentInnen- oder einer projektbezogenen Weiterbeschäftigung.

Aufgaben

  • Du wirst ein wichtiger Teil unseres Teams und hilfst dabei, unsere Inhalte für verschiedene Kanäle zu gestalten und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Du erstellst, redigierst und optimierst Inhalte für unsere Websites, Blogs und Social-Media-Kanäle.
  • Du unterstützt bei der strategischen Planung von Content-Marketing-Maßnahmen und entwickelst Content-Pläne.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Inhalte nicht nur qualitativ hochwertig sind, sondern auch den technischen und SEO-Anforderungen entsprechen.
  • Du überwachst und analysierst die Performance von Inhalten (z. B. Reichweiten, Interaktionen, Conversions) und erstellst regelmäßige Reports.
  • Du recherchierst relevante Publisher, Blogs, Fachportale und Kooperationspartner für Offsite-SEO- und Content-Marketing-Maßnahmen.
  • Du analysierst Backlinkprofile und Wettbewerber im Offsite-Bereich und leitest Potenziale für unsere Kunden ab.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem SEO-Team kreative Content-Ideen, die sich für Digital PR, Linkbuilding und Content-Seeding eignen.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) in einem relevanten Studiengang, wie z. B. Kommunikationswissenschaften, Medienmanagement, Marketing oder ähnliche Fachrichtungen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling und Zielgruppenansprache und bringst idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Content mit.
  • Du interessierst dich für digitale Medien, Social Media und Content-Strategien.
  • Du hast erste Kenntnisse in SEO und Web-Analytics-Tools (z. B. Google Analytics, Google Search Console) oder bist bereit, dich schnell in diese Tools einzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast eine analytische Denkweise und Freude daran, Daten zu analysieren und daraus Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung abzuleiten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und bist in der Lage, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu managen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind ein Muss.

Benefits

  • Ein spannendes und abwechslungsreiches Praktikum in einem dynamischen Team.
  • Die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Content, SEO und digitale Medien zu sammeln.
  • Einblicke in die Arbeit mit modernen Content-Management-Systemen und digitalen Marketing-Tools.
  • Eine flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und die Möglichkeit, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten.
  • Ein offenes, kreatives Arbeitsumfeld und die Chance, eigene Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen.

Ready to go?

Wenn du bereit bist, deine Kreativität und dein Können in einem professionellen Umfeld unter Beweis zu stellen, dann schnapp dir deinen Lebenslauf und – falls vorhanden – ein paar Arbeitsproben. title: Pflichtpraktikum Social Media (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
ÜBER UNS

HR Weekly ist der Video-Podcast für alle, die im Job und als Mensch wachsen wollen. Jede Woche spricht unsere Gründerin und Host Katharina mit Gäst:innen über Karriere, Leadership und Selbstmanagement. Wir gehören zu beyobie in Berlin.

Du schneidest lieber zehn Reels und testest, was am besten performt, als an einem einzigen zu feilen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

In deinem Pflichtpraktikum machst du aus unseren Folgen Reels, TikToks und YouTube Shorts. So entdecken neue Menschen unseren Podcast. Das ist ein Job mit hohem Takt und viel Routine. Dafür wird dein Gespür für Hooks und Schnitt jeden Tag schärfer.

DEINE AUFGABEN

• Du schneidest aus unseren Podcast-Folgen Reels, TikToks und YouTube Shorts.

• Du testest neue Reels auf Instagram und wertest aus, was ankommt.

• Du bringst die stärksten Clips auf alle Kanäle.

• Du baust unseren TikTok-Account von null auf.

• Du schickst uns einmal pro Woche ein kurzes Update, was gut lief.

So startest du:

• Woche 1: Du gehst mit uns eine ganze Folge durch, lernst die Tools kennen und postest erste Test-Reels.

• Ab Monat 1: Du schneidest und postest eigenständig.

• Danach: Du startest unseren TikTok-Account.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

• Du bist eingeschrieben, und ein Praktikum ist in deiner Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung vorgeschrieben.

• Du schneidest Short-Form sicher, am Handy oder am Desktop.

• Du bist selbst viel auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube Shorts unterwegs.

• Du spürst, was in den ersten zwei Sekunden zieht.

• Du schaust gern auf Zahlen und lernst daraus.

• Du arbeitest gern in Routinen und hältst deinen Takt selbst.

• Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch, auch in Untertiteln.

Pluspunkte, kein Muss:

• Erfahrung mit Opus Clip, Edits, CapCut oder Premiere

• Du hast schon einen Account aufgebaut oder betreut, gern auch privat.

• Routine mit ChatGPT oder ähnlichen Tools

• Interesse an Arbeitswelt, Karriere und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung

Bewirb dich auch, wenn du nicht alles mitbringst. Die Tools lernst du bei uns in einer Woche.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

• Vergütung: 560 € im Monat

• Eigene Verantwortung für Reels, Shorts und den TikTok-Start

• Deine eigenen Zahlen: Du siehst sofort, was funktioniert.

• Direktes Feedback von Katharina

• Einblick in Studio und Podcast-Produktion

• Benefits über P:xtra, zum Beispiel Urban Sports Club

• Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage im Office in Berlin

DIE ECKDATEN

• Pflichtpraktikum im Studium

• Dauer: 6 Monate

• Arbeitszeit: 20 Stunden pro Woche

• Start: Dezember oder Januar

• Bewerbungsfrist: 19.11.2026

SO BEWIRBST DU DICH

Kein Anschreiben, kein Lebenslauf nötig. Schneid ein kurzes Reel über dich, 30 bis 60 Sekunden: Wer bist du, und warum passt das Praktikum zu dir? Handy reicht.

Füg den Link zu deinem Reel im Bewerbungsformular ein. Wir schauen uns jedes Reel an und melden uns bei dir.

title: Photonics Layout Lead
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Photonics Layout Lead to join our Photonics team and lead our Layout team, taking technical and people leadership of the physical design, verification and development of advanced integrated photonic devices.

You will work closely with engineers across photonic design, layout and testing, setting the direction for how device and circuit requirements are translated into robust, fabrication-ready layouts. The role combines hands-on physical layout, design verification, programming and ownership of our internal design workflows, along with leading, developing and managing the layout engineers on your team and raising the standard of layout work across the company.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of integrated photonics, semiconductor design and software. You should be comfortable leading the resolution of complex layout challenges, interpreting and challenging design requirements, and using programming to improve the speed, quality and repeatability of engineering work, while building a team that can do the same.

We are particularly interested in people who have led or significantly shaped integrated photonics or semiconductor IC layout work, and who have experience leading engineers, whether in industry, research or a strong academic environment.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the Layout team, setting priorities, allocating work and ensuring the team delivers high-quality, on-time results

  • Line manage layout engineers, including coaching, performance reviews, career development and objective setting

  • Support hiring and onboarding of new layout engineers as the team grows

  • Lead the development of physical layouts for integrated photonic components, structures and large-scale photonic designs

  • Translate photonic device and circuit requirements into fabrication-ready layouts, and help shape those requirements with the photonic design team

  • Own design verification, including DRC and LVS, and drive designs through the full layout and verification process to tape-out

  • Define, develop and improve software-based workflows for photonic layout and design automation

  • Use Python and relevant semiconductor or photonic design tools to create, manipulate and verify layouts, and set best practice for the team to do the same

  • Own and evolve our internal component and design libraries

  • Define and support the development of appropriate test and characterisation structures

  • Lead layout reviews for design integrity, fabrication constraints and potential sources of failure

  • Act as a technical point of contact for foundry and fabrication partners on design rules, process constraints and verification issues

  • Plan and prioritise layout work across projects, balancing schedule, quality, risk and team capacity

  • Collaborate closely with photonic design, testing and wider engineering teams, and represent the Layout team in planning and design discussions

  • Drive improvements in layout methodology, tooling and verification processes

  • Make photonic design workflows increasingly repeatable, reliable and efficient

You will own the Layout team’s technical direction and delivery, from individual components through to complex, full-chip integrated photonic designs and their verification.

What we’re looking for

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or another closely related technical discipline

  • Typically 6+ years of relevant experience in integrated photonics, photonic IC layout, semiconductor IC layout or design verification, including experience leading or owning layout work on complete designs

  • Experience leading, managing or mentoring engineers, and a track record of developing people and building effective teams

  • Extensive hands-on experience creating physical IC or photonic layouts using Python or other layout and EDA software

  • Strong programming capability, ideally in Python or another relevant language, with experience building and maintaining layout automation

  • The ability to explain and discuss software or coding projects you have worked on in detail

  • A strong understanding of integrated photonics or the broader semiconductor IC industry

  • Working knowledge of photonic IC design and fabrication flows, including experience taking designs through tape-out

  • A deep understanding of how physical layout decisions interact with device design, fabrication and performance

  • Experience with DRC and LVS verification, and with resolving complex verification issues

  • Experience planning and prioritising work across multiple projects and engineers

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively and influence across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Strong critical thinking and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing layouts and resolving verification issues

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Candidates with particularly strong academic, research or project experience may also be considered where they can demonstrate the required practical capability and leadership.

Even better if you

  • Have a Master’s degree or PhD in integrated photonics, photonics, electrical engineering, physics or a related discipline

  • Have led Python-based layout automation or framework development

  • Have experience with photonic or semiconductor EDA tools

  • Are familiar with common integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Have knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and fabrication technologies

  • Have developed or maintained component or PDK libraries

  • Have been involved in multiple photonic or semiconductor design cycles

  • Have experience working within a commercial product development environment

  • Have a background in photonic device design or semiconductor process development

  • Have experience building or scaling a layout team or function, including hiring

Relevant backgrounds could include integrated photonics design and layout teams, silicon photonics research groups, university or research institute environments, or semiconductor IC layout and verification teams.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across photonics, semiconductor engineering and software, with meaningful ownership over the quality and effectiveness of physical design. You will join a highly collaborative engineering environment where you can shape not just individual designs, but also the methods, tools, processes and people behind our advanced photonic hardware.

The role is based in the UK on a hybrid basis, with four days per week on site and one day working from home.

title: Platform Engineer Open Source (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Du baust lieber mit Open Source als mit Lizenzschlüsseln und automatisierst alles, was dir in die Finger kommt?

Dann bist du bei uns richtig! Wir suchen einen Platform Engineer, der Lust auf langfristige Kundenprojekte hat und Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen baut – von Linux und Automatisierung über CI/CD bis zu Containern, egal ob in der Public Cloud, im Rechenzentrum des Kunden oder irgendwo dazwischen. Kurz: einen Generalisten für den ganzen Stack, der auch mal eine gewachsene Anwendung kubernetifiziert.

Wir bei cloudpunks glauben daran, dass wir den Unterschied machen können! Wir konzipieren, implementieren und betreiben Plattform- und Cloud-Lösungen – als Kubernetes Certified Service Provider (KCSP) und CNCF Silver Member.

Du bist Teil unseres Teams und stehst im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kunden & Partnern. In gemeinsamen Projekten modernisieren wir Anwendungen, bauen Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen und sorgen dafür, dass alles automatisiert ausgebracht und betrieben wird. Wir wollen geile Projekte umsetzen – mit cooler Technologie, die dem Kunden wirklich hilft!

Deine Aufgaben!

Das machst du bei uns:

  • Anwendungen kubernetifizieren: Du nimmst Bestandsanwendungen auseinander, schreibst Dockerfiles und Helm Charts und bringst sie sauber auf Kubernetes – von der Java-Monolithen-Altlast bis zum frischen Microservice.

  • Plattformen aus Open-Source-Bausteinen: Aufbau von Kubernetes-Plattformen mit dem, was das CNCF-Ökosystem hergibt: Ingress-Controller, cert-manager, Harbor als Registry, Keycloak für Identity, Vault oder OpenBao für Secrets. Cloud-agnostisch, On-Premises oder hybrid.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform bzw. OpenTofu, Ansible, Helm und Kustomize – du automatisierst alles, was automatisiert werden kann, und gießt jede Komponente in versionierten Code.

  • CI/CD & GitOps: Aufbau und Optimierung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions. GitOps-Workflows mit ArgoCD oder Flux.

  • Security & Policies: Policies mit Kyverno oder OPA/Gatekeeper, Image-Scanning mit Trivy, Runtime-Security mit Falco. Du baust sichere Baselines ab Tag 1.

  • Observability: Aufbau von Monitoring-Stacks mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki und OpenTelemetry – du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden wissen, was auf ihrer Plattform passiert. Mit OpenCost auch, was sie kostet.

  • Backup, Recovery & Lifecycle: Backup- und Restore-Konzepte mit Velero, Cluster- und Komponenten-Upgrades, Lifecycle-Management. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Plattform nicht nur läuft, sondern auch wiederherstellbar und wartbar bleibt – als Code, nicht per Klick.

  • Kundenberatung & Befähigung: Du arbeitest embedded in Kundenteams, nimmst an Standups teil und befähigst Teams, ihre Plattform selbstständig zu betreiben.

Projektbeispiele aus unserem Alltag:

  • Containerisierung gewachsener Java-Anwendungen und Umzug auf Kubernetes für ein Finanzunternehmen

  • On-Premises-Kubernetes-Plattform mit Harbor, Keycloak und ArgoCD für ein Industrieunternehmen

  • Migration von VM-basierten Workloads auf Kubernetes mit Helm und GitLab CI für ein E-Commerce-Unternehmen

  • Secrets-Management mit Vault und Policy-as-Code mit Kyverno für ein Versicherungsunternehmen

  • Observability-Stack mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki und OpenTelemetry für ein Healthcare-Unternehmen

  • Backup- und Restore-Konzept mit Velero für ein Logistikunternehmen



Dein Profil

Must-have (ohne das wird's schwer):

  • Linux & Container: Solide Linux-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Docker bzw. Containern – du weißt, was im Container passiert und warum.

  • Kubernetes: Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, egal ob Vanilla, in der Cloud oder On-Premises.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Erfahrung mit Terraform/OpenTofu oder Ansible sowie Helm und/oder Kustomize.

  • CI/CD: Erfahrung mit mindestens einem CI/CD-Tool (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) für automatisierte Deployments.

  • Networking: Verständnis von DNS, TLS, Load Balancing und Container-Networking.

Nice-to-have (macht dich noch interessanter):

  • GitOps: Erfahrung mit ArgoCD oder Flux.

  • Security: Erfahrung mit Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, Trivy, Falco oder Vault.

  • Observability: Erfahrung mit Prometheus, Grafana, Loki oder OpenTelemetry.

  • Identity & Registry: Erfahrung mit Keycloak und Harbor.

  • Cloud-Provider: Erste Erfahrung mit AWS oder Azure schadet nicht – ist aber kein Muss.

  • Zertifizierungen: CKA, CKAD, CKS, LFCS oder andere CNCF-Zertifizierungen.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Kommunikation: Du kannst technische Konzepte verständlich erklären – auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Arbeit.

  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne embedded in Kundenteams und bist ein Teamplayer.

  • Lernbereitschaft: Du bleibst am Ball und lernst kontinuierlich neue Technologien.

title: Praktikum: Founder's Associate
descriptionHtml:
Über die Stelle

Kein Bock auf einen Job in einem Unternehmen, das es wegen KI in einem Jahr eh nicht mehr gibt? Was es dann noch geben wird: geile Snacks. Die ersetzt dir keine KI.

Genau daran arbeiten wir. SNACKL ist der herzhafte Proteinsnack, mit dem wir Deutschland eine neue Snack-Kultur geben wollen. Unterstützt werden wir von dem besten Food-VC Deutschlands, und sind auf steilem Wachstumskurs.

Bei uns verschwindest du nicht in einer Abteilung, sondern sitzt direkt neben den Gründern und siehst, wie ein Food-Startup von innen funktioniert. Als Founder’s Associate bist du unser Generalist: Du springst dorthin, wo es gerade brennt, und übernimmst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, egal ob Website, Marketing, Operations oder Finance. Heute baust du eine neue Landingpage, morgen vibe-codest du eine App für unsere internen Prozesse, übermorgen schreibst du Skripte für Meta-Ads und darfst beim Dreh selbst mit vor der Kamera (Wenn du es möchtest).

Wir suchen keinen Spezialisten, sondern jemanden, der Probleme löst, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge zu Ende bringt.

Womit du Wirkung erzielt

  • Website & Tech: Du baust und optimierst unseren Shopify-Shop mit, setzt neue Seiten und Features um und scheust dich nicht vor ein bisschen Code, auch mit Hilfe von KI.
  • Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du findest Abläufe, die noch manuell laufen, und baust sie smarter auf, von internen Tools bis zu automatisierten Workflows.
  • Wachstum & neue Kanäle: Du findest heraus, wo SNACKL als Nächstes hin sollte, rechnest es durch und bringst es an den Start.
  • Operations & Logistik: Du behältst Bestände, Nachbestellungen und Fulfillment im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Snacks zuverlässig bei Kunden und Partnern ankommen.
  • Finance & Analyse: Du unterstützt bei Reportings, Kalkulationen und Auswertungen und lernst, Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen zu treffen.
  • Founder Projects: Du übernimmst strategische Sonderprojekte direkt mit dem Gründerteam, von Events bis zur Vorbereitung neuer Vertriebskanäle.

Dein Profil

  • Generalist: Du hast Lust auf viele Themen gleichzeitig und arbeitest dich schnell in Neues ein, ob Excel-Modell, Shopify-Theme oder Content-Konzept.
  • KI-affin: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT nicht nur für Texte, sondern um echte Arbeit schneller und besser zu erledigen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Vibe Coding, Automatisierung oder bauen eigener Apps sind ein großes Plus.
  • Strukturiert: Du schaffst Ordnung im Chaos, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei mehreren Baustellen den Überblick.
  • Zahlenverständnis: Du hast keine Angst vor Zahlen und verstehst, was hinter einer Marge oder einer Conversion Rate steckt.
  • Echte Motivation: Du hast den Drive, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, und willst in einem Early-Stage Startup wirklich etwas bewegen.

Das passt zu dir, wenn...

  • ... du lieber viele verschiedene Dinge machst, als dich auf eine Aufgabe zu beschränken.
  • ... du Verantwortung suchst und auch in der „Startup-Chaos-Phase“ selbst Struktur schaffst.
  • ... du lieber schnell umsetzt und testest, als monatelang am „perfekten“ Konzept zu feilen.
  • ... du dir vorstellen kannst, später selbst zu gründen, und dir genau das aus nächster Nähe anschauen willst.

Das passt eher nicht, wenn...

  • ... du klare 9-to-5-Strukturen und ein fertiges Handbuch für jede Aufgabe brauchst.
  • ... du dich auf ein Fachgebiet spezialisieren willst und keine Lust auf Abwechslung hast.
  • ... dir Aufgaben „unter deinem Niveau“ zu schade sind, denn bei uns packt jeder überall mit an.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Output over Presence: Wir entscheiden nach Ergebnissen. Wir halten Hierarchien flach, Meetings kurz und das Tempo hoch.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst Einblick in wirklich alle Bereiche eines Early-Stage Food Startups, von Produktion über Marketing bis Finanzierung, und lernst direkt vom Gründerteam.
  • AI-first Arbeiten: Du lernst, wie man mit modernen KI-Tools in kurzer Zeit Websites, Apps, Prozesse und Kampagnen baut, ein Skill, der dir überall Türen öffnet.
  • Community & Spirit: Du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das den Snack-Markt nachhaltig verändern wird.

Rahmenbedingungen

Ort: Berlin (Hybrid möglich)

Anstellungsart: Praktikum (Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum, Teil- oder Vollzeit, idealerweise 3–6 Monate)

Start: Ab sofort / nach Absprache

title: Principal Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Application Modernization Platform (“AMP”) is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer’s legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.  

AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.

AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.

Work as a software developer in an Agile environment delivering solutions for customers focused on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. During each project, successful candidates will be required to innovate on potential new GenAI-based solutions for specific challenges in addition to applying existing playbooks and tooling for migration.

This role will be based remotely in France.

Position Expectations

  • Shape architecture and technology strategy across AMP modernization projects and workstreams, making complex technical decisions with limited supervision and connecting engineering choices to customer and business outcomes
  • Lead the assessment and modernization of legacy Java applications by uncovering dependencies, embedded business logic, integration points, and operational constraints; recommend fit-for-purpose modernization paths rather than defaulting to lift-and-shift
  • Design, implement, and review production-quality solutions using Java and Spring Boot, including APIs, integrations, monolith decomposition, relational-to-document data modeling, stored-procedure transformation, schema evolution, and MongoDB operational practices
  • Establish safe, incremental delivery practices through explicit acceptance criteria, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and rollback, dual-run, or other risk-control strategies; identify quality, security, performance, and reliability risks and guide teams to resolve them
  • Serve as a senior technical partner to customers, application owners, and account and project stakeholders by explaining complex topics clearly, aligning priorities, navigating disagreement, communicating trade-offs, and maintaining trust through high-risk change
  • Multiply the effectiveness of engineers by mentoring, raising engineering standards, creating reusable migration playbooks and documentation, applying GenAI advancements responsibly where valuable, and influencing project direction without relying on formal authority

Requirements

  • Professional fluency in French is required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically 8+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and delivering Java applications, including significant experience leading complex application modernization initiatives
  • Expert understanding of Java fundamentals, object-oriented design, concurrency, error handling, performance considerations, and maintainable software architecture; able to review code and guide design decisions across teams
  • Deep production experience with Spring Boot and related patterns for building resilient services, APIs, integrations, and testable distributed applications
  • Demonstrated ability to assess legacy estates, decompose monoliths, uncover dependencies and embedded business logic, and define practical modernization strategies with clear trade-offs
  • Strong experience with relational databases and SQL, including stored procedures, data dependencies, data migration, schema evolution, and relational-to-document modeling for MongoDB or comparable document databases
  • Proven history of delivering high-cadence modern applications using Agile methodologies, test-first development, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, observability, and reliability practices; demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical outcomes across teams

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience in building REST APIs with Spring Boot
  • Experience in performance and memory optimization of JAVA applications
  • Familiarity with tools like Postman, IntelliJ IDEA, and Maven/Gradle
  • Exposure to other languages or technologies like JavaScript, .Net
  • Understanding of ORM tools like Hibernate, Spring Data  or JPA (even through coursework or self-study)
  • Experience in nascent GenAI technologies and approaches, such as using OpenAI/Anthropic API not purely through chat interfaces
  • Experience with AI-powered development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar code assistants
  • Good experience of using MongoDB

Successful candidates will engage with customer systems and may be exposed to highly confidential customer data, including but not limited to non-public information. For this reason, and due to the nature of the highly regulated industry in which our customers operate, successful candidates may be subject to enhanced background checks, security screenings, and possible constraints around the trading of securities. Successful candidates will understand these requirements and be willing to participate in enhanced screenings and constraints as required by MongoDB and its customers in connection with this role. 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Principal Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner.

You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model.

Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams.

What You'll Do

Risk & Governance

  • Map Vibe's risk model across every major system.

  • Set the security roadmap with clear priorities.

Security Engineering

  • Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set.

  • Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one.

  • Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers.

  • Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you.

Detection & Response

  • Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure.

  • Own security incident response from detection through resolution.

  • Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own.

  • Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program.

Trust & Compliance

  • Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification.

  • Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements.

  • Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you.

Security Culture

  • Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day.

  • Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar.

What You Need

  • Built a security function as a company's first security hire.

  • Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience.

  • Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

  • Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day.

Nice to Haves

  • Ran a private bug bounty program.

  • Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment.

  • Navigated security through a company acquisition.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €127,000-€171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, technical background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Assessment — 90 minutes. A deeper technical conversation covering core engineering skills, problem-solving, and a technical use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.
