title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Mindset

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé.

La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif, en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable.

C’est là qu’intervient l’AI Product Ops.

Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux.

Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter.

Le job

En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA.

Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle.

Tu es à la fois :

  • un profil hands-on, capable de builder pour montrer l’exemple ;

  • un profil ops, capable de simplifier et fiabiliser les workflows ;

  • un profil change, capable d’embarquer les équipes dans de nouvelles pratiques ;

Concrètement, dans le cadre de tes missions, tu seras amené·e à

  • Auditer les processus de discovery, delivery et go-to-market pour identifier les frictions, les tâches à faible valeur, les dépendances inutiles et les opportunités de délégation à l’IA.

  • Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

  • Designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, en clarifiant les rôles, les responsabilités, les points de contrôle et les conditions de réussite.

  • Mettre en place les outils, standards et rituels nécessaires à une exécution plus fluide : documentation, pilotage, reporting, coordination, partage de connaissance, qualité d’exécution.

  • Builder toi-même des skills, assistants, automatisations ou agents simples adaptés au contexte client, pour outiller des usages concrets et immédiats.

  • Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible.

  • Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail.

  • Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être.

  • Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

  • des workflows de discovery et de delivery revus, simplifiés et mieux maîtrisés ;

  • des usages IA prioritaires cadrés, outillés et réellement adoptés ;

  • plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ;

  • une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ;

  • une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective.

  • la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ;

Ce que ce rôle n’est pas

Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire :

  • du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ;

  • du portfolio management ;

  • de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;

  • de l’industrialisation technique à grande échelle ;

L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’efficience organisationnelle, du build, et de la conduite du changement.

Qui es-tu ?

Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience, avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

Tu es probablement :

  • un·e coach agile aguerri au passé de dev, ayant une approche hands-on

  • un·e Product Ops senior ;

  • ou un·e Product Manager avec une très forte fibre ops ;

Et surtout :

  • Tu as déjà travaillé au sein d’équipes produit, au plus près du delivery et de la réalité terrain.

  • Tu sais analyser un flux de valeur de développement, repérer les goulots d’étranglement, et transformer une friction en dispositif concret.

  • Tu utilises déjà l’IA au quotidien dans ta pratique professionnelle (claude code, cursor, …).

  • Tu sais tirer parti de copilotes, assistants, outils d’automatisation, outils de documentation augmentée et solutions d’orchestration légère.

  • Tu es capable de builder toi-même des agents ou assistants simples, sans prétendre être la personne qui les industrialisera techniquement à grande échelle.

  • Tu sais passer de l’idée à l’outil, puis de l’outil à l’adoption.

  • Tu es à l’aise aussi bien avec des équipes opérationnelles qu’avec des interlocuteurs de direction.

  • Tu as suffisamment de culture produit pour ne pas confondre vitesse et valeur.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment.

Ton savoir-être

  • Tu es énergique, pragmatique et orienté impact.

  • Tu aimes autant transformer un mode de fonctionnement que mettre les mains dans les outils.

  • Tu sais embarquer sans évangéliser dans le vide.

  • Tu as une posture de partenaire exigeant : direct, utile, crédible.

  • Tu navigues bien entre technique, produit, organisation et business.

  • Tu sais faire avancer un sujet même quand tout n’est pas encore cadré.

Et en interne, au sein de Thiga

  • Tu interviens comme consultant·e en mission, au plus près des enjeux clients.

  • Tu contribues au développement de l’offre AI Product Ops / POM-AI avec le référent de l’offre.

  • Tu participes à la production de contenu, à la capitalisation, au partage interne et à certaines démarches d’avant-vente.

  • Tu contribues à faire monter Thiga en niveau sur les nouvelles pratiques d’organisation produit à l’ère de l’IA.

Les étapes 🎢
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.
  • Une rencontre avec un des Directeurs de la Tribe Conseil
  • Une étude de cas afin de confirmer ce que vous savez mettre en pratique.
  • Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝
Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an!

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.
  • Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.
  • Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.
  • Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.
  • Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.
  • Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.
  • Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.
  • Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.
  • Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.
  • Du bewertest Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und leitest daraus fundierte Prioritäten und Entscheidungen ab.

title: Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Role Overview 🔎

We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own the security of Orbital's product: the AI agent our customers use, the platform it runs on, and how we build both.

Our customers are law firms and real estate businesses. They trust us with confidential transaction documents, and they ask hard questions about how we protect them. Our product is an AI agent that reads those documents, calls tools and runs code on a lawyer's behalf. That brings the usual cloud security work and a newer set of risks: prompt injection, agents acting on untrusted input, and attackers using AI to move faster than before.

You'll be our first in-house product security engineer, taking on work we have so far relied on contractors for. You'll build security into the product rather than review it from outside: you'll decide how we rate a vulnerability and how fast we act on it, build the automated systems that find and fix issues before an attacker does, and set the security bar that engineering builds to. You'll work alongside our product engineers, with the authority to require changes across teams on security grounds, independent of any one team's delivery deadlines. An information security lead will own company-wide policy, compliance and customer assurance, and you'll work closely with them.

You won't start from zero. Our AWS environment follows the Well-Architected Framework, with GuardDuty, Security Hub, encryption at rest and scoped credentials in place, and we hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments to our customers. What we need is someone to own it, find the gaps, and raise the standard as the company and the threat landscape grow.

You'll get a chance to 👩‍💻 👨‍💻

  • Build an automated security harness. Put agents to work on our product: continuous red-team and blue-team loops that probe the agent, the platform and our code, find vulnerabilities, and propose or ship the fix. Manual review should be justified when required and automatic harness improvement is expected.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end. Define how we classify severity and the response time each level demands, so a critical CVE gets fixed the same day. Automate patching, dependency and image scanning, and make sure findings reach an owner and get closed.

  • Secure an AI agent in production. Threat-model how our agent handles untrusted documents, emails and web content, and the tools and sandboxes it uses. Design defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and test them.

  • Make security part of how we build. Review designs and changes that touch authentication, tenant isolation, secrets and data handling. Turn recurring findings into automated checks so the protection holds without depending on someone remembering.

  • Respond to security incidents. Lead the technical response when something goes wrong: containment, investigation and the fix. Build the technical side of our breach playbooks with our information security lead, and run the review afterwards.

  • Choose and run our security tooling. Evaluate and roll out a cloud security platform (such as Wiz) and the detection, alerting and logging we need across AWS and Azure. As our only product security specialist, use tooling and AI agents to cover more ground than one person could alone.

  • Test our defences. Run red-team exercises, manage external penetration testers, and run breach drills with engineering so everyone knows their part before it matters.

  • Close the loop on findings. Fix what penetration tests and security researchers report to us, run responsible disclosure, and keep the technical evidence for our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls current, working with our information security lead.

  • Make the work visible. Show leadership and engineering what the harness finds, what has been fixed and what risk remains, in plain language, with a recommendation for each open risk.

You should apply if you ✍️

  • You build with agents. You'd rather put an agent loop on a problem than repeat a manual review. You've used AI agents to find, triage or fix security issues, and you aim for automation that leaves people to review only the exceptions.

  • You have deep, hands-on security engineering experience. You've owned security for a cloud-native product or platform and can do the work yourself, from reading code and IAM policies to configuring detection and running an investigation.

  • You know AWS security well. IAM, network design, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail and how they fit together in a real production environment.

  • You've led incident response. You've run a real security incident, including containment, investigation, communication and the follow-up, and you stay clear-headed under pressure.

  • You take application and AI security seriously. You understand OWASP-class vulnerabilities, and you're interested in the new risks that come with LLM agents, such as prompt injection and over-broad tool access.

  • You understand the product and the business. You know why a finding matters to our customers and our commercial position. You can tell a theoretical finding from one that puts customer data at risk, you spend effort where the risk is real, and you don't disappear down technical rabbit holes.

  • You help teams ship safely. You find the secure way to do what the team needs, and you block work only when the risk justifies it. When you do, you explain why clearly enough that engineers understand and agree.

  • You work independently. As our first in-house product security engineer, you'll set your own priorities, build the programme, and know when to bring in outside help.

  • You bring people with you. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, a lawyer and a board member, adjusting the detail for each, and you change how teams work through influence rather than authority.

You'll most likely come from a security engineering, product security or application security role at a fast-growing startup, or from a security consultancy with hands-on delivery. We're open to different backgrounds if you can show the depth, judgement and automation-first approach this role needs.

It would also be nice if you have

  • Experience securing LLM or agentic AI applications, or research into prompt injection and AI-specific threats.

  • Harness engineering experience: building the tooling, evaluation loops and guardrails that let AI agents do real engineering work.

  • Hands-on experience with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.

  • Experience with Azure, Kubernetes or container security, or sandboxed code execution.

  • Familiarity with identity and SSO providers such as WorkOS or Okta.

  • Experience in legal, financial or other regulated industries.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Projekt & Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Die Position bietet langfristig die Möglichkeit, sich zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Bereich Operations weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Entscheidungswege und enger Austausch mit dem Geschäftsführer.

  • Technologieumfeld: Arbeite an innovativen Drohnensystemen und autonomen Technologien mit anspruchsvollen Anwendungen.

  • Unternehmenskultur: Flache Strukturen, offene Kommunikation und ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Technikaffinität.

  • Mobiles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist nach Absprache möglich, sofern es die jeweiligen Aufgaben und die operative Situation erlauben.

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Ausstattung mit aktueller Hard und Software sowie kurze Wege zwischen Entwicklung, Produktion und Projektmanagement.

  • Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander.

  • Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Projekt & Operations Managerübernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte, Ressourcen und interne Abläufe zuverlässig ineinandergreifen.

  • Operative Steuerung: Koordination des täglichen Geschäftsbetriebs über die Bereiche Werkstatt, Produktion, Entwicklung, Projektkoordination, Beschaffung und Flugbetrieb hinweg.

  • Projektkoordination: Steuerung mehrerer paralleler Entwicklungs-, Liefer- und Forschungsprojekte hinsichtlich Terminen, Ressourcen, Qualität und Budgets.

  • Priorisierung: Wöchentliche Abstimmung der Projektprioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourcen sowie eigenständige Lösung entstehender Konflikte.

  • Produktion: Koordination von Produktion, Ausgangsprüfung und Auslieferung der Drohnensysteme.

  • Prozesse: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter operativer Abläufe in Bereichen wie Projektplanung, Aufgabensteuerung, Einkauf, Lager und Qualitätsmanagement.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen aus Entwicklung, Produktion, Projektmanagement und weiteren internen Bereichen.

  • Projektmanagement: Unterstützung und Koordination bei Kundenprojekten, Lieferungen, Abnahmen und weiteren operativen Vorhaben.

  • Compliance: Koordination relevanter Themen rund um Exportkontrolle, Zoll und erforderliche Dokumentationen.

  • Geschäftsführung: Entlastung des Geschäftsführers im operativen Tagesgeschäft, damit dieser sich stärker auf Strategie, Technologie und Schlüsselkunden konzentrieren kann.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Vorantreiben von Maßnahmen zur Skalierung und Automatisierung der operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil als Projekt & Operations Manager

  • Ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten, die Entwicklung und Fertigung verbinden, idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit eigener Produktion.

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Rolle mit Führungsbezug oder der Steuerung von Teams und Projekten.

  • Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer paralleler Projekte sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Termine, Ressourcen, Budgets und Prioritäten.

  • Technisches Verständnis für mechatronische Systeme und die Fähigkeit, sich auf Augenhöhe mit Konstruktion, Elektronik und Software auszutauschen.

  • Eine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen ohne lange Abstimmungswege voranzutreiben.

  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und die Bereitschaft, in einem kleinen Unternehmen ohne große Stabstrukturen selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort sowie gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kunden, Testkampagnen, Übungen und Messen. Diese Einsätze halten sich in der Regel in Grenzen und finden maximal etwa einmal pro Monat statt.

Nice to have

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Drohnen oder unbemannte Systeme.

  • Erfahrung mit Exportkontrolle, BAFA oder Zoll.

  • Erfahrung mit Kleinserienfertigung.

  • Kenntnisse in Jira oder vergleichbaren Projektmanagementsystemen.

  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis für Kalkulation, Projektcontrolling oder Liquiditätsplanung.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem Wachstumsunternehmen oder Start-Up.

  • Projektmanagement Zertifizierung wie PMP, IPMA oder PRINCE2.

Deine Perspektive als Projekt & Operations Manager

Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, sich langfristig zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen, hast einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und kannst die operativen Strukturen maßgeblich mitgestalten.

title: Creator Marketing Manager:in (Performance) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind fravio, die Community-Centric Agency aus Köln. Wir bringen Marken und Menschen zusammen: mit Creator- und Influencer-Kampagnen, Street Generated Content® (SGC) und eigenen Communities wie dem onmasportsclub® (OSC) und unserem Kölner Stadt-Account. Community ist unsere DNA, Performance steckt in allem, was wir tun. Profitabel seit dem ersten Jahr und ohne Investoren arbeiten wir für Marken wie Wolt, Vodafone und XING. 2026 haben wir bei The Best Agency Bronze als Newcomer gewonnen und stehen zweimal auf der Shortlist „Agency of the Year“.

Vorab, damit du es einschätzen kannst: Die Stelle ist keine Einstiegsposition. Wir suchen jemanden, der schon selbst Creator ausgewählt, gebucht und Honorare oder Nutzungsrechte verhandelt hat, auf Agentur- oder Markenseite. Wenn du bisher vor allem Content produziert, Community Management oder SEO gemacht hast, passt die Stelle noch nicht.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

„Performance“ heißt bei uns: Du kaufst Creator ein, deren Content als Werbeanzeige Neukunden bringt. Den größten Teil deiner Zeit wählst du Creator aus, buchst sie und verhandelst Honorare und Nutzungsrechte, vor allem für Creator-Assets, die unsere Kunden als Dark und Spark Ads schalten, zum Beispiel für Wolt. Du schaust gemeinsam mit dem Kunden auf die Ad-Zahlen und entscheidest daraus, welche Creator und welcher Content als Nächstes kommen. Dazu kommen Awareness-Kampagnen. Außerdem planst du Social-Content für deine Kunden: Du verstehst, welche Trends gerade funktionieren, und übersetzt sie strategisch für die Marke und ihre Zielgruppe. Selbst im Ads-Manager steuerst du nur bei einzelnen Kunden. Das musst du nicht schon perfekt können, das lernst du bei uns.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content-Planung: Du planst Social-Content für deine Kunden und richtest ihn an Marke, Ziel und Zielgruppe aus.

  • Trends & Strategie: Du erkennst früh, was auf TikTok und Instagram funktioniert, und übersetzt Trends strategisch für deinen Kunden und seine Zielgruppe.

  • Creator-Einkauf: Du findest passende Creator, buchst sie und verhandelst Honorare, Nutzungsrechte und Paid Usage (Spark Ads, Whitelisting) eigenständig.

  • Briefing: Du brieftst Creator so, dass der Content als Ad funktioniert, prüfst Skripte und stimmst dich mit unseren Produktionen ab.

  • Content zu Ads: Du entscheidest, welche Assets als Dark oder Spark Ad laufen, und lieferst sie an den Kunden aus.

  • Auswertung: Du liest die Ad-Zahlen (CPM, CTR, Hold Rate, Kosten pro Neukunde) und die Kommentarspalten und leitest daraus die nächste Creator-Auswahl ab.

  • Ad-Steuerung: Bei vereinzelten Kunden planst, schaltest und optimierst du die Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok selbst.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du stellst Ergebnisse vor und vertrittst deine Empfehlungen beim Kunden.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Creator- oder Influencer-Marketing, gern auf Agenturseite oder im Creator-Programm einer Marke.

  • Du hast Creator selbst ausgewählt, gebucht und Honorare oder Nutzungsrechte verhandelt.

  • Du verfolgst Social-Trends und kannst begründen, warum ein Format zu einer Marke und ihrer Zielgruppe passt.

  • Du weißt, warum ein Creator-Video als Ad funktioniert (Hook, Hold Rate, CTR), und hast schon mit Ad-Zahlen gearbeitet, egal ob du selbst geschaltet hast oder eng mit einem Performance-Team.

  • CPM, CTR, ROAS und Conversion-Rate liest du nicht nur, du triffst damit Entscheidungen.

  • Du wohnst im Raum Köln oder ziehst her.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch.

Schön, wenn du schon selbst im Meta- oder TikTok-Ads-Manager gearbeitet hast, Dark und Spark Ads umgesetzt hast und mit Pixel und Conversions API vertraut bist.

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Verantwortung: Du kaufst für einen unserer größten Accounts Creator eigenständig ein und entscheidest mit, wer als Nächstes gebucht wird.

  • Growth: Raum für deine Entwicklung in Richtung Senior oder Unit-Verantwortung. Wer bei uns wächst, bekommt Perspektive: Verantwortung als Führungskraft im Team oder fachlich im eigenen Thema.

  • Hybrid: flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und Office, mittwochs ist unser Office Day.

  • Team: kurze Entscheidungswege und Sparring direkt mit den Gründern.

  • Equipment und Perks: MacBook, modernes Office im Herzen von Köln, Jobticket, regelmäßige Teamevents.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze zu einer Creator-Buchung, die du selbst verhandelt hast: wofür, zu welchen Konditionen, was dabei herauskam. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 2 Werktagen.

title: Propulsion Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform engineering assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design engineering role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft powerplant systems. Experience with electric aviation or electric propulsion systems is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

  • Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing functional, structural, environmental, certification, manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach and attention to detail.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is creating Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a subsidiary seeking ACPR authorisation as a payment institution and financing company, to serve its 1.6 million SMB customers base.

  1. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will lay the foundations of PFS’s accounting model, controls and reporting as the business is built.

  2. You ensure the reliability of PFS’s financial information, from product events and accounting entries through to financial and prudential reporting.

  3. You check daily that client funds are safeguarded and that PFS meets its own funds requirements and applicable prudential ratios. You flag risks early and help the Head of Finance anticipate capital needs.

You report to Maxime Leclercq, GM PFS, and functionally to @Raphaël Nahum, Head of Finance, on accounting standards and methods aligned with group finance.

How will you contribute to the project?

You build from scratch the accounting model and controls with Product and Tech, then run daily accounting until volumes justify a dedicated operator.

You own the figures and accounting decisions, and prepare the accounting-based prudential reports. You collaborate with our Regulatory Lead, who oversees reporting deadlines, completeness and reviews, the reports before submission.

You would be a great fit if:

  • You can work with incomplete information and make decisions, assumptions and open questions clear.

  • You document accounting decisions and are able to defend them internally and externally, including to statutory auditors and the ACPR.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

Build

  • Design and test payment and financing accounting schemes in the Core Banking System, the accounting interpreter, working closely with Product and Tech teams

  • Document the accounting impact of each product before launch.

  • Reconcile the ledger, general ledger, bank accounts and reports. Keep each reported figure traceable to its transactions.

  • Set up RUBA and COREP reporting, including dry runs, with the Regulatory Lead.

Operational accounting

  • Reconcile payment accounts (eg. SCT, SDD, cards, cheques) against the settlement account daily. Check safeguarding coverage, keep evidence and flag shortfalls.

  • Check own funds requirements, applicable ratios and available buffers daily.

  • Forecast the amount and timing of capital needs with the Head of Finance and FP&A

  • Resolve and document exceptions.

  • Account for doubtful receivables, provisions, write-offs and reversals.

  • Prepare closing entries, reconcile intercompany balances with Pennylane SAS and support statutory closings.

Strategic contributions

  • Prepare the accounting, exposure and provisioning materials for the committee that sets credit risk appetite, overall exposure and counterparty limits.

  • Quantify the accounting, provisioning and capital impact of new products, pricing or volume scenarios before launch.

  • Alert the Head of Finance early on capital needs, prudential constraints and standards changes (PCEC, ACPR) that affect the model.

  • Work closely with Pennylane’s Accounting Manager and the FP&A team to align on definitions, key metrics, and group procedures

Profile we are looking for

Must-have:

  • At least 6–7 years of experience, ideally in financial services audit followed by accounting in a payment institution, financing company or bank.

  • Strong PCEC, doubtful receivables and provisioning knowledge.

  • Able to both build the accounting model and run daily reconciliations, exceptions and closings.

  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and owning accounting decisions.

  • Able to query large datasets independently.

  • Works well with Engineering, Product, Data, Operations and the Regulatory Lead, with clear responsibilities.

  • Professional French and English: documentation and regulatory exchanges are in French; teams work in English.

Nice-to-have:

  • DEC or equivalent.

  • SQL.

  • Core banking or accounting interpreter experience.

  • Experience building accounting and controls for a new entity or licensing programme.

  • ACPR reporting experience (RUBA, COREP).

Recruitment Process

1. Interview (30-45 min) with Simon, Senior Recruiter

2. Interview (1h) with Maxime, General Manager and Raphaël Nahum (Head of Finance)

3. Case Study (1h30) with Raphaël, Sabrina and Maxime

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

title: QA Lead - Data Platform (TL1)
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London

Level: TL1

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Shira Tsinovich

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do


As the QA Lead across Data you will work closely with the Data Org, setting the testing approach and quality standards for its products and platforms.

You will be the quality partner for data delivery teams, advising on testing and quality assurance across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work with Data Engineering, Product teams, and clients to make sure changes meet the defined quality bar before they reach client environments.

This is an individual contributor role with no line management responsibilities. You will influence through expertise, relationships, and evidence.

  • Define and own the test strategy and test plans for the Data Org, deciding what is tested and how, based on risk, criticality, and impact to the business and clients.

  • Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams.

  • Set the quality gates that determine whether a change is fit to be promoted to client environments, and assess release readiness against milestones.

  • Ensure defects are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked to resolution in accordance with Quality standards, and drive root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact issues.

  • Select and maintain the tools and frameworks used for testing, with automated checks running in CI/CD.

  • Work with delivery teams, programme teams, and clients to support queries on test data and releases, and to maintain client confidence through clear, professional communication.

  • Influence engineers, data analysts, and leadership to adopt a test-first mindset and own the quality of their products, and hold a firm line on quality standards.

  • Report on test progress, quality trends, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and raise delivery risks and blockers early.

  • Maintain documentation of quality standards, test coverage, and decisions, with transparency on known issues and risks.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on data testing and data quality practices, including data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness).

What you’ll bring

  • Proven QA and testing experience: Strong knowledge of QA strategies, processes and methodologies, including defining and executing test plans, test cases and test scripts for complex software applications.

  • Agile, test-first delivery: Experience in cross-functional Agile teams with a test-first mindset, managing priorities, scope and risk to maximise testing impact across distributed engineering organisations.

  • Data testing and SQL: Working knowledge of data testing methods (data quality checks, schema validation, transformation testing, ETL/migration testing), plus SQL proficiency for querying and profiling large datasets to diagnose quality issues.

  • Quality metrics and reporting: Experience building quality metrics, dashboards and reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration and communication: Strong stakeholder management and verbal and written communication skills, working with development, product and client teams at all levels of management, including client engagement.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

Kaluza has new opportunities for QA Developer Engineers who will build and maintain automation frameworks that test AI-generated and AI-assisted code, and develop agent-based tooling that supports engineering teams across the business. These roles sit at the intersection of software development, quality engineering, and applied AI — you will build the tools that other engineers and clients rely on to develop, test, and ship AI-driven solutions with confidence.

The QA Development Engineers will be part of a Quality Enablement function which forms part of Kaluza’s Quality departments.

They will work closely with Applied Engineering and Global Products teams to deliver reusable frameworks and agent solutions. You will have opportunities to work with internal and external clients to understand their requirements and build solutions to meet their needs. AI will be a core part of your own workflow — used to accelerate 

the design, build, and iteration of testing tools and frameworks.

  • Automation Framework Development: build and maintain automation frameworks specifically for testing AI-generated code and AI system outputs, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and consistency.

  • AI-Assisted Tool Building: Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine, and scale internal testing tools and frameworks efficiently, embedding AI into your own development lifecycle.

  • Solution-Driven Delivery: Operate as part of a solution-focused team, translating customer and stakeholder requirements into working tools, frameworks, and processes.

  • Feature Delivery and Ownership: Take technical ownership of discrete components and features end-to-end, writing clean, well-tested code.

What you will have

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and QA methodologies.

  • Problem-solving skills with a solution-oriented mindset.

title: Quality Assurance Inspector (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Production Quality team in Thessaloniki is the technical shield protecting the integrity of STARK’s next-generation autonomous systems. Operating directly on the production floor, we partner with assembly leads, technicians, and engineering teams to stand up resilient, high-yield manufacturing processes. We bridge precise structural mechanical builds with complex, high-reliability aerospace-grade electronics. We value absolute technical precision, structured problem-solving, and the proactive ownership required to safeguard zero-defect manufacturing standards.

YOUR MISSION

As our Quality Assurance Inspector, you will be the final gatekeeper of production standards on our assembly floor. Utilizing your combined knowledge of mechanical and electronics engineering, you will continuously review active assembly lines, verify build documentation, and ensure all mandatory inline steps are executed flawlessly. You will take end-to-end ownership of on-floor quality checks—collaborating closely with Manufacturing Engineers to identify assembly gaps, block defective parts, and update localized Control Plans so our processes are continuously improved.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Conduct rigorous inline quality checks on active production lines, verifying that electro-mechanical sub-assemblies, wire harnesses, and avionics conform exactly to design schematics.
  • Review assembly lines to identify physical gaps, actively collaborating with Manufacturing Engineers to implement tooling, jig, or process improvements.
  • Define, update, and maintain dynamic Control Plans (CPs) for inline assemblies and final products based on real-time assembly data.
  • Block defective products immediately, physically isolating and managing quarantined materials on the floor.
  • Initiate and coordinate technical reworks, providing on-floor guidance to technicians and verifying that repaired systems meet original engineering standards before re-release.
  • Perform final quality checks and outgoing document reviews before delivery, recording deviations in the QMS and creating precise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Education: Vocational diploma or technical degree in mechatronics, electronics, mechanical assembly, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years as a Quality Inspector, QA Specialist, or Lead Assembler in aerospace, automotive, or defense.
  • Technical Skills: Strong practical understanding of both electronics (wiring, connectors) and mechanics (tolerances, fasteners, blueprints).
  • Process Review & Control Plans: Proven ability to spot floor assembly gaps, collaborate with Manufacturing Engineers, and execute dynamic Control Plans (CPs).
  • NCR Ownership & Languages: Experience managing non-conformances in QMS/ERP with professional working proficiency in English and Greek.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Active certifications in IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards.
  • Familiarity with flight-critical avionics systems (flight controllers, power distribution boards, telemetry) or military-grade hardware, tactical defense systems, and UAS.
  • Familiarity with ERP/QMS platforms (SAP QM, JIRA, CAQ) and basic training in Lean manufacturing, Kaizen, or Six Sigma.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

title: Regional Director, Client Engagement
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets, the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 350+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We are bringing Client Engagement together as a single global function under our Global Head of Client Engagement. We are hiring Regional Directors to lead it on the ground. You will own retention, adoption and growth for your region (EMEA or the Americas), lead a team of Client Engagement Managers across a tiered coverage model, and turn client insight into action across the business.

This is a role for a proven CS or AM leader who wants to scale a function. You will inherit a strong foundation, shape the next stage, and be accountable for commercial outcomes: gross and net revenue retention, product adoption, and the health of our most important client relationships.

What You’ll Work On

Every day is different, but here is the kind of work you will lead:

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach and develop a regional team of Strategic CEMs, Senior CEMs and Client Engagement Managers across the whole region, and the managers beneath you as the team grows.

  • Run a tiered coverage model: Strategic CSMs for our most important accounts, Senior CSMs for key accounts, and CSMs for the wider base. Define clear roles, service levels and career paths at each level.

  • Hire, onboard and train to a rapid growth plan, with a strong bench of internal successors.

Retention, Adoption & Growth

  • Own regional gross revenue retention (GRR), with clear early-warning signals and remediation plans for at-risk accounts.

  • Drive seat-level adoption: activate and re-activate users, build champion networks, and embed 9fin in each client’s daily workflow.

  • Lead adoption of our newest products, including 9fin AI and Private 9fin, with client-specific programmes and measurable usage goals.

  • Design role and client-specific adoption metrics that forecast usage trends, so the team drives usage proactively.

  • Partner with Account Management and Relationship Managers on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership at each stage of the client lifecycle.

Strategy & Operating Model

  • Translate the global Client Engagement strategy into a regional plan, with the playbooks, success plans and lifecycle programmes to execute it.

  • Use health scoring and usage data to decide where the team spends its time, and to move accounts between coverage tiers as their needs change.

  • Report regularly on regional KPIs to global leadership: retention, adoption, health, renewals and expansion pipeline.

Voice of the Client

  • Represent clients in conversations with Product, Engineering, Data and Editorial, backing requests with evidence such as the accounts affected, the ARR at stake and the workflow impact.

  • Work with our Forward Deployed team on strategic accounts, setting shared success criteria and feeding what you learn back into the product.

  • Build executive relationships with senior stakeholders at your region’s most important clients.

Operational Excellence

  • Use Salesforce, our analytics tools and client engagement platforms to make the team more proactive, with automation where it frees up time for high-value work.

  • Keep playbooks, client communications and dashboards current, and create feedback loops that improve the client experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 months: a clear picture of your region’s accounts, risks and team, and a regional plan agreed with the Global Head of Client Engagement.

  • Within 6 months: accounts assigned and covered under the tiered model, with health scoring in use and a visible improvement in early-warning response.

  • Within 12 months: measurable gains in regional retention, adoption and AI and Private 9fin usage, and a team with the capacity and leadership depth to keep scaling.

Requirements

This role will be a great fit if you have:

Experience & Expertise

  • 8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or related client-facing roles in Capital Markets, Enterprise B2B SaaS or Financial Data, including 3+ years leading teams.

  • Experience managing AMs, CSMs, AEs or building the layer of leadership beneath you, ideally across more than one region or client segment.

  • A track record of scaling or structuring a CS or AM function through a period of fast growth.

  • Strong understanding of global financial markets, and credibility with buyside, sellside and advisory clients.

Commercial Acumen

  • Proven success driving retention, adoption and expansion in enterprise accounts, ideally accountable for a portfolio of $50m in ARR.

  • Comfort being measured on GRR, NRR and adoption, and designing the KPIs, dashboards and forecasting that support them.

  • Experience working alongside sales and account management on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership between teams.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent people leadership: you coach, develop and hold a high bar for high-performing teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both inside 9fin and at clients.

  • The judgement to prioritise competing demands and to use data to decide where the team focuses.

Bonus Points

  • Existing relationships in the Leveraged Finance, Debt Capital Markets or Restructuring community.

  • Experience in a high-growth fintech or data provider, or with seat-based professional data products.

  • Experience driving adoption of AI products or working with embedded or forward deployed teams.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, product analytics and client engagement platforms.

Why Join Us?

You will join a fast-moving, ambitious team helping to power the largest financial market in the world. This role offers the chance to lead a regional Client Engagement team at a pivotal moment: with a clear global strategy, a product that clients rely on daily, and the mandate to shape how we retain and grow our client base for years to come.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
  • Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
  • Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
  • Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
  • Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals
  • Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
  • Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
  • Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
  • Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Relationship Manager - North London/Northern Home Counties
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.

Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.

In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.

Role Description

All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this.

Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team). We expect our Relationship Managers to be recognised as valued partners and experts in business finance by their clients and in the communities they serve.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks

  • Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

  • Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.

  • Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.

  • Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

  • Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values

  • Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships.

  • You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending.

  • You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

  • You will be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work.

  • You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

  • You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • You’ll have a proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.

  • You’ll demonstrate an ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

#LI-Remote #LI-AD1

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.
