• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

Marketplace Highlights

  • Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

  • A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

  • Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Economist at Relay, you'll:

  • Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

  • Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

  • Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

  • Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

  • Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

  • Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

  • Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

  • Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

  • Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Engineer, Machine Learning
descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be our first Senior Engineer in ML, working alongside our Staff Engineer to help build the foundations from the ground up. There's no existing DS/ML team yet, so the two of you will shape it together, working closely with engineering, data, and product, who are already exploring how ML can be used in payments. There's a lot still to figure out and a lot to build. You'll work closely with your team's stakeholders to identify where ML can move the needle, and report to engineering leadership while that function takes shape.

What will you be doing?

  • Own the full lifecycle of ML-powered features within your initiatives - from independently researching and testing approaches through training, deployment and monitoring in production

  • Productionise smart routing decisions across the payment flow, building the ML infrastructure around them as you go - versioning, CI/CD, observability

  • Partner closely with product, data and engineering to turn promising use cases into shipped, measured outcomes

  • Bring a pragmatic, impact-first mindset to experimentation and model evaluation, rather than chasing the most sophisticated approach

  • Mentor other engineers as they pick up ML techniques, sharing how you think about tradeoffs and when to keep things simple

  • Talk directly to customers to validate ideas and pressure-test what you're building against real usage

  • Help set technical direction within your area, working with your team to prioritise the use cases worth pursuing

  • Establish patterns and practices that make ML work reliable and repeatable at Primer, building on foundations rather than defining them alone

What we're looking for

  • Senior experience in ML engineering, data science, or applied research, with real production deployments behind you (API, batch, or streaming)

  • You think statistically. You can design and run experiments and A/B tests, and report what the results do and don't show

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch or Keras

  • Solid grounding in modern software engineering, infrastructure and data tooling, and an understanding of the MLOps challenges across the full ML lifecycle. You don't need to have built a platform, but you know what one has to handle

  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning (multi-armed or contextual bandits, for example). Production experience with it isn't required, but you need to understand how it works and where it applies

  • Cloud experience — AWS preferred; GCP or Azure both fine

  • Exposure to payments or e-commerce is a plus, not a prerequisite - you'll build that domain depth on the job

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, in the problems and in the process. You can research, develop and productionise independently, and you'll help define how we work as you go

  • You prefer handing models to another team to deploy and run.

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

descriptionHtml:

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

This is the most senior executive support role at Focused Energy. You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will take ownership of the operational infrastructure supporting the CEO, including diary and calendar management, travel coordination, executive administration and stakeholder logistics. The Chief of Staff leads strategic priorities, substantive briefings, executive alignment and follow-through on key decisions. You ensure the practical arrangements and information flow support those priorities effectively.

When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

You will exercise sound judgment and make day-to-day decisions independently within agreed parameters, knowing when to escalate strategic conflicts or sensitive matters. You will help establish reliable, efficient ways of working as the CEO Office develops.

You represent the CEO Office to investors, ministries, partner companies and board members. As the most experienced EA in the company, you also help shape how executive support works across Focused Energy.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and coordinate the CEO’s domestic and international travel, including complex delegations, conferences and investor or government engagements.

  • Build trusted relationships with investors, ministries, agencies, partner companies, board members and their offices.

Who You Are

  • You have managed complex delegation trips involving multiple participants, countries and official meetings.

  • You are fluent in English and German.

  • You are based in Berlin, or willing to relocate, and comfortable travelling with the CEO when needed.

This is a demanding role, with a strong emphasis on complex calendar management, exceptional attention to detail and the delivery of high-level, hands-on executive support to the CEO of a rapidly growing international company. Priorities can shift quickly and some trips or commitments require flexibility at short notice. In return, you can expect meaningful ownership, a close working partnership with the CEO and Chief of Staff, and the opportunity to help shape how the CEO Office operates. You will be trusted to exercise judgment within agreed responsibilities and escalation parameters.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Frontend Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role — our Frontend team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them

  • Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency

  • React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces

  • Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols

  • Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years)

  • Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols)

  • Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs

  • Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced

  • You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen:

  • Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie.

  • Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling.

  • Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken.

  • Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development.

  • Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een HR professional die begrijpt hoe tech & product teams werken. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie snel groeit en van richting verandert. Je bent niet bang om moeilijke gesprekken te voeren en weet hoe je mensen vooruit helpt zonder ze te verliezen. Je bent praktisch, direct en houdt van een omgeving die nog niet af is.

  • Je hebt minmaal 5 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bij voorkeur in een tech- of IT-omgeving, en weet hoe je in die context het verschil maakt.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je komt binnen in een organisatie die hard groeit en volop in beweging is. Het tech, content en IT-team dat jij begeleidt staat middenin die beweging: veertig mensen, tien open stoelen en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR-partner die hen daarin niet volgt, maar voorgaat.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag één invloed hebt op de mensen, de cultuur en de groei van een van de snelst groeiende teams van Lefebvre Sdu.

  • De kans om samen te werken met een nieuw leadership team dat hun baan in big tech bewust inruilde voor de kans om hier iets te bouwen wat er nog niet was.

MEER WETEN?

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.
  • Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok en Snapchat werken en houdt hun innovaties bij.
  • Je bent creatief, maar werkt ook gestructureerd en gecoördineerd.
  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels vloeiend.
  • 5+ jaar ervaring
  • Je bent hands-on en zorgt ervoor dat campagnes tot in de puntjes geregeld zijn.

Wat bieden wij?

Een boeiende baan in een vooruitstrevend en informeel team binnen een van de grootste communicatiegroepen ter wereld. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen in een inspirerende werkomgeving. En natuurlijk werk je met fijne collega’s in ons geweldige kantoor, die iedere werkdag bijzonder maken.

  • Salaris: €3.800 - €5.800 (op basis van 38,75 uur per week).
  • Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.
  • Werken voor grote (internationale) merken en klanten.
  • Een zelfstandige rol met veel vrijheid.
  • De kans om een breder perspectief binnen influencer marketing en social media te ontwikkelen en kennis vanuit de wereld van mediabureaus op te doen.
  • Werken binnen een energiek, ambitieus en gezellig team met focus op AI-transformatie.
  • Open communicatie en een fijne werksfeer waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn.
  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden.
  • Een fijne kantoorplek op een mooie locatie in Amsterdam (Rivierenbuurt);
  • Een team met veel kennis, kunde en gezelligheid;
  • Vrijdagmiddag borrels en events op onze rooftop aan de Amstel
  • Mental Wellbeing: Toegang tot ons well being platform Telus
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.
  • 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).
  • Hybrid Working allowance: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.
  • Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.

Klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière?

Solliciteer nu en word onderdeel van ons ambitieuze team!

title: Senior Influencer Planning Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

The Senior Influencer Planning Manager is a hands-on strategic planner responsible for translating PlayStation's global influencer approach into clear, actionable plans across priority games, hardware, services, sponsorships, brand campaigns, and cultural moments. 

This role will support portfolio prioritisation, audience and creator plans, global/local processes, measurement, and investment recommendations that enable the broader Influencer Partnerships team to execute with greater clarity, consistency, and impact. 

Working closely with Influencer Partnerships, Brand, Media, Studios, Social, PR/Communications, Insights & Analytics, agencies, and local market teams, this role connects the planning approach to execution through strong briefs, planning tools, recommendations, and cross-functional coordination.

What you'll be doing:

Influencer Planning 

  • Develop planning documents, campaign frameworks, and recommendations for priority initiatives, translating audience objectives, business priorities, and cultural opportunities into actionable influencer plans. 
  • Maintain planning calendars, portfolio roadmaps, intake inputs, and decision materials across influencer workstreams. 
  • Partner with internal insights teams, agency partners, local teams, and activation leads to synthesise research into clear planning implications. 

Portfolio Prioritisation & Investment Strategy 

  • Support assessment of the appropriate influencer support model by initiative, including full-service, lighter-touch, locally led, agency-supported, or playbook-enabled approaches. 
  • Build planning inputs for investment and resource recommendations, balancing business impact, cultural opportunity, audience reach, market needs, and historical learnings. 

Global / Local Planning Model 

  • Coordinate early local market inputs, creator recommendations, market nuances, and feedback loops, translating them into clear global planning outputs. 
  • Maintain shared ways of working, planning templates, and governance that drive global consistency while supporting local relevance. 

Measurement, Learning & Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Maintain KPI, reporting, and learning frameworks and translate campaign performance into actionable recommendations for future planning. 
  • Build and maintain planning tools, playbooks, and knowledge resources that improve speed, clarity, and consistency. 
  • Create concise stakeholder updates and leadership readouts, partnering cross-functionally to resolve planning needs and improve execution readiness.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator strategy, brand planning, social strategy, entertainment marketing, digital marketing, or integrated campaign planning. 
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 
  • Strong understanding of the creator landscape, social platforms, gaming communities, entertainment culture, youth audiences, and emerging platform behaviours. 
  • Experience translating audience insights, cultural signals, creator trends, and business priorities into clear campaign strategies and planning recommendations. 
  • Experience supporting portfolio prioritisation, investment planning, measurement, and global/local ways of working in a complex or matrixed organisation. 
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and synthesise complex information into clear presentations and recommendations. 
  • Comfort working with KPIs and campaign performance data and translating results into practical planning implications. 
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to build trust across activation teams, local markets, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • AI fluency or willingness to rapidly adopt AI-enabled tools for research, trend scanning, reporting, knowledge management, and planning efficiency. 
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and high-visibility initiatives. 
  • Genuine passion for PlayStation, gaming, creators, entertainment, sports, youth culture, and the broader cultural landscape.

Benefits:

  • Discretionary bonus opportunity
  • Hybrid working model (FlexModes)
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Dental Scheme
  • 25 days holiday per year
  • On Site Gym
  • Subsidised Café
  • Free soft drinks
  • On site bar
  • Access to cycle garage and showers

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. 

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

title: Senior Information Security Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology"

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

Senior Information Security Consultant (m/w/d)

Das erwartet Dich:

  • ISMS und BCMS: Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und nachhaltigen Verankerung von Informationssicherheits- und Business-Continuity-Managementsystemen, beispielsweise nach ISO 27001, TISAX® oder BSI IT-Grundschutz

  • Praxisnahe Informationssicherheit: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationssicherheit bei unseren Kunden nicht nur auf dem Papier existiert. Gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Ansprechpartnern entwickelst Du praxistaugliche Vorgaben und begleitest deren nachhaltige Umsetzung

  • Projektverantwortung: Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle und komplexe Kundenprojekte. Dabei steuerst Du die Projektbeteiligten, behältst Ziele, Qualität und Termine im Blick und sorgst für eine strukturierte Umsetzung

  • Portfolioentwicklung: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres ISMS- und BCMS-Beratungsportfolios und bringst Deine fachliche Erfahrung gezielt in neue Methoden, Leistungen und Beratungsansätze ein

  • Audit-Vorbereitung: Du bereitest unsere Kunden auf interne und externe Audits vor, coachst sie im Umgang mit Auditoren und vermittelst praxisnahe Tipps für eine erfolgreiche Zertifizierung

  • Dokumentation: Du erstellst und überarbeitest Auditunterlagen, Berichte, Sicherheitskonzepte und Maßnahmenpläne professionell und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Methoden & Standards: Du entwickelst Best Practices, Methoden und interne Standards kontinuierlich weiter und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Teams ein

  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt weniger erfahrene Kollegen bei fachlichen Fragestellungen, teilst Dein Wissen und gibst konstruktives Feedback

Das bringst Du mit

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der ISMS- oder BCMS-Beratung mit und hast bereits anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte eigenständig begleitet und fachlich gesteuert

  • Standards: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und regulatorischer Anforderungen, insbesondere ISO 2700x, BSI IT-Grundschutz, VDA ISA / TISAX® und KRITIS

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick

  • Kommunikation: Du trittst gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern sicher auf und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln, vom Fachexperten bis zum Management

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich und überzeugst durch einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Qualifikation: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder relevante Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen IT, Informationssicherheit oder Risikomanagement

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Kundentermine innerhalb der DACH-Region zu reisen. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei etwa 30 %

  • Weitere Expertise: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrung in der BCM-Beratung, einschlägige Zertifizierungen sowie Kenntnisse der Anforderungen aus NIS2 oder KRITIS

Was erwartet Dich noch?

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an.

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.

title: Senior Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions.

  • Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions.

  • Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solvethe hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements.

  • Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1.

  • You are not afraid of different physics domains. You feel comfortable navigating the different physics regimes of a Stellarator - from waves propagating in a plasma to cryogenic properties of steel.

  • You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse.

  • You build consensus. You are a low-ego high-clarity communicator who works effectively with multiple technical leads, to bring integration challenges and system-level tradeoffs to a clear decision.

  • You commit to a concrete outcome. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at L3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

  • Operating System & Debugging: Solid understanding of Linux internals, bootloaders, systemd, drivers, kernel concepts, networking, and Docker, plus hands-on experience with debugging tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind, UART, and JTAG

  • Senior Mindset: You clarify requirements before designing a solution, consider the impact on other teams, and are comfortable making and defending technical decisions

title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
descriptionHtml:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

  • Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

Benefits & Culture

  • Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

  • Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making.

  • Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment.

  • Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications.

  • Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance.

  • Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

descriptionHtml:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.

Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.

We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.

title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotic Systems
descriptionHtml:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission. Every one of these solutions starts as physical hardware — robotic workcells that we design, build, and commission in our own labs before they go into production.

We are looking for a passionate Senior Mechanical Engineer for Robotic Systems to turn robotics concepts into reliable physical systems. In this role, you will design the mechanical parts of our workcells, build and assemble them in our labs, and make sure they meet the relevant safety standards. You will own our lab infrastructure, tooling, and material, and be the hands-on partner for our robotics, software, and application engineers. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Design mechanical parts, fixtures, grippers, mounts, and enclosures for the robotic workcells in our labs and in customer projects
  • Validate workcell and production line concepts in simulation — reachability, collisions, and cycle times — before any hardware is built
  • Construct, assemble, and commission complete robotic workcells — from the frame and mounting concept to cabling and final integration
  • Create and maintain CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials, and prepare parts for manufacturing via CAM and 3D printing
  • Build up a library of reusable mechanical modules, standard components, and design templates, and feed lessons learned from existing workcells back into it, so that each new cell is faster to design than the last
  • Own the organization of our labs, including tools, equipment, material stock, and the procurement of mechanical components
  • Ensure that our workcells adhere to the relevant machine safety norms and support risk assessments, safeguarding concepts, and technical documentation
  • Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to translate application requirements into robust mechanical solutions
  • Travel to customer and deployment sites to support the installation, commissioning, and on-site adaptation of workcells (up to 20% of working time)

Essential Skills

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience, e.g. a technical apprenticeship with several years of relevant work
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in mechanical design, machine building, or industrial automation
  • Solid CAD skills (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor, Creo) for part and assembly design including technical drawings
  • Experience with robot simulation and offline programming environments (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Visual Components)
  • Practical experience with CAM and common manufacturing processes (milling, turning, sheet metal) as well as with 3D printing, including design for manufacturability
  • Experience with aluminum profile systems, linear axes, fixtures, and standard mechanical components
  • Experience with robotic hardware (robot arms, grippers, cameras, AGVs, sensors, etc.)
  • Hands-on mindset — you enjoy building, assembling, and commissioning hardware yourself
  • Knowledge of machine safety norms and a structured approach to safe workcell design
  • Structured and independent working style with a strong sense of order in the lab
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Knowledge of electrical engineering: wiring, control cabinets, and the integration of sensors and actuators
  • Experience with pneumatics: valves, cylinders, vacuum grippers, and air supply
  • Familiarity with functional safety standards and safety equipment (e.g., EN ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, EN ISO 13849, safety scanners, light curtains, emergency stop circuits)
  • Experience working with external manufacturing suppliers and in procurement
  • Basic programming skills (e.g., Python) or experience with PLC programming
  • German language skills

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement.
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.

Why Join Samsara?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
