title: Senior People Partner - Content
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups)

  • Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner

  • A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels

  • Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment

  • Proactive and collaborative approach

  • A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture

Compensation & Benefits

Finance & Insurance

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped)

  • Private health insurance with dental and vision

Time Off

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months per year

  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company-wide events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior People Tech Specialist (FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior People Tech Specialist, you will be responsible for enhancing the user experience within the Workday platform. This responsibility includes Workday configuration, conducting thorough Workday testing, sharing insights and providing end-user support for Workday-related inquiries.

You will join our dynamic People Tech team, which primarily manages the Workday - Human Capital Management (HCM) system. Reporting to the People Tech Manager, you will collaborate with other People Tech team members. Our team is accountable for configuring Workday, adopting new functionalities, integrating with other systems, and tailoring the system to meet the company's needs. We strive to make Workday a user-friendly, self-service tool that caters to our organization's specific requirements.

This is a fixed-term position approximately 2 years.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Troubleshoot Workday technical problems and deficiencies in a timely manner
  • Audit for data integrity, accuracy and timeliness
  • Advocate for the use of technology and automation across people processes
  • Do unit testing and create test plans, coordinate end-to-end testing until resolution.
  • Develop system documentation
  • Drive / support implementation of additional Workday modules
  • Provide end user support on more complex issues
  • Contribute to interdependent HR wide projects
  • Suggest and implement Workday enhancements, process improvements
  • Perform Workday Release testing and adopt improvements
  • Partner with HR and other stakeholders
  • Support other projects and ad hoc requests

About you 

  • Solid experience with Workday configuration within Compensation and Advanced Compensation functional areas.
  • Confidence with Workday Security, Business Processes, Reporting, Calculated Fields, Condition Rules, EIBs, Custom Organization hierarchies.
  • Advanced Excel / Gsheet skills
  • Experienced in updating and maintaining project plans
  • High attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English
  • Capability of handling confidential information discreetly and demonstrate a strong work ethic.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

  

Purpose

In this role, you will drive the launch, growth and optimisation of paid digital marketing activities in Finland. You’ll manage campaigns and budgets across key performance channels, using data and testing to improve results, identify growth opportunities and scale customer acquisition.

  

Your tasks:

  • Create, manage and optimise paid digital campaigns across Google, Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Display.

  • Own campaign budgets and continuously optimise performance against key business KPIs.

  • Analyse campaign results and translate performance data into actionable improvements.

  • Plan and run tests across audiences, creatives, channels and campaign setups to identify growth opportunities.

  • Explore and launch new performance marketing channels.

  • Support the development of tracking, measurement and reporting.

  • Coordinate with internal teams, external agencies and partners to deliver campaigns.

  • Monitor the Finnish market, competitors and digital marketing trends.

What you offer us:

  • 5+ years of performance marketing experience within a B2C environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using tools such as Google Analytics and platform-specific ad managers.

  • Experience managing and optimising significant paid media budgets against performance KPIs.

  • Structured, results-oriented and comfortable working independently.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

  • Fluent English and German or Finnish, both written and spoken

  • Experience with Display and Affiliate Marketing is a plus.

  • Experience working in start-up, new market launch or agency environments is a plus.

  • Understanding of how performance marketing works alongside broader brand and offline marketing is a plus.

What we offer you:

  • International working environment where your ideas and contributions can have a real impact.

  • A talented and supportive team with plenty of opportunity to take ownership and shape how we work.

  • €1,500 annual development budget to support your personal and professional growth.

  • A high level of trust and autonomy, giving you the freedom to own your work and make decisions.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • The opportunity to work temporarily from abroad with support through our WorkFlex platform.

title: Senior PHP Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
About Shiftbase

At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe rely on our platform every day to plan work, track time, and manage leave, freeing them from unnecessary admin so they can focus on what matters and what sparked their business.

As we continue to grow in customers, usage and product ambition, the demands on our platform grow with us. Our backend needs to scale in quality, reliability and speed of change. That’s why we’re investing heavily in modernising our platform, building a foundation that allows us to move faster, deliver better experiences, and support the next phase of Shiftbase’s growth.

About the role:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you are a key driver of both product delivery and platform modernisation. You work on the core of our backend, improving reliability, performance and scalability, with the explicit goal of turning Shiftbase from a platform people enjoy into a platform they love.

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality.

What you'll do

Drive technical excellence

  • Design and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for complex features and system components

  • Make informed architectural decisions that balance pragmatism with long-term vision

  • Set the bar for technical craft through your contributions and code reviews

  • Own complex technical initiatives from design through production, breaking them into testable increments

Build for reliability and scale

  • Define comprehensive testing strategies for complex features, championing quality within the team

  • Debug and resolve complex issues across multiple components, improving system observability

  • Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle

  • Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health improvements

Enable team growth

  • Mentor engineers with targeted technical guidance and feedback

  • Support onboarding and enable a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment

  • Help shape delivery practices and improve team velocity through data-informed decisions


What we're looking for

Core technical expertise

You have deep backend engineering experience with complex, high-scale systems. We don't expect expertise in everything listed below. We value engineers who've built depth and breadth through genuine curiosity and a drive to solve real problems. These are examples of competencies that matter in this role:

  • Modern PHP & architectural patterns: Experience with hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, or similar patterns that emphasize domain modeling over framework magic. You can build maintainable systems without relying on framework shortcuts.

  • SQL & database design: Comfort writing raw SQL (not just ORM abstractions) and working with complex relational schemas particularly around time-sensitive data like scheduling, timesheets and payroll where integrity and performance are critical.

  • Legacy modernisation experience: You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers.

  • Monolith to services: Experience breaking down monoliths with good judgment about when distribution solves real problems (deployment bottlenecks, team autonomy) vs. when it adds unnecessary complexity.

  • Testing in legacy contexts: Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems.

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of

✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture

✅ You care about product quality, not just “shipping code”.

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features

✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions

This probably isn’t your dream job if…

⛔️ You only want to work on greenfield projects and avoid legacy systems altogether

⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements

⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them

⛔️ You’re looking for a role where architecture decisions are already “done”

⛔️ You’d rather optimise locally than care about the end-to-end product experience

Note: Candidates outside the Netherlands will not be considered

title: Senior Planner OOH mit Schwerpunkt Programmatic DOOH (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten & Hybrid Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Planner OOH mit Schwerpunkt Programmatic DOOH (Mensch) bist du ein entscheidender Teil unseres Teams und gestaltest maßgeblich den Erfolg unserer Kampagnen. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für die strategische Planung, Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung wirkungsvoller Außenwerbelösungen für unsere Kunden, wobei du einen besonderen Fokus auf die Integration und den Ausbau zukunftsweisender Programmatic DOOH-Lösungen legst.

  • Kundenverständnis & Strategie: Du verstehst die vielschichtigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden, ordnest Ziele und Rahmenbedingungen ein und übersetzt sie in klare, zielgerichtete (D)OOH-Strategien unter Berücksichtigung innovativer programmatic Ansätze. Dabei schaffst du eine saubere Verbindung zwischen Briefing, Zielgruppe und kanal- bzw. standortgerechter Umsetzung.
  • Mediaplanung: Mit besonderem Fokus auf Zielgruppe, Reichweite und Budget planst und steuerst du (D)OOH-und Programmatic DOOH-Kampagnen. Du wählst passende Umfelder und Standorte aus, koordinierst Timings und stellst eine effiziente Aussteuerung über den gesamten Kampagnenzeitraum sicher.
  • Innovation: Strategisch über den Tellerrand hinausdenkend entwickelst du kreative, moderne und zukunftsfähige (D)OOH-Lösungen. Dabei bringst du datenbasierte Ansätze gezielt in Konzepte ein, um Wirkung und Relevanz weiter zu steigern.
  • Zusammenarbeit: In enger und proaktiver Abstimmung mit internen Teams sowie externen Partnern und Kunden stellst du reibungslose Abläufe und den Erfolg der Kampagnen sicher. Du koordinierst Schnittstellen, hältst Stakeholder auf dem aktuellen Stand und sorgst dafür, dass Timings und Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden.
  • Konditionsverhandlung: Du verhandelst versiert mit Vermarktern und sicherst für unsere Kunden die bestmöglichen Konditionen und Platzierungen. Mit gutem Marktüberblick vergleichst du Angebote und achtest auf transparente, belastbare Vereinbarungen.
  • Analyse & Optimierung: Kampagnendaten wertest du kontinuierlich und detailliert aus, um daraus konkrete, datenbasierte Optimierungsmaßnahmen abzuleiten. Du identifizierst Performance-Treiber und Potenziale, leitest Learnings für laufende Anpassungen ab und nutzt die Erkenntnisse für die Weiterentwicklung kommender Planungen.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Ausbildung: Eine fundierte Ausbildung oder ein einschlägiges Studium im Marketing, den Medienwissenschaften oder einer ähnlichen Disziplin hast du erfolgreich absolviert. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Marken, Kommunikation und Medien mit.
  • Berufserfahrung:  Du verfügst über fundierte Marketingerfahrung, insbesondere im (D)OOH-Bereich, und bringst nachweisbare Erfolge in diesem Segment, speziell im Bereich Programmatic DOOH, mit. Planung, Umsetzung und Auswertung gehören für dich zusammen.
  • Tool-Skills: Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint, ist für dich selbstverständlich. Durch diese Tools bereitest du Daten strukturiert auf und machst Ergebnisse klar und präsentationsstark.
  • Arbeitsweise: Dein analytisches Denkvermögen ist ausgeprägt; du interpretierst Ergebnisse präzise und fokussierst dein Handeln konsequent auf nachhaltige Kundenzufriedenheit. Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig, gut organisiert und zuverlässig.
  • Team & Ideen: Proaktiv bringst du dich ins Team ein, überzeugst mit strategisch fundierten Ideen, insbesondere im Bereich Programmatic DOOH, und beweist ein sicheres Gespür für innovative Umsetzungen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deine Sprachkenntnisse umfassen verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deine Kommunikation ist sicher, klar und adressatengerecht – mündlich wie schriftlich.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamorientiert #kommunikativ #zuverlässig

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

Bitte lies unsere Datenschutzerklärung für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. #LI-Promoted

title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence.

  • We’re a SaaS scale up and one of the fastest growing tech companies in the North.
  • There’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.
  • Our software is award-winning and used by 100,000s of students at over 1,000 universities & colleges worldwide.
  • We’re growing so we can achieve our mission to support 1 million students to become better learners by 2030.

🚀 About the role

Career track: IC4

Unit: Shared services

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you help set the strategy for Genio's infrastructure end-to-end — from design through to running it in production. You work with squads on feature work to advise/set direction, and ensure reliability, security, and cost efficiency. You drive the design and implementation of best-practice cloud infrastructure, automation frameworks, and tooling that enable scalability, reliability, and efficiency for engineering teams in both business units. Working closely with engineers, testers, and data colleagues, you lead initiatives to enhance platform capabilities, optimise performance, and champion DevOps principles.

Responsibilities:

  • Evolving Genio's cloud infrastructure: Architect and optimise cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, security, and resilience. Shape long-term infrastructure strategy and apply Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD best practices.
  • Maintaining and improving observability of Genio's applications: Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing capabilities. Champion the adoption of SLOs, SLAs, and SLIs.
  • Leading incidents and post-incident learning: Support as an incident lead for PlatformOps, coordinate the response, run blameless post-incident reviews, and track actions to completion.
  • Driving automation of repetitive tasks: Develop scalable automation frameworks to streamline engineering workflows and improve efficiency.
  • Raising the technical capability of other teams: Act as a technical advisor, provide guidance and upskilling support for platform tooling, and mentor engineers across engineering teams.

👥 Meet the team

You will report to the Principal Platform Engineer and work most closely with:

  • Principal Platform Engineer (Operations)
  • Platform Engineer (Operations)
  • Engineering teams in both business units
  • Production Support Engineer (Operations)
  • Senior Data Engineer (Operations)

👤About you:

Essential:

  • Systems design and judgement: Takes an ambiguous problem, defines options, makes trade-offs explicit, and writes clear design documents.
  • Programming Skills: Strong experience in scripting and programming with Python and/or Bash for automation and tooling.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficient with Terraform for infrastructure automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Kubernetes in production: Experience operating, upgrading, networking, and debugging Kubernetes clusters under load.
  • Reliability Engineering & Security: Proven ownership of production service reliability (defining SLIs, incident response) and implementing security practices (access control, secrets management, patching, backup/recovery).

Bonus / Nice to have: 

  • AI-Assisted Development: Comfortable and proficient with AI development tools as part of everyday engineering.
  • Cost Awareness: Understanding of infrastructure costs and the ability to build cases for spending changes.
  • Collaboration & Adaptability: Ability to mentor others, foster trust, make pragmatic technology choices, and communicate with "passionate views, loosely held".

💰Salary and benefits:

💸£70,000- £76,000 per annum dependent on experience 

🏖️ 33 days annual leave (Inclusive of bank holidays)

🎄 3 gifted days off at Christmas

💰 EMI Share Options Scheme

🎓 Generous individual learning and training allowance

⌚ Truly flexible hours to suit when you work best

💻 Full home working set up and beautiful collaborative office space

🚗 Free Leeds City Centre office parking

🌴 Nomad working policy with family travel insurance

🍼 Enhanced 26 weeks maternity and 4 weeks paternity (fully paid)

🤍 Health cash plan (from glasses to massages)

📍Location: 

Our beautiful office space in Leeds is our key hub for collaboration, and we love to get together in person. We operate a flexible hybrid working model, including supporting our Genios who are based remotely across the UK. If you are more than 50 miles away from the office, we offer full remote working support within the UK, with the opportunity to join colleagues for in-person collaboration several times a year.

title: Senior Power Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do 

  • Own the electrical power system architecture for Hypersonica’s high-speed flight vehicles, ensuring generation, conversion, storage, distribution, protection, and monitoring functions operate as a coherent and resilient system.

  • Define, manage, and maintain power system requirements, ensuring full traceability from mission and vehicle-level needs through subsystem design, verification, and validation.

  • Develop power-system architectures and performance budgets covering voltage regulation, load management, efficiency, redundancy, thermal constraints, fault tolerance, and mission-critical availability.

  • Lead the integration of power generation, battery systems, power electronics, energy storage, distribution networks, protection devices, and control systems across vehicle and payload architectures.

  • Conduct electrical system analyses including load-flow, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments.

  • Define and support system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, environmental qualification, and vehicle integration activities, using data-driven analysis to improve performance and mitigate risk.

  • Produce and maintain critical engineering artefacts including specifications, electrical schematics, interface control documents (ICDs), analysis reports, verification plans, and design review material.

  • Apply systems engineering and MBSE principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and flight-test outcomes.

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks associated with power availability, thermal loading, EMC performance, reliability, safety, integration complexity, and operational resilience.

  • Act as a technical authority across electrical power systems, collaborating closely with avionics, controls, software, thermal, mechanical, EMC, and systems engineering teams to deliver robust vehicle capability.


Who you are 

  • An experienced Power Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex electrical power, energy storage, avionics, aerospace, defence, automotive, space, or other mission-critical systems.

  • Strong background in electrical system architecture, requirements management, systems integration, verification, and validation across the full engineering lifecycle.

  • Deep understanding of electrical power generation, power conversion, battery systems, energy storage, power distribution, protection systems, and power electronics.

  • Experienced in electrical analysis including load-flow studies, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments.

  • Comfortable designing and integrating high-performance electrical power systems within highly constrained environments where weight, volume, efficiency, and thermal management are critical.

  • Familiar with systems engineering and MBSE approaches, using structured methods to manage complexity, interfaces, traceability, and technical risk.

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, qualification campaigns, integration programmes, and the transition from concept through detailed design and verification.

  • Technically credible across multiple engineering disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction.

  • Comfortable operating in ambitious, fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly and engineering decisions have significant programme impact.

  • Motivated by solving difficult engineering problems and delivering technologies that strengthen European sovereign defence capability.


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Price & Discount Strategy Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:

From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.

Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.

We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance.

  • Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process.

  • Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements.

  • Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets.

  • Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective.

  • Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose.

  • Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services.

  • Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data.

What They're Looking For

  • A German-qualified lawyer (Volljurist:in), having successfully completed both State Examinations.

  • 4–10 years of experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, and significant experience advising B2B technology businesses, either in-house or in private practice.

  • Experience working within an international B2B technology business, particularly one scaling its enterprise customer base or operating across multiple jurisdictions, would be beneficial.

This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers.

You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection.

If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission:

Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation.

You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you.

What you'll own

A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome.

Your first 90 days

  • Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table.

  • Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for.

  • Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first.


What we need from you

  • Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer.

  • Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind.

  • Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make.

  • Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts.

  • Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships.

  • Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Compensation: Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.

  • Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

  • Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

  • Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

descriptionHtml:

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day.One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Requirements Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Requirements Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead requirements engineering practices for the Microliner aircraft.

You will establish and maintain a consistent, traceable, and certification-compliant requirements framework across the aircraft development lifecycle. Working closely with Overall Aircraft Design, Safety, Verification and Validation and Configuration Management, you will enable system and discipline owners to develop high-quality requirements by providing requirements engineering expertise, guidance and quality assurance.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide requirements engineering expertise across the organization, guide requirement owners in applying effective methods, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead requirements engineering practices across the aircraft development lifecycle, from stakeholder needs and requirements definition through baselining, change management, and certification support.

  • Support aircraft, system, and discipline owners in developing and maintaining clear, consistent, implementation-appropriate, and verifiable requirements, providing expert guidance and quality assurance throughout the process.

  • Support requirement owners in the decomposition and allocation of requirements, and maintain bidirectional traceability across aircraft functions, systems, and engineering disciplines, including requirements applicability and consistency across aircraft variants and configurations.

  • Ensure alignment between requirements, aircraft architecture, interfaces, certification requirements, and safety objectives, and collaborate with the V&V team to establish complete and traceable verification coverage.

  • Facilitate requirements elicitation, development, and review activities, and challenge and support requirement owners in resolving ambiguities, inconsistencies, gaps, and quality issues.

  • Coordinate requirements baselining and change control, including the assessment of impacts on architecture, interfaces, safety, certification, and downstream requirements.

  • Define and continuously improve requirements engineering processes, methods, templates, quality criteria, and tool usage.

  • Assess and communicate requirements maturity, quality, traceability, applicability, and change status in collaboration with the respective requirement owners.

  • Coach engineers and technical leads in requirements development and management best practices.

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in requirements and systems engineering, with demonstrated expertise in developing and managing complex requirements throughout the full product development lifecycle and across multiple levels of the requirements hierarchy. Experience with aircraft requirements is preferred; comparable experience from another safety-critical industry, such as automotive, is also considered.

  • Previous experience with the development of novel aircraft systems, such as high-voltage electric propulsion systems, is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience working across a complete requirements hierarchy, from aircraft, vehicle, or product level through system and subsystem levels to hardware and software requirements, including decomposition, allocation, traceability, and management of requirements across organizational and technical boundaries.

  • Strong knowledge of requirements capture, analysis, decomposition, allocation, validation, traceability, change control, and verification.

  • Good understanding of systems and safety engineering for complex, safety-critical products, preferably in accordance with SAE ARP4754 and ARP4761. Previous experience with ED-12/DO-178 and ED-80/DO-254 is a strong plus.

  • Experience with civil aircraft certification under EASA CS-23/25, FAA Part 23/25, or comparable aircraft certification; experience in an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation is highly desirable.

  • Proficiency with requirements management tools such as IBM DOORS, Siemens Polarion, Jama Connect, or equivalent; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a plus.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset, combined with a strong motivation for aviation and electric aircraft technologies.

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role

You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer.

We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards.

You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include:

  • Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise.

  • Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk.

  • Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail.

  • Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work.

We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community.

You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and

experimental teams across the company.

About You

You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed.

You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You understand modern machine learning and can write the code, run the experiments, and analyse the results needed to test your ideas.

You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work.

You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim.

You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them.

You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project. You care about enabling useful scientific and medical applications of AI and are motivated to make them safer.

Nice to Have

  • Research experience in AI safety or biosecurity, including evaluations, red-teaming, or threat modelling.

  • Experience with protein design, genomic models, structure prediction, or other biological AI systems.

  • Experimental biology experience, or computational research validated in collaboration with an experimental team.

  • Experience implementing and evaluating safeguards in deployed systems.

  • Collaboration with biosecurity organisations, synthesis screening initiatives, or AI safety institutes.

Compensation and benefits

What we offer in return

  • Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..

  • Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

  • High Growth: We truly believe in investing our people we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.
