title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als (Senior) Sales Manager (w/m/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen. In dieser zentralen Rolle fungierst du als entscheidendes Bindeglied, das Interessent:innen in zufriedene LIQID-Kund:innen verwandelt. Dein souveränes Auftreten sowie deine umfassende Kompetenz prägen den Eindruck, den Interessent:innen von LIQID gewinnen, und überzeugen sie nachhaltig, sich für unsere maßgeschneiderten Anlagelösungen zu entscheiden. Du hast die Möglichkeit, dein Gehalt durch deine starke Leistung und Motivation flexibel zu gestalten.

 

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Proaktive Kundengewinnung: Du begeisterst neue Kund:innen im Segment der vermögenden Privatkundschaft und positionierst LIQID als starken, vertrauenswürdigen Partner im digitalen Wealth Management.

  • Qualifizierte Ansprache: Auf Basis hochwertiger Leads nimmst du proaktiv Kontakt zu Interessent:innen auf, führst strukturierte Erst- und Folgegespräche und baust so von Beginn an eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung auf.

  • Bedarfsgerechtes Informieren: Du präsentierst unser Leistungsangebot, analysierst die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen und entwickelst darauf abgestimmte Anlagevorschläge.

  • Onboarding & Übergabe: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Übergang der gewonnenen Kund:innen an unser Relationship-Management-Team.

  • Team- & Marktfeedback: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Teamlead Sales und Kolleg:innen zusammen, teilst aktiv Feedback zu Kundenbedürfnissen, Markttrends und Materialien und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Vertriebsaktivitäten weiterzuentwickeln.

  • CRM & Nachverfolgung: Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten strukturiert und transparent in unserem CRM-System und trägst so zu einer effektiven Nachverfolgung und Steuerung des Vertriebs bei.

Das bringst du mit

Background:

  • Du hast ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium abgeschlossen oder eine Ausbildung in der Finanzbranche gemacht, zum Beispiel als Bankkaufmann/-frau, Investmentkaufmann/-frau oder Versicherungskaufmann/-frau.

  • Außerdem bringst du erste Erfahrung im aktiven Vertrieb von Finanzprodukten mit, idealerweise in der Finanzanlagenvermittlung, Vermögensverwaltung oder im (Private) Banking.

  • Du weißt also genau, wie man anspruchsvolle Kund:innen abholt und professionell informiert.

Skills & Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Kapitalmärkte und Anlageprodukte und kannst komplexe Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend vermitteln.

  • Mit deiner Akquisitions- und Abschlussstärke sowie deinem professionellen Auftreten gewinnst du schnell das Vertrauen neuer Kund:innen.

  • Kommunikation ist deine Stärke; klar, empathisch und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Außerdem bist du sicher im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Reporting-Tools und digitalen Vertriebsplattformen.

  • Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch, und gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du ebenfalls mit.

Mindset:

  • Du bist hochmotiviert, zielorientiert und packst Dinge gerne aktiv an. Sales ist für dich nicht nur ein Job, sondern etwas, das dich antreibt; du liebst den direkten Kundenkontakt und interessierst dich für Kapitalmärkte.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und mit echtem Erfolgswillen. Gleichzeitig verbindest du Überzeugungskraft mit Empathie und einem starken Servicegedanken, genau das macht dich zu einer authentischen und überzeugenden Ansprechperson.

 

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!


Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erster Austausch: In einem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team möchten wir die Gelegenheit nutzen, dich näher kennenzulernen und grundlegende Informationen zu besprechen.

    Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: In einem fachlichen Dialog prüfen wir, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen mit den Anforderungen der Position übereinstimmen.

  • Persönliches Treffen: Hier hast du die Gelegenheit, das Team zu treffen und praxisnahe Einblicke in die Tätigkeiten eines Sales Managers zu gewinnen.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.


LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Senior Sales Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As Senior Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you’ll lead, coach and develop a team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers in the UK. You’ll own team-level commercial performance, improve sales execution and build a predictable, data-driven revenue engine through disciplined pipeline management, forecasting and deal coaching. This is a hands-on player-coach role where you’ll support complex opportunities, develop Account Executive capability, strengthen outbound motions with Sales Development and Marketing, and help shape the UK go-to-market strategy. You’ll work closely with Product, Account Management, Revenue Strategy & Operations, GTM Partnerships and other regional stakeholders to turn customer and market insight into growth.

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers, setting clear expectations for customer engagement, pipeline quality, sales execution and revenue delivery.

  • Run a consistent sales operating rhythm through regular one-to-ones, call coaching, deal strategy sessions, live opportunity reviews, pipeline reviews, forecast reviews and quarterly business reviews.

  • Embed MEDDPICC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology across the team, driving rigorous qualification, multi-threading, persona-based messaging, clear next steps and close planning.

  • Support strategic and complex opportunities by joining customer meetings, coaching negotiation and objection handling, engaging senior stakeholders and preserving clear Account Executive ownership throughout the sales cycle.

  • Build and improve outbound sales motions with Sales Development and Marketing by refining target segments, account coverage, messaging, outreach cadences and reporting.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene, data quality and forecasting discipline, using pipeline coverage, stage conversion, win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy to identify risks and prioritise action.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • At least 6 years of B2B sales experience, including significant experience as a closing Account Executive selling to SME, SMB or mid-market customers, and at least 2 years of frontline sales leadership experience managing, mentoring or coaching Account Executives in a quota-carrying sales environment.

  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets, with experience owning or contributing to a team quota.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, including discovery, value selling, negotiation, objection handling and close planning.

  • Strong practical knowledge of MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology, with the ability to train, inspect and reinforce its use across a team.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing pipeline, inspecting opportunities, forecasting accurately and maintaining disciplined CRM standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and performance-manage Account Executives, including providing clear feedback and addressing under-performance fairly and effectively.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments or financial services, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred

  • Experience selling multi-product fintech or payments solutions, such as payments, foreign exchange, business accounts, cards or spend management, to founders, CFOs, Finance, Operations or business-owner stakeholders.

  • Experience building or scaling a sales team, market, outbound motion or go-to-market strategy in the UK, EMEA or another developing market.

  • Experience implementing sales methodologies across a team, including creating enablement materials, inspection frameworks, coaching routines and performance measures.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and modern sales tools such as Gong, Chorus, Outreach, Salesloft or AI-enabled sales platforms, together with an interest in using data and technology to improve sales productivity.

  • Understanding of payments, KYC, AML, risk, compliance or other regulated financial-services workflows, or experience representing a company at market events and managing C-level customer relationships.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You take feedback well and actively seek it. You see it as a tool, not a criticism.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.

As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:

  • Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.
  • Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.
  • Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.
  • Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.
  • Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.
  • A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.
  • Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.
  • A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.
  • A champion of responsible speed. You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • AI fluency. You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.
  • A diverse Agile toolbelt. You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.
  • Global team experience. Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.

title: Senior Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you'll be doing
This role does the hands-on architecture work. You design the secure patterns engineering builds against, review hard problems in depth, and help make secure-by-design real across the Hyperblock and Polaris platform and the AI product surface. You work closely with the Principal Security Architect, who sets the technical bar. You own significant areas of that work and deliver them end to end. Engineers adopt good architecture because it is the better path. You will build that kind of architecture, working on problems that carry real risk.

Anaplan is not a simple SaaS application. The platform performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modelling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. The technical surface includes the legacy Hyperblock engine, the newer Polaris engine, and a growing set of AI products. These include CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational planning support.

Enterprise customers in regulated industries increasingly ask a hard question: if Anaplan is breached, can Anaplan staff or an attacker read their data? Answering it takes rigorous architecture work. We are commissioning an independent Trail of Bits assessment of exactly this. It covers end-to-end tenant isolation, the proposed BYOK design, and internal infrastructure boundaries. You will help turn findings like these into concrete design changes. That includes moving key management from legacy HSM-based designs to Vault, and extending encryption coverage to storage and data paths that lack an agreed architecture today.

What you'll do
• Produce reference architectures: design and maintain security patterns for platform and AI components, working to the standards set by the Principal.
• Contribute to identity and authorisation design: including tenant isolation, service-to-service trust, and authorisation for AI agents and analyst-style workflows.
• Apply cryptography and key management: work on encryption, BYOK and key custody. Be clear about where data is plaintext, who can use keys, and what each control protects against.
• Design AI guardrails: input and output controls, tool and authorisation boundaries, and prompt-injection and abuse defences. Draw on MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10.
• Run threat models: lead them on high-risk systems, working with engineers to trace trust boundaries and compromise paths. Turn the findings into prioritised, actionable design changes.
• Support external assessments: prepare architecture evidence, join discovery sessions with engineering, and check that what is built matches what is documented.
• Improve the supply chain and attack surface: build integrity and provenance, hardened images, and less exposed surface.
• Stay hands-on: write and review designs and prototypes, and test your own work.
• Grow the practice: mentor engineers, contribute to standards, and help turn design decisions into enforceable guidance.

What we're looking for
• Solid experience in secure software architecture, with depth in at least two of: cryptography and key management, identity and authorisation, tenant isolation, and threat modelling.
• A working understanding of AI and ML security, and of how LLM-driven features change identity, authorisation, supply chain, and verification.
• The ability to design and review real systems, and to defend your decisions to strong engineers.
• A record of influencing engineers without formal authority, including when risk and delivery pressure conflict.
• Experience with enterprise-scale SaaS or cloud-first systems, ideally multi-tenant.
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain architecture honestly to engineers, leadership, and customers.

Nice to have
• Experience with Vault, KMS/HSM, or BYOK/HYOK designs.
• Experience designing for regulated environments, such as FedRAMP.
• Contributions to NIST, ISO, or OWASP, or talks and published research.
• An offensive grounding that you use to pressure-test designs.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

title: Senior Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

  • Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments.

  • Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Proactively fix security flaws by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation.

  • Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats.

  • Automate security tooling into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production.

  • Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks.

  • Lead incident response efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies.

  • Own our public security posture as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem.

Our Tech Stack

  • Security & Vulnerability Tools: Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security

  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

  • Cloud: GCP

  • Programming language: Java, Typescript, Javascript

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, AMQP

  • Monitoring & Logs: ELK, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Deployment & Repository: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role.

  • Strong hands-on penetration testing background, with proven ability to discover application, API, and network-level vulnerabilities.

  • A builder/fixer mindset: You don't just export scanner PDFs; you can read code, understand exploits, write fixes, or provide clear remediation steps to engineers.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud security (AWS or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).

  • Experience with dependency and supply-chain security (CVE management, open-source licensing, SCA tools).

  • Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.

  • Adaptability to a fast-paced open-source startup environment where pragmatism and execution speed matter.

Perks & Benefits

  • Work from anywhere: We’re a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you’ll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.

  • Health coverage: From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered.

  • Home office setup on us: We’ll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably.

     

Our Hiring Process

We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.

  • Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min)

  • Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous homework focusing on threat assessment and remediation)

  • Team chat with one of your future colleagues (30 min)

  • Final discussion with one of our co-founders (30 min)

title: Senior Social Media Manager (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Wir bei T&P verstehen uns als datengetriebene Kommunikationsagentur, deren Mission es ist, Kreativität, Technologie und Daten auf neue, aufregende und effektive Weise zu verknüpfen. Wir nennen es das &Modell und die Prämisse ist einfach: Kreation, Strategie, Media und Daten/CRM arbeiten Hand in Hand und lösen Herausforderungen als ein Team, das nah und partnerschaftlich mit dem Kunden zusammenarbeitet.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Social Media Manager übernimmst du den strategischen Lead für die Kanäle etablierter Marken: Von der Redaktionsleitung über zielgerichtete Kampagnen bis zur fachlichen Führung deines Accounts verwandelst du Ideen in reichweitenstarken Content mit messbarem Impact.
  • Content-Lead & Redaktionsplanung: Du entwickelst kanalübergreifende Social Media-Strategien und Content-Konzepte. Die übergeordnete redaktionelle Verantwortung liegt in deinen Händen. Von strategischen Themenplänen und Kanal-Positionierungen bis hin zu Content-Pillars steuerst du Workflows und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Qualitätssicherung (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube etc.).
  • Kreativ-Lead & Brand Voice: Als Expert:in für alle Plattformen arbeitest du im engen Sparring mit Art & Copy. Du führst und entwickelst die Kanäle in der passenden Tonalitäten, bringst komplexe Themen treffsicher auf den Punkt und gibst als Reviewer wertvolles Feedback.
  • Plattform-Trends & First-Mover: Du hast ein Gespür für Plattform-Updates, Algorithmen, Sounds und Popkultur-Trends,  antizipierst sie vorausschauend und integrierst sie strategisch in die Redaktionsplanung. Du leitest relevante First-Mover-Konzepte ab und machst markenadäquates Trend-Jacking zur strategischen Stärke.
  • Community-Strategie: Neben der Konzeption professioneller Community-Guidelines begleitest du anspruchsvolle Markendialoge mit diplomatischem Fingerspitzengefühl und baust gezielt Brand-Communities auf.
  • Performance & Paid Social: Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für deine Social KPIs, übersetzt Daten in klare strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für Kundentermine und stimmst Kampagnen sowie Budgets auf Meta, TikTok oder LinkedIn gemeinsam mit den Media-Teams ab.
  • Mentoring & Team-Development: Mit deiner Erfahrung leitest du Junior- und Mid-Level Kolleg:innen fachlich an, begleitest ihr Onboarding und förderst den kontinuierlichen Wissenstransfer.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 4–6 Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Management und in der Content-Strategie (von Vorteil: Agenturumfeld o. auf etablierter Markenseite) sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Führung reichweitenstarker Multichannel-Accounts.
  • Strategie- & Redaktionssicherheit: Routinierter und strukturierter Umgang mit komplexen Redaktionsabläufen, kanalübergreifenden Workflows und anspruchsvollen Freigabeprozessen.
  • Kreativgespür & Sparring: Führungs- und Moderationsstärke, ausgeprägte Kooperationsfähigkeit sowie ein Gespür für Storytelling und integrierte Kampagnenansätze.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Stilsicheres Text- und Schreibtalent mit verhandlungssicherem Deutsch (C1-C2-Niveau) und fließendem Englisch (C1) sowie viel Feingefühl im Markendialog.
  • Plattform- & Tool-Know-how: Ausgeprägte Expertise im Umgang mit Meta Business Suite sowie gängigen Social Media Marketing Tools. Tiefes Verständnis der Plattformlogiken von TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und YouTube sowie deren Auswirkungen auf Content-Strategie und Performance.
  • Analytics & Paid-Social-Know-how: Starkes Zahlenverständnis, sichere Anwendung gängiger Social-Analytics-Tools und C-Level-Präsentationen sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von Paid und Organic für einen smarten Budgeteinsatz.
  • Mentoring-Mindset: Motivation und Freude daran, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu coachen und zu fördern.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #proaktiv #kommunikativ #motiviert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

Accso ist Digitalpartner für anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen nach Maß – mit AI Native Mindset. Wir verbinden exzellentes Engineering und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit pragmatischem KI-Einsatz, von der Konzeption über die Entwicklung bis hin zum Betrieb. title: (Senior) Software Engineer (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

  • Contribute to technical direction and strategy in support of the long-term product vision.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Critically evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot AI-generated output, using effective prompting and appropriate safeguards rather than accepting results at face value.

  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teammates improve how they use AI tools.

  • Improve developer experience through tools, automation, and engineering practices that enable reliable, frequent delivery.

  • Collaborate across product and platform teams, and contribute to an environment where people learn, grow, give constructive feedback, and raise challenges safely.

Your profile:

  • Professional software engineering experience (React, Node.js) and designing reliable backend services and APIs. Experience with React Native experience is a plus.

  • Able to work effectively across system boundaries and collaborate with engineers outside your primary specialism.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high engineering standards.

  • Able to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated output, use effective prompting where relevant, and share practical learnings with teammates.

  • Experience working with a public cloud environment such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.

  • Familiarity with DevOps concepts and practices, including CI/CD, observability, and operating software in production.

  • Understanding of core application and backend concepts such as authentication, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and API integrations.

  • A builder-first, pragmatic approach: You turn customer problems into shipped outcomes. You take initiative, test and learn quickly, and make clear trade-offs between speed, quality, maintainability, and risk.

  • Passion for writing maintainable, elegant code and continuously improving how software is built.

  • A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively.

  • You have a builder mindset. You thrive in environments where things are still taking shape, take initiative to move ideas forward, and find ways to create impact even when the path isn't fully defined.

  • You embrace trying things out over waiting for perfect conditions, ship early to learn fast, and treat iteration as progress.

Why Taxfix?

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be the primary software point of contact for the Laser team and provide technical leadership across software, hardware, and experimental-system interfaces. You will help define the architecture and technology direction for a greenfield laser-software platform while remaining hands-on in developing reliable tools for calibration, operation, human-machine interaction, and experimental data processing.

This role offers the opportunity to work across software, hardware, and experimental-system boundaries while contributing to a strong engineering culture within the Darmstadt Software Department. You will help shape technical direction, establish the foundations of a new software platform, and grow toward a broader technical leadership role. The position does not initially include direct people-management responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the primary software partner for the Laser team and coordinate software activities across laser projects.

  • Provide technical leadership for software initiatives, including planning, technical alignment, risk identification, and coordination with laser physicists, engineers, and systems-integration partners.

  • Help define the architecture, technology choices, development practices, and interfaces for a new laser-software platform in a greenfield environment.

  • Design and implement reliable software for critical laser projects, from system-level interfaces to user-facing applications.

  • Develop and maintain automated calibration software that improves repeatability, reduces manual effort, and supports reliable laser operation.

  • Design and build clear, dependable human-machine interfaces, dashboards, and operational tools for monitoring and operating laser systems.

  • Develop software that interfaces with laser devices, diagnostic systems, cameras, and experimental equipment to support data acquisition, system monitoring, operational control, and visualization.

  • Develop data-processing pipelines and data-storage solutions for experimental and operational data, including diagnostic and camera data where appropriate.

  • Define robust interfaces between software, hardware, cameras, and experimental systems in an environment where requirements and technologies are still evolving.

  • Work with networked device and system interfaces, potentially including TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable communication technologies.

  • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and operational guidance to support long-term maintainability and safe, reliable operation.

  • Identify and address reliability, performance, integration, debugging, and maintenance risks in software that interacts with real-world systems.

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the Software Department.

  • Mentor engineers and help establish engineering practices as the software team grows.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous technical problems and building systems from the ground up.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of technical direction while collaborating closely with software specialists, laser physicists, experimental experts, and systems-integration partners.

  • You can move effectively between technical leadership, project coordination, architecture, and hands-on implementation.

  • You take ownership of the quality, reliability, testability, and long-term maintainability of the systems you build.

  • You communicate clearly with both software specialists and technical partners from adjacent disciplines.

  • You apply sound technical judgment when making design, implementation, and technology-selection decisions in an evolving environment.

  • You are curious, adaptable, and motivated to understand how software interacts with hardware, cameras, diagnostics, and experimental systems.

  • You are experienced in debugging and testing complex software and understand their importance in senior-level engineering work.

  • You value constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other engineers.

  • You are interested in developing toward technical leadership and project ownership. Formal people-management responsibility is not required at the outset.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Python, or comparable programming languages.

  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

  • Knowledge of software architecture, code review practices, automated testing, technical documentation, and engineering best practices.

  • Experience with greenfield development, platform or architecture definition, and making technology choices where requirements are still evolving.

  • Experience with automated calibration, control-adjacent software, laboratory systems, automation, or physical-device interfaces.

  • Experience developing human-machine interfaces, dashboards, or software for operating technical equipment.

  • Experience with camera integration, image processing, diagnostic data, or experimental data-processing pipelines.

  • Experience developing data-storage solutions for high-volume, time-series, experimental, or operational data.

  • Familiarity with software-hardware integration and working across experimental-system boundaries.

  • Experience with networked device communication or system interfaces, such as TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with control systems or optics is beneficial, but not required; the ability to learn and collaborate across these disciplines is more important.

  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

This team spends most of its time working on customer focused features that improve the user experience, from content discovery and search to Roku pay and subscription to embedded software and firmware, and much more. Our product roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide. Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media.

What is the role?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the OS UI/SDK team, you will design, develop, and deliver engaging platform features — including screensavers, static and dynamic wallpapers, trivia, featured experiences, and AI-driven content initiatives — that reach millions of Roku users worldwide. You will leverage AI and machine learning technologies to develop new capabilities that enhance user experiences across the Roku platform. This role requires a proactive, ownership-driven approach where you will create proof-of-concept prototypes in a startup-minded environment and then adapt those prototypes for production-grade deployment. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in UI/UX design, product management, backend engineering, and business leadership to translate ideas into impactful solutions. You will investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain high-quality, commercially viable products. This is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming entertainment through innovation and a deep commitment to engineering excellence.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Design and develop features for new experiences on the Roku platform, including screensavers, wallpapers, trivia, and featured experiences
  • Build proof-of-concept prototypes to validate ideas rapidly, working with a startup mindset to iterate quickly and deliver solutions
  • Collaborate with UI/UX design, backend engineering, and product management teams to create and implement new user experiences
  • Adapt proof-of-concept solutions into production-ready, scalable implementations
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and large language model technologies to develop innovative platform features
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain commercially viable solutions
  • Contribute to API design decisions, understanding considerations and trade-offs
  • Work across cloud development, content management, and UI development to deliver end-to-end feature solutions

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • Extensive experience in a software engineering environment
  • Demonstrated project work using AI/ML and LLM technologies
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React Native, Python, BrightScript, or related technologies
  • Experience working in an embedded environment
  • Experience in productionising solutions, including content management, UI development, cloud development, and cloud backend integration
  • Knowledge of core OS concepts such as memory management and multi-threading
  • Experience in API design, with an understanding of considerations and trade-offs
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Consumer electronics experience in media, content, or ad product development is a plus
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
#LI-AM3

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

descriptionHtml:

Our team members come from some of the best universities in the world and left some of the largest tech companies to build something truly remarkable.

Tasks

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is at home across our processor software from ported libraries and the compiler down to bare-metal and operating systems. Your team will: develop our software stack, including compiler, mapping tools, low-level tooling, simulation and debug infrastructure; write bare-metal, firmware and OS-level software for our RISC-V SoC; implement and optimise signal-processing and inference kernels under real-time constraints; bring up, test and port software on pre-silicon platforms and on silicon, including low-level hardware tests; and work in a close feedback loop with our hardware designers.

Requirements

  • Strong C, modern C++ (C++17/20, STL, Boost) and Python.
  • A solid foundation in algorithms and in hardware/software system architecture.
  • Experience working close to the hardware, with a good understanding of system-on-a-chip design, processor architecture and microarchitecture, and some familiarity with RTL and hardware design.
  • Experience with agentic programming.
  • You know your way around all of these fields, and go deep in at least one: i ) compiler development and code generation; ii) low-level tooling, simulation and performance analysis; iii) low-level embedded or systems software, operating systems and real-time; iv) signal processing, numerical computation and ML inference
  • Master's degree (or equivalent experience) and 10+ years of relevant experience.
  • Relocation required. Currently 4 days on-site, 1 day remote. Policy may change.

Nice to have

  • Parallel and data-flow execution models: SIMT, predicated execution, branch divergence.
  • Mapping and optimisation algorithms: graph algorithms, place-and-route / EDA, CGRA or FPGA mapping, ILP solvers.
  • Kernel-level optimisation: vectorisation, data layout, memory hierarchy, fixed-point and quantised arithmetic.
  • Post-silicon validation and hardware bring-up, including directed and random test generation.
  • Porting code to new platforms.
  • Exposure to: RISC-V, LLVM, CUDA, OpenCL, Verilog, Verilator, QEMU, GDB, JTAG and on-chip debug, OpenSBI, bootloaders, HAL, Linux kernel and device drivers, device tree, Zephyr, Yocto/OpenEmbedded, BLAS/LAPACK/OpenBLAS.
