title: Strategic Finance Intern
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Review and reconcile our models: Work through our long-term investment model and multi-year business plan, check formula integrity and cross-sheet consistency, and reconcile both against our budget.

  • Find and resolve discrepancies: Keep a clear log of every mismatch you find, trace it to its cause, and work with the relevant teams to resolve it.

  • Document how the models fit together: Write clear handover documentation on how our models connect and where each input comes from, so the next person can pick them up quickly.

  • Build tools the team will use: Create dashboards and automations on top of the reconciled models to enable the business operations team and the rest of the business to quickly find answers to their finance questions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Modelling experience: Hands-on financial modelling experience, ideally from investment banking, private equity, venture capital, transaction services, or a finance role at a startup.

  • Excel and spreadsheet fluency: You can trace logic through models someone else built, spot errors quickly, and suggest improvements. Experience with Excel macros or Google Apps Script is a plus.

  • Independent problem-solving: You structure a messy question, reason from the data in front of you, and work through blockers without needing step-by-step guidance.

  • Confidence to flag problems: You tell a team lead when their numbers don't tie, clearly and constructively, and own your mistakes when you make them.

  • AI-native: You use AI tools such as Claude to work faster and build better tools, not as a replacement for doing the thinking.

  • Startup mindset: Curious, proactive, and detail-oriented. You welcome feedback, enjoy working with others to help the team succeed, and are excited by fusion energy.

  • Availability: You can start immediately and commit to 2-3 months on-site in Munich. Fluent English is required; German is a plus.


Don't tick all the boxes? We would still like to hear from you!

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30 min)

  • Technical Interview, including a short modelling case (60 min)

  • Second Technical Interview (45 min)



*This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don't look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Strategic Sales Manager (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Strategic Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence with its most important French customers. This is a pivotal opportunity to shape how we win and grow strategic accounts, from developing senior relationships and navigating complex buying groups to building a repeatable approach for large, high-impact opportunities.

You’ll act as the business lead for the strategic segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team while staying close to customers, account plans, and active deals. You’ll build a focused pipeline and a sales motion suited to organizations with complex needs, multiple stakeholders, and ambitious transformation goals.

You’ll also orchestrate the cross-functional support needed to grow strategic accounts. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll direct resources toward the accounts and opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the Strategic sales team, including hiring, performance management, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set clear priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Develop a focused strategy for target accounts, including account plans, senior stakeholder relationships, and a clear view of customer priorities and decision processes.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on executive engagement, value-based selling, multi-threading, commercial strategy, and navigating complex buying groups.

  • Build a consistent, evidence-based strategic sales motion, refining qualification, messaging, and execution based on customer conversations and deal patterns.

  • Bring customer and market learning to Product, making clear recommendations on strategic customer needs, use cases, and opportunities.

  • Set pipeline priorities with BDR and Growth leaders, including targeted outbound and other channels suited to strategic accounts.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize executive events, campaigns, customer advocacy, and community programs that support strategic pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support strategic priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on account access, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to deliver credible evaluations, successful implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share strategic account and market insights with the CRO and other segment leads, helping shape a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience leading Strategic or Enterprise sales, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals and relationships with senior executives.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end, and building pipeline through teams and functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience making practical decisions about where to focus capacity and budget, including the roles of direct sales, marketing, and partners.

  • Strong judgment in developing account strategies, coaching complex deal execution, and building a reliable forecast.

  • The ability to create a repeatable sales approach without treating every strategic customer as the same.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building strategic sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Strategic segment has clear ownership, a focused pipeline, and measurable progress against its ARR goals. The team builds trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executes complex sales cycles with discipline. Cross-functional resources are aligned to the accounts and opportunities that matter most, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust sharpen its strategic sales approach in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Strategy & Operations - Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Strategy & Operations - Transformation

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £90k-£110k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our customers are some of the world's largest companies, and every partnership depends on Deducta delivering the measurable outcomes we've committed to. This role owns delivery for a set of our enterprise accounts, from sales handover through implementation, adoption and ongoing value. You'll report to the Chief of Staff.

You'll work directly with senior leaders at our customers, run complex programmes end to end, and work closely with whoever leads our customer function. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Deducta delivers and help make that model repeatable.

What you'll do

  • Account delivery: Own delivery for a set of enterprise accounts end to end, from sales handover through implementation, adoption, value realisation and ongoing partnership.

  • Enterprise programmes: Translate customer objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners and dependencies, and keep complex programmes moving.

  • Senior relationships: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day programme leads through CPOs, CFOs and other executives.

  • Data and platform: Work directly with customer data and the Deducta platform, understanding each customer's business so our work produces meaningful insights and outcomes.

  • Implementation and adoption: Identify blockers early, coordinate the right resources across product and engineering, and make sure customer learnings shape how we improve the product.

  • Delivery playbook: Turn what works on your accounts into repeatable processes the wider customer team can use.

Success in this role means:

  • Trusted partner: Your customers see Deducta as a partner that consistently delivers against its commitments.

  • Predictable implementations: Implementations move quickly, with risks and blockers surfaced early rather than through firefighting.

  • Visible value: Customers adopt the platform, can articulate the value Deducta creates, and keep deepening how they use it.

  • Repeatable delivery: The processes you build make delivery faster and more consistent across accounts.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency operator with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, ideally having reached Manager, with experience managing complex workstreams and confidence in front of senior clients. You should be as comfortable in the data as you are presenting to an executive. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Client leadership: You build credibility quickly, manage demanding stakeholders and become a trusted partner to senior executives.

  • Programme leadership: You turn an ambitious objective into a structured plan and create accountability across stakeholders you don't control.

  • Analytical depth: You get into the data yourself, identify what matters and synthesise complex information into clear conclusions.

  • Problem solving: You diagnose why something isn't working, separate symptoms from underlying problems, and drive the team to a practical solution.

  • Executive communication: You take complex, messy work and communicate the answer clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • High agency: You create clarity where none exists and follow problems through to resolution.

  • Nice to have: Experience in enterprise software, data, analytics, AI, procurement, complex technology implementations, or a high-growth environment.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

Compensation: £90K – £110K • Offers Equity

title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

descriptionHtml:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell

As we are building the best milkman on earth, we are looking for sharp minds that can help us further shape Picnic as we expand across Europe. We are looking for experienced hires with a background in top strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, e-commerce or commercial roles, that can tackle challenges and growth opportunities at Picnic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Finance, Math or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in top tier management consulting, PE, investment banking, retail topics and hands-on deal experience
  • Out-of-the-box thinking and initiative: hands-on, nothing-is-impossible mindset
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, allowing you to explain complex analytical concepts in a simple and practical way
  • Proficient with SQL and Python or excited to learn

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

You'll always have something to learn with us! You’ll benefit from opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already know. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Which team will I join?

At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.  

What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?

You get full accountability from the start: from shaping the strategy and driving step-change improvements, to collaborating with multiple teams to achieve tangible business results.

At Picnic, the long-term opportunity isn't just a role—it’s a platform to shape your own career trajectory with real ownership, business impact, and fast growth. Hence the career paths are as diverse as your ambitions. Depending on your interests and strengths, these are most common career paths we’ve seen so far:

  • Given our scale-up environment, many projects tend to grow in scope and complexity under your responsibility and you naturally grow a team around you in order to take your project to a next level.
  • As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. We have numerous colleagues that have switched from Commercial to Fulfillment, or from Distribution to Customer and many other examples.

In what language should I apply?

Please send your application in English.

title: SW Team Lead
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Software Team Lead, you'll coordinate the efforts of the software team across the stack, driving performance optimization, deploying pilot and prototype stacks to grow the developer base, and ensuring alignment between client specifications and deliverables. You'll build and mentor a growing team while staying hands-on with code, architecture, and performance yourself, working closely with chip architects and hardware teams during early silicon bring-up.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong background in systems software for AI/ML accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, or other high-performance compute platforms.

  • Solid understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, parallel computing, and hardware-software interaction.

  • Proven ability to lead small engineering teams while retaining significant individual contribution.

  • Strong C/C++ programming skills.

  • Experience with Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, etc.) is highly desirable.

  • Strong communication and project ownership skills, including translating client requirements into technical scope, deliverables, and realistic timelines.

  • Strong background in testing and deployment infrastructure for large-scale software projects.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the software stack for AI accelerator products, balancing speed of execution with long-term technical foundations.

  • Work closely with chip architecture and hardware teams on hardware–software co-design and early silicon bring-up.

  • Lead development across kernel libraries, runtimes, drivers, firmware, and developer tooling as needed.

  • Optimize key AI workloads for performance, efficiency, memory usage, and reliability on emerging hardware.

  • Stay hands-on with architecture, coding, debugging, reviews, and performance analysis while mentoring a growing team.

  • Partner directly with clients to understand technical requirements, translate them into clear team deliverables, and align scope, priorities, and timelines.

Nice to have

  • Strong background in mathematics.

  • Hands-on experience with low-level software such as compilers, drivers, and firmware.

  • Experience profiling and optimizing AI workloads for performance, memory efficiency, and hardware utilization.

  • Experience with AI inference platforms such as vLLM and SGLang.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

Find and engage talent | About 70%

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.

You'll join the Recharge team in Amsterdam, part of a global e-commerce platform that makes digital payments simple, fast, and accessible worldwide. From gift cards and gaming vouchers to prepaid payment cards and mobile top-ups, Recharge connects millions of consumers with digital products from leading brands such as Apple, Google, Vodafone, PlayStation, and PaysafeCard.

At Coda, Tech Leads play a pivotal role in shaping both our technology and our teams. Beyond technical expertise, they inspire and develop engineers, foster a culture of trust and collaboration, and take ownership of key technical decisions. With the autonomy to drive meaningful change, our leaders balance innovation, execution, and long-term scalability.

We're looking for a Tech Lead who is equally passionate about people and technology. Along the way, you'll empower engineers to grow, champion engineering best practices, and help build a collaborative, high-performing team that makes a real impact.

title: Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (EMS, PPC & SCADA) at NeuVerge-Tron GmbH, you will serve as the technical lead and solution architect during pre-sales and tender phases for utility-scale renewable energy and energy storage power plants.

In this position, your core product portfolio comprises Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), and SCADA platforms. You will analyze customer requirements, regional Grid Codes, and Transmission/Distribution System Operator (TSO/DSO) mandates, translating them into resilient, high-availability, and cybersecure system architectures.

(Note: This role focuses on control software, industrial automation, and OT system architecture; it does not cover battery cell sizing, containerized mechanical design, or civil EPC scope.)

 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Pre-sales & Bid Management

  • Analyze customer technical specifications, RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs for utility-scale solar, wind, and hybrid BESS assets.

  • Author technical proposals, functional architecture diagrams, and Statements of Work (SOW) for EMS/SCADA solutions.

  • Compile compliance matrices and deviation lists addressing customer specifications and utility regulations.

  • Define the Bill of Materials (BOM), covering server hardware, industrial controllers, networking equipment, software licenses, and engineering services.

  • Lead technical deep-dive workshops, solution demonstrations, and clarification sessions with customers, EPC contractors, and grid operators.

Grid Code Compliance & Functional Control Design

  • Evaluate regional Grid Code regulations across target European markets (e.g., VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, ENTSO-E standards) and translate them into EMS/PPC control requirements

  • Architect plant-level control logic, including Active Power Control, Reactive Power/Power Factor Regulation, POI/PCC Voltage Support, Frequency Response, and Ramp Rate restrictions.

  • Define EMS-level operational strategies, such as automated dispatch tracking, State of Charge (SoC) management constraints, energy arbitrage scheduling, ancillary service controls, and fail-safe/black-start logics.

System Integration & Communication Architecture

  • Design overall system architectures connecting EMS, PPC, SCADA, Historian, and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI).

  • Define interface specifications for external subsystems: Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), MV switchgear, digital protection relays, power meters, and TSO/DSO dispatch centers.

  • Develop and maintain interface control documents (ICD), data point lists, and signal mapping registers.

  • Implement and validate standard industrial protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850 (MMS/GOOSE), DNP3, and OPC UA.

  • Architect high-availability schemes, redundancy topologies, automated failover mechanisms, time synchronization (NTP/PTP), and disaster recovery plans.

OT Networking & Cybersecurity Architecture

  • Design Operational Technology (OT) network topologies, VLAN segmentations, IP addressing schemes, and DMZ firewall policies.

  • Formulate secure remote maintenance topologies, jump host concepts, VPN tunnels, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) mechanisms.

  • Ensure EMS solution adherence to cybersecurity standards, including IEC 62443 and IEC 62351 frameworks.

  • Collaborate with customer IT/OT security teams and external auditors during security reviews and threat modeling assessments.

Verification & Handover

  • Define verification scopes and technical criteria for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and grid compliance commissioning.

  • Support engineering, commissioning, and project management teams during post-award handover to ensure seamless project delivery.

 

Scope Boundaries

  • To preserve focus on control systems and software integration, this position explicitly excludes:

  • Battery cell/module selection, chemistry evaluation, and electrochemical degradation modeling.

  • Mechanical layout, thermal HVAC design, or fire suppression engineering of BESS containers.

  • Primary high/medium voltage electrical hardware engineering (transformers, switchgear internals, or EPC civil infrastructure).

 

Qualifications & Profile

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Professional Experience:

  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in technical presales, solution architecture, or systems engineering focusing on EMS, PPC, or SCADA in power generation or grid utilities.

  • Practical familiarity with grid integration procedures and technical dialogue with European grid operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Technical & Protocol Competencies:

  • Solid understanding of power utility communication standards: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, and OPC UA.

  • Hands-on experience with industrial automation platforms (PLCs/RTUs), real-time historians, and SCADA packages.

  • Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity best practices (IEC 62443 / IEC 62351).

Key Competencies:

  • Strong analytical capability to dissect technical tender documents into structured requirements.

  • Confident presentation skills in customer-facing technical exchanges and contract negotiations.

Language Skills:

  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is required.

  • German language or any other third EU or Chinese proficiency are strongly preferred.

Mit einer Teamgröße von über 200 Mitarbeitern legen wir großen Wert auf Werte wie Gemeinschaft, Vertrauen und Innovation. Bei uns erwartet dich eine spannende Herausforderung, bei der du nicht nur deine technischen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln kannst, sondern auch Teil eines Teams wirst, das Wachstum, Fairness und Respekt großschreibt. Wir fördern ein Umfeld von Ehrlichkeit und Integrität, in dem du deine Ideen einbringen und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst. Wenn du bereit bist, deine Karriere in einem dynamischen und unterstützenden Umfeld zu starten, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Werde Teil unserer Community und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Mobilität. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Unser Talentprogramm :

Unser internes Nachwuchsprogramm bringt dich in 5 Jahren vom Azubi zur Führungskraft. Du machst nicht nur einen Abschluss – du sammelst gleich 5 Qualifikationen, die dich im Technikbereich weit nach vorne bringen.

Das Besondere: Du verdienst vom ersten Tag an, arbeitest in der Praxis und entwickelst dich kontinuierlich weiter. Kein theoretisches Studium im Hörsaal – sondern echte Karriere im Biker's Universe.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Reparatur, Wartung und Instandsetzung von Motorrädern & Rollern und kannst dabei auf die neusten Diagnosegeräte zugreifen

  • Du hilfst bei dem Fahrzeugaufbau von Neufahrzeugen

  • Du lernst, wie man die Wartung und den Service an Kundenmotorrädern
    durchführt

  • Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung von Werkstatt- und Servicekunden

  • Du wirkst bei der Zubehörmontage mit

Nach der Ausbildung: Einstieg als Geselle in unserer Meisterwerkstatt

Parallel zu all dem Weiterbildung zum:

  • Zertifizierten Limbächer-Technikerin

  • Herstellermarken-Spezialist (Ducati, Yamaha, Honda etc.)

  • Geprüften Servicetechnikerin

  • Begeisterte Talente, die Technik lieben und richtig was können wollen

  • Du packst lieber an, als nur in der Schule zu sitzen

  • Zuverlässig, kontaktfreudig und kommunikationsfähig

  • Spaß am Schrauben

  • Teamfähigkeit, Selbstständigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Duale Ausbildung: Beruf & Weiterbildung kombiniert – echte Praxis von Tag 1.

  • Gehalt statt BAföG: Du verdienst vom ersten Tag an – und das steigt mit jedem Abschluss.

  • Klarer 5-Jahres-Plan: Du weißt genau, wo du hinwillst und wie du dorthin kommst.

  • Zertifikate mit Wert: Anerkannte Abschlüsse, die dich im Handel oder in der Technik weiter bringen.

  • Echte Karrierechancen: Aufstieg zur Führungskraft – bei uns im Haus, nicht irgendwo anders.

You will operate at the center of complex engineering programs to coordinate AI, robotics, hardware, operations, and customer teams to move our systems from prototype to real-world production.

title: Technical Strategy Manager H/F
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Context

We are looking for hybrid profile, sitting at the intersection of strategy and engineering, able to rigorously evaluate the technology choices made by the R&D and innovation teams, audit our internal capabilities, and challenge product/tech trade-offs with a business lens. This is not a technical team management role, but a role of constructive counter-power and strategic alignment between engineering and business priorities.

You will ensure that our technological decisions (R&D, innovation, architecture choices, build vs buy, roadmap prioritization) are aligned with overall strategy, economically sound, and robust by actively challenging the relevant teams rather than rubber-stamping their proposals.

Role & Missions:

Strategic and technical challenge

  • Challenge the technical choices and roadmaps proposed by R&D and the Innovation team (architecture, stack, prioritization, build vs buy vs partner)

  • Question the underlying assumptions behind technical projects (feasibility, ROI, strategic alignment, technical debt incurred)

  • Produce well-argued, independent analyses not rubber-stamped validations

Technology and market watch

  • Run continuous technical and technology watch (competitors, emerging technologies, market trends, new tools, and platforms) to keep the company's decisions informed by the state of the art

  • Identify technologies or approaches that could create a competitive advantage, or expose the company to being left behind

  • Turn watch findings into actionable inputs for the R&D/Innovation roadmap and for COMEX-level strategic discussions

  • Build and maintain a structured watch process (sources, cadence, internal distribution) rather than ad hoc monitoring

Capability audit

  • Regularly map and assess the company's technical capabilities (skills, tools, infrastructure, external dependencies)

  • Identify areas of risk, over-investment, under-investment, or critical dependency

  • Benchmark our capabilities against the market and competitors

Technology strategy

  • Contribute to defining the company's technology strategy alongside the Strategy & Operations Director

  • Assess build, buy, partner, or acquisition opportunities on technology topics

  • Inform R&D resource allocation decisions with a strategic and financial lens

Reporting and governance

  • Produce syntheses and recommendations for COMEX on tech-strategy topics

  • Set up tracking indicators on technical execution vs. commitments made

  • Participate in R&D/Innovation committees as an independent strategic voice

Candidate profile

Experience

  • 5-6 years of overall experience, engineering background (degree in engineering or equivalent)

  • Ideal trajectory: 2-3 years of hands-on technical execution, followed by 2-3 years in a hybrid technical/business role e.g. Engineer → Technical Product Manager, Engineer → tech-focused strategy consulting, or Engineer → Chief of Staff to a CTO/VP Engineering

  • Profiles with only pure execution experience (no exposure to business trade-offs) or only early technical experience followed by years of generalist consulting (no longer technically credible) are not a fit for this role

  • Given the seniority level, the candidate should compensate for limited years of experience with either deep, recognized expertise in a specific technical domain (enough to be seen as a peer by R&D on that topic) or a strong, proven track record of challenging senior stakeholders from a strategy/consulting background.

Technical skills

  • Hands-on experience in a technical environment (dev, data, tech product, architecture, not consulting-only exposure)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand architecture choices and technical trade-offs, and to assess their relevance

  • Comfortable engaging as a peer with CTOs, tech leads, and senior engineers

  • Able to speak in concrete, specific terms about a real technical decision they challenged or questioned

Strategy / business skills

  • Ability to translate technical issues into business implications, and vice versa

Critical soft skills

  • Strong critical thinking and independence of judgment

  • Able to distinguish a genuine technical risk from a mere communication gap

  • Natural credibility: earns legitimacy through the rigor of the analysis, not through hierarchy

Success indicators (by month 12)

  • Technical capability map completed and kept up to date

  • A structured technology watch process in place, with regular outputs reaching R&D/Innovation and COMEX

  • Number of R&D/Innovation decisions meaningfully redirected following a well-argued challenge

  • Perceived quality of recommendations by COMEX and by the technical teams themselves

  • Measurable reduction in the gap between technical roadmap and strategic priorities

title: Technical Support Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

We are a fast-growing embodied AI company building robots that reason and act in real warehouse and factory environments. Our AI-powered systems help businesses streamline operations, boost productivity and transform physical work.

Overview

  • Collaborate with internal and external hardware and software teams to solve complex technical problems.

Skills

  • Proficiency in Python programming and the ability to debug code.

Aufgaben

Du begleitest unsere Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zur serienreifen Realität und übernimmst dabei die volle Verantwortung für Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit. Analytisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe – wer eine bessere Lösung sieht, spricht sie an.

So sieht deine Arbeit konkret aus:

Entwicklungsmanagement

  • Technische Verantwortung für Entwicklungsprojekte im Kosten-, Zeit- und Qualitätsrahmen – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Fertigungsüberführung

Technisches Life Cycle Management

  • Aktive Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte auf technologischer und konzeptioneller Ebene

  • Erste Anlaufstelle bei fertigungs- und qualitätsbezogenen Fragestellungen und Problemen

  • Verantwortung für das Änderungsmanagement – von der Idee bis zur Serienreife

  • Unterstützung von Vertrieb und Produktmanagement mit fundierter technischer Expertise

Qualifikation

Wir suchen Menschen, die technische Verantwortung wirklich übernehmen wollen und wissen, wie man unterschiedliche Abteilungen zur Erreichung eines gemeinsamen Ziels bewegt. Wenn du dich hier und bei den nachfolgenden Punkten wiedererkennst, dann passt du zu uns:

  • Nachgewiesene Kompetenz im Entwicklungs- und Projektmanagement – du kennst Methoden, Tools und vor allem die Realität dahinter

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit – du weißt, wie du unterschiedliche Abteilungen und Interessen zusammenbringst

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du verlierst Themen nicht aus dem Blick, auch wenn du sie weitergibst

  • Freude daran, Dinge nachhaltig zu verbessern – nicht nur kurzfristig zu lösen

Benefits

Warum TWK? Weil hier mehr zählt als Obstkorb und Parkplatz.

Ja, wir haben Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad, eclara, Wellhub, Getränke, Obst und Firmenevents – aber seien wir ehrlich: Dafür wechselst du nicht den Job. Das hier macht den echten Unterschied:

Stabil aufgestellt und bereit zu investieren.

Ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit einer jungen, nahbaren Geschäftsleitung und einem stabilen wirtschaftlichen Fundament. Das schafft nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch den Spielraum, in Ausstattung zu investieren: Hochwertige Testumgebungen mit moderner Ausstattung von Steuerungen über Drehmotoren und Klimakammern bis hin zu modernen Messsensoren. Wer den Willen mitbringt, etwas zu bewegen, findet bei uns den Raum dazu und flache Hierarchien sorgen dafür, dass Ideen ankommen, ohne sich durch Hierarchieebenen kämpfen zu müssen.

Ob im Büro oder von zuhause – flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten geben dir den Spielraum, der zu deinem Leben passt. Dazu ein gut angebundener Standort in Wedel.

title: Tools Developer (Rust / Linux)
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.


About the team and role

The tools built by the Developer Experience team are how engineers — both inside Fractile and at our customers — see, control and understand the Fractile inference accelerator. That means the command-line utilities used to discover, configure and health-check devices; the diagnostics used during hardware bring-up and in the datacentre; and the profiling, tracing and debugging tools that show where the time goes across the host, the driver and the silicon.

As a Tools Developer you will design and build these tools in Rust, running on Linux hosts from a single developer workstation against large datacentre deployments. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, kernel driver, runtime and Developer Experience teams to understand what they need, and turn that into fast, reliable and well-designed tools that fit naturally into existing Linux workflows. This is largely greenfield work, with real scope to shape how our tooling is architected and how it is used.


About you

You enjoy building tools that other engineers rely on every day, and you care about getting the details right: clear output, sensible defaults, good error messages and behaviour you can script against. You are at home on Linux, comfortable working anywhere from the shell down to sysfs, ioctls and the kernel/userspace boundary, and you know how to find out what a system is actually doing when it misbehaves. You are self-driven, able to identify tooling opportunities for yourself, and happy to work autonomously in areas of ambiguity.


Key Requirements

  • Strong Rust skills, with experience shipping production-quality tools or libraries

  • Knowledge of Linux from a developer's perspective: processes, memory, filesystems, sysfs/procfs, device files and ioctls, systemd and the kernel/userspace interface

  • Experience designing command-line tools and APIs that are easy to learn, script and automate

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience writing tools for PCIe-attached devices, GPUs or other ML accelerators

  • Experience using CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan Compute, or similar

  • Familiarity with tracing and telemetry formats or systems such as Perfetto, Chrome trace format, OpenTelemetry or Prometheus

  • Experience exposing Rust libraries to Python (e.g. PyO3) or C

  • Experience with Bazel, CI/CD or packaging software for Linux distributions

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

title: VP Data Centres
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have:
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

title: VP, Software Engineering (NwPS)
descriptionHtml:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Job Title: Head of NwPS Engineering 

Location: Global / Remote (preference for US, UK, or Spain) 

About the Role 

The Head of NwPS Engineering is a VP-level leadership role responsible for the full engineering delivery and technical strategy of Vonage’s Network Powered Solutions business. This is not a delivery management role — it is an engineering leadership role that carries end-to-end accountability for the platform powering Vonage’s fastest-growing business unit. 

NwPS is Vonage’s strategic growth engine, commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs — including Verify, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Number Verification, and Quality on Demand — for enterprise customers across FinTech, Healthcare, Transportation, and beyond. The engineering function that supports it spans multiple squads, complex multi-CSP integrations, a rapidly evolving product portfolio, and an emerging AI and agentic engineering capability. 

The Head of NwPS Engineering will own the vision, structure, and execution of this engineering function. They will report directly to the SA NwPS General Manager and serve as a key voice on the NwPS leadership team. 

Key Responsibilities 

Engineering Delivery 

  • Full engineering accountability for: Verify, VNA (Vonage Network APIs), Connectors, Intelligence Engine, Advanced NwPS, and future NwPS products 
  • Ownership of all NwPS squad delivery across Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, and Verify 
  • QA Excellence and SDET capability across NwPS engineering 
  • DevRel engineering in support of the NwPS developer ecosystem 
  • Operational Excellence, SRE practices, and platform reliability 

Architecture 

  • End-to-end architectural accountability for NwPS engineering 
  • Direct leadership of the NwPS Architecture function (Architecture Lead reports to this role) 
  • Ownership of architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture across NwPS products 
  • Technical decision-making authority for platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards 

Strategic Engineering Leadership 

  • Agentic AI and MCP engineering strategy and execution 
  • Engineering roadmap aligned with NwPS product strategy and commercial OKRs 
  • Representation on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside NwPS Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD 
  • Cross-functional partnership with CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering on shared platform standards and practices 

Reporting Structure 

This role leads the NwPS Architecture Lead and the squad leads for Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, Verify, and SDET Improvements. 

The engineering organisation comprises approximately 40+ engineers across the squads, with seven direct reports once the Architecture Lead position is filled. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

Engineering Vision and Strategy 

  • Demonstrated ability to set and communicate a multi-year engineering vision for a complex, API-native product portfolio 
  • Experience leading engineering for developer-facing or telco/network API products is strongly preferred 
  • Proven capability to align engineering strategy with product roadmap and commercial priorities — not just execute against them 

Leadership at Scale 

  • Track record of leading distributed, multi-squad engineering organisations across multiple geographies 
  • Ability to develop and retain engineering talent at all levels, including squad leads and senior engineers 
  • Experience managing engineering through periods of significant growth and structural change 

Technical Depth 

  • Strong grounding in API platform architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering 
  • Familiarity with CSP/telco network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) is a significant advantage 
  • Hands-on architecture experience sufficient to provide meaningful technical guidance to the Architecture function 

Execution and Accountability 

  • History of delivering complex, multi-CSP or multi-partner integrations on aggressive timelines 
  • Operational rigour: reliability, KTLO management, cycle time, and quality engineering are active leadership priorities, not delegated concerns 

Why This Role Matters 

NwPS is building the infrastructure for a market that is still being defined. Carrier-grade, developer-accessible network APIs are emerging as a category, and Vonage is positioned to lead it. The Head of NwPS Engineering will be the person who ensures the engineering organisation is built to move fast, scale reliably, and stay ahead of a rapidly evolving technical landscape. 

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not manage something that already exists. 

About Vonage and SA NwPS 

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader, part of the Ericsson group. The NwPS Solution Area is Vonage’s dedicated business unit for Network Powered Solutions — commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs for enterprise customers globally. NwPS operates as a standalone business with its own P&L accountability, product roadmap, sales motion, and engineering function.

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Qualifikation

Was wir uns von dir wünschen.

Wir interessieren uns vor allem für dich als Menschen und prüfen immer individuell, ob deine Erwartungen, deine Skills und dein Drive zu uns passen. Benefits

Ja, wir fordern einiges von unseren Teammitgliedern, dafür haben wir aber auch einiges zu bieten. descriptionHtml:

Find, hire and retain the best talent.

Unser erfahrenes Berater-Team besetzt deutschlandweit erfolgreich verschiedenste Positionen (von Geschäftsführerin und C-Level über Fach- und Führungskräfte bis hin zum Azubi) in diversen Branchen (E-Commerce, Retail, SaaS/Tech, Maschinenbau oder Logistik uvm.) bei namhaften Kunden (Flink, Flip, Hermès, Zalando, Zeppelin, RIMOWA, FactFinder, TWAICE, uvm.).

Du bist gerade mitten im Studium und auf der Suche nach einem flexiblen Werkstudentenjob oder einem Praktikum im Recruiting, den Du 100 % Remote ausüben kannst?

Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Recruiting oder Active Sourcing gesammelt und möchtest sie jetzt in echten Mandaten vertiefen? Du hast Spaß am direkten Kontakt mit Bewerbern und möchtest uns im täglichen Rennen um neue Talente unterstützen?

Dann lies unbedingt weiter.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Recruiting Teams in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent oder Praktikant Recruiting / Active Sourcing (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – remote aus ganz Deutschland.

In dieser Position arbeitest Du eng mit unserem Senior Recruiter zusammen. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich das Active Sourcing für spannende Positionen bei namhaften Kunden – vor allem Sales-, GTM- und Tech-Rollen bei Start-ups und Scale-ups. Eine grandiose Candidate Experience zu gestalten ist für Dich hierbei selbstverständlich.

Unser Must-have: Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise im Active Sourcing. Alles andere lässt sich lernen – und wir passen den Job Deinen Stärken an.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst das Active Sourcing via LinkedIn (Recruiter) und XING eigenständig, baust Suchstrings und Talent-Pools auf und unterstützt beim Kandidatenscreening.

  • Du verwaltest, pflegst und organisierst die Kandidaten-Pipeline im ATS (z. B. Personio, Ashby), stehst im aktiven Austausch mit nationalen sowie internationalen Talenten (Terminvereinbarung, Nachforderung fehlender Informationen, Absagen) und sorgst mit Deiner professionellen Bewerberkommunikation für eine positive Candidate Experience.

  • Du erstellst attraktive Stellenanzeigen, die im Gedächtnis bleiben (wenn Du gleich einen Vorschlag für diese Anzeige hast, nur her damit ;-)).

  • Du kannst Deine Kreativität in verschiedenen Projekten mit dem Schwerpunkt Recruiting, Employer Branding und KI-gestütztes Sourcing einbringen.

  • Du bist stets auf der Suche nach neuen, innovativen Direct-Search-Kanälen und hilfst uns bei der Weiterentwicklung von zielgruppenspezifischen Recruiting-Strategien.

  • Du hast darüber hinaus weitere Ideen, wie Du uns optimal unterstützen kannst? Dann lass uns unbedingt sprechen, wir freuen uns auf den Austausch mit Dir!

Deine Skills:

Must-haves:

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Recruiting gesammelt – z. B. als Werkstudent:in, Praktikant:in oder in einer HR-Rolle – idealerweise im Active Sourcing / Direct Search über LinkedIn oder XING.

  • Du bist an einer anerkannten (Fach-)Hochschule immatrikuliert (Werkstudium) oder suchst ein Pflicht- bzw. freiwilliges Praktikum (3–6 Monate). Die Fachrichtung ist zweitrangig.

  • Du wohnst in Deutschland (Voraussetzung für die Anstellung) und arbeitest remote.

  • Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher (mind. C1), Deine Englischkenntnisse sind verhandlungssicher.

  • Du hast ca. 20 Stunden die Woche Zeit, um uns zu unterstützen (Praktikum in Voll- oder Teilzeit möglich).

Was uns außerdem wichtig ist:

  • Du bist neugierig, hast Lust auf das Thema Recruiting und Talent Acquisition, kannst Dir schnell neue Themen aneignen und würdest lieber heute als morgen loslegen.

  • Du scheust Dich nicht, Dinge zu hinterfragen und hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an Deine Arbeit.

  • Du hast sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du kennst Deine Stärken und erkennst schnell, wie Du diese einbringen kannst und uns optimal unterstützt.

  • Du hast Spaß daran, selbstständig zu arbeiten, bist dienstleistungsorientiert sowie flexibel.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktive Stundenvergütung + erfolgsabhängiger Bonus bei entsprechender Erfahrung oder Praktikumsvergütung

  • 20 bezahlte Urlaubstage pro Jahr (bei 20 Std./Woche), damit Du neben Studium und Arbeit eine optimale Erholung bekommst.

  • Arbeit zu 100 % Remote in Deutschland – optional Treffen mit dem Team in Berlin.

  • Maximale Flexibilität in Bezug auf Deine Arbeitszeiten – uns ist es egal, wann Du Deine Arbeit erledigst. Hauptsache die Qualität stimmt!

  • Abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag, vielfältige Aufgaben, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, offene, transparente Kommunikation und steile Lernkurve – Du siehst den kompletten Recruiting-Prozess von der Suche bis zur Einstellung.

  • Professionelles Tool-Setup: LinkedIn Recruiter, moderne ATS und KI-Tools im Sourcing-Alltag.

  • Unterschiedliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – lass uns das individuell für Dich festlegen.

  • Viel Raum zur persönlichen Entfaltung und zum eigenverantwortlichen Arbeiten in Deiner neuen Rolle.

  • Arbeit in einem kleinen, erfahrenen Team sowie die Möglichkeit, Deine individuellen Stärken und Ideen einzubringen.

  • Chance, eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung aktiv mitzugestalten und das Thema Recruiting neu zu denken!

  • Auf Wunsch ist Vollbeschäftigung in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit möglich.

Häufige Fragen (FAQ)

Kann ich komplett remote arbeiten? Ja, zu 100 % – Voraussetzung ist ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

Wie viele Stunden pro Woche? Als Werkstudent:in ca. 20 Stunden (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit mehr möglich), im Praktikum Voll- oder Teilzeit – wie es zu Deinem Studium passt.

Brauche ich Vorerfahrung? Ja – erste Erfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise im Active Sourcing, ist unser Must-have.

Wann kann ich starten? Ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

Wie läuft die Bewerbung ab? Kurzer Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt – kein Anschreiben nötig. Der Prozess hat zwei Runden: ein 30-minütiges Video-Interview zum Kennenlernen und ein 30-minütiges Case-Study-Interview mit einer praxisnahen Sourcing-Aufgabe. Nach jeder Runde bekommst Du innerhalb von 48 Stunden eine Rückmeldung.

Mirko Duus · Geschäftsführer, Best Talents Consulting GmbH, Berlin
