title: Working Student AI Solutions Architect – Generative AI & Data Platforms
descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT Application note

Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you.

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Design the path from a business requirement to a working data and AI system. You will work directly with our founders and engineers to turn discovery findings into architecture decisions, implementation plans and tested components.

Our architecture and advisory work connects enterprise data platforms with generative AI, AI agents and business applications. Depending on the engagement, solutions run on AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Google Cloud or customer-managed infrastructure.

What you will do

Translate business workflows, existing systems and data constraints into clear solution designs, with explicit assumptions and acceptance criteria.

Design data flows connecting ingestion, storage, retrieval, model inference, APIs and downstream enterprise systems.

Evaluate trade-offs across cloud services, open-source components and on-premises deployment, including security, reliability, cost and maintainability.

Create architecture diagrams, technical decision records and delivery estimates; contribute to discovery workshops and design reviews.

Validate important assumptions with Python, SQL, API integrations or infrastructure prototypes, then work with engineers on implementation.

Specify access controls, evaluation, observability and human approval steps for enterprise RAG and agentic workflows.

What you bring

Current university enrollment in a relevant technical discipline, combined with substantial hands-on experience building software or data systems.

Evidence that you have delivered systems used by others and can explain your own design choices, implementation and operational lessons.

Strong Python and SQL skills, practical cloud experience and an understanding of APIs, data modeling and deployment.

Applied understanding of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and the data foundations these systems require.

The judgement to own a defined workstream, surface risks early and communicate technical decisions clearly in English.

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Terraform, Lakehouse architecture or technical discovery with business stakeholders is valuable. Depth in one relevant environment matters more than familiarity with every platform.

What you can expect

You will contribute to customer-facing architecture and implementation, work closely with the founders and receive substantive design and code review. Your part-time scope and schedule will be planned around your studies.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Include a short example of a system you helped design and build: the problem, your contribution and a trade-off you made. An anonymised explanation is welcome; please do not share confidential client material.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you.

Stay connected

Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions.

title: Working Student B2G: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
01 · Why this role exists

This is not your typical student job.

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you help win it. You'll work directly with our B2G Manager and the founders on funding that flows straight into RIZM's cash flow, and you'll see from the inside how the public sector decides and buys. Something most students never get to see.

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one.

02 · What you'll do

  • Public funding as a growth channel: Help build the pipeline for Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: scout new calls, prepare applications and keep track of our running programmes.

  • Connect research: Support our research collaboration with Stanford and help turn it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first: Set up trackers, automations and AI workflows so our funding pipeline runs with as little manual work as possible. Your ideas count here.

  • Support ReNET-EV: Help with our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region): documentation, reporting and the rollout to more municipalities.

  • Get to know municipalities: Research how cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies decide and buy, as groundwork for our first public-sector customers.

  • Build the data foundation: Collect public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

03 · What you bring

  • Studies: You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme, e.g. public administration, political science, economics, business, energy, engineering or something similar.

  • Curiosity: The energy transition, municipal heat planning or how public funding works interest you. No prior experience needed.

  • Writing: You write clearly and in a structured way.

  • AI-native: You're curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility.

  • Languages: Fluent German and good English.

04 · Why you should apply now

B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start.

  • Small team: You'll work actively and day to day with our full-time B2G Manager, not on the sidelines.

  • Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch.

  • Founders: You work directly with them.

  • Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making.

  • Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Flexible hours: They fit around your studies.

05 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest sentences on these two questions.

  1. A mayor gives you 2 minutes. Which energy problem in their city would you tell them RIZM can help with?

  2. Research funding sounds dusty to most students, but we think it's not :) How would you convince your friends it's actually cool, in the language you'd really use with them?

After that:

  • Intro call: 15 minutes on video to get to know each other.

  • Meet the team: At our office, with the team and one of our founders. Then we decide together.

descriptionHtml:

You will join our team at the intersection of international trade, export control, and day-to-day operations at STARK. As a Working Student in Export Control, you will support us in reliably integrating national and international export control regulations into our daily business processes. Initial practical experience in export control, customs, compliance, or foreign trade, for example through internships or working student positions.

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang.
